1786674802584_style.name: Journal Sketch Stop-Motion
1786674802584_style.prompt: Real journal-sketch stop-motion style; the painting process in pencil, charcoal and watercolor filmed on actual notebook pages; drawn characters moving across the paper surface; eraser marks and paper grain clearly visible; the desktop and the hand holding the pen occasionally entering the frame; overall the intimate handmade texture of the creative process itself becoming the animation.

1786674802721_style.name: Gothic Doodle Line
1786674802721_style.prompt: Gothic doodle line style; neurotic, jittery fine lines outline bony figures; mostly black and white with patterned backgrounds such as bullseyes and spirals; morbidly cute designs with big heads, thin limbs and stitch elements; light and shadow rendered in radiating hatching; overall the grotesque humor texture of dark fairy-tale doodles.

1786674802858_style.name: Chinese Gongbi Heavy-Color Lianhuanhua
1786674802858_style.prompt: Chinese-style gongbi heavy-color lianhuanhua style; iron-wire line drawing with mineral-pigment heavy color; bright red wedding robes and gilded ornaments rich and solemn; classical, delicate facial rendering; dense ensemble compositions like an ancient handscroll; occasional ink-wash transitions; overall the gorgeous Chinese texture of traditional lianhuanhua and gongbi heavy-color painting.

1786674802995_style.name: Acrylic Texture Impasto Picture Book
1786674802995_style.prompt: Acrylic texture impasto picture-book style; paint stacked on real canvas, with palette-knife and brush textures visibly raised; skies and grass smeared in bold, broad strokes; fuzzy character edges melting into the background; fresh colors with hand-painted warmth; overall the raw artistic texture of frame-by-frame animation painted on physical canvas.

1786674803132_style.name: B&W Woodcut Line
1786674803132_style.prompt: Black-and-white woodcut line style, a relief-print look like woodcut or linocut, decorative texture formed by short white lines and arcs left by the carving knife, and highly simplified, patterned forms with folk printmaking charm. Pure black and white, large black grounds in strong contrast with white carved marks. No tonal gradients; light, dark and layering come from the density of carved lines. Paper shows uneven ink and press grain. Flat, strongly decorative compositions, often with a framed border and foreground, middle ground and distance stacked in layers; overall an archaic, forceful, simple and serene graphic beauty, as if hand-printed.

1786674803269_style.name: Backlit Silhouette Epic
1786674803269_style.prompt: Backlit silhouette epic style, 2D illustration, subjects rendered as pure black silhouettes with simple forms and no inner detail against a glowing single-red gradient that runs from bright red at the center to dark red at the edges. Almost only crimson and ink black. Strong backlight turns subjects into full silhouettes, edges occasionally catching a faint rim of light, with thin mist lying on the horizon. Coarse film-noise grain over the whole image. Horizontally unfolding compositions with vast emptiness, tiny subjects and geometric dark blocks slicing the frame; overall a tragic, desolate, austere backlit silhouette epic aesthetic full of fate.

1786674803406_style.name: Dusk Realistic Impasto
1786674803406_style.prompt: Dusk realistic impasto illustration style; the light at the warm-cool boundary of twilight in delicate impasto; a girl's school uniform and hair in loose, realistic strokes; highway guardrails and distant mountains alternating between sharp and soft; palette blending blue-grey with orange-pink; a quiet, wistful mood; overall the twilight poetry of Japanese youth illustration.

1786674803543_style.name: Dark Night Ocean Impasto
1786674803543_style.prompt: Dark night ocean impasto animation style; deep blue-black sea and waves churning in impasto strokes; a character lit by faint warm yellow light as the sole light source; extreme light-dark contrast; thick, powerful wave motion; overall the dramatic oil-painting texture of a single point of warmth in the dark.

1786674803680_style.name: Orange-Blue Dynamic Flat Color
1786674803680_style.prompt: Orange-blue high-saturation dynamic flat-color style; brick-orange buildings clash with teal-blue sky; clouds graphic like paper cut-outs; characters running and leaping with bold, tilted perspective; clean, crisp lineless color blocks; speed lines and fragments heighten motion; overall the sharp, exhilarating motion aesthetics of comic storyboards.

1786674803817_style.name: Grainy Texture Picture Book
1786674803817_style.prompt: Grainy texture picture-book illustration style; charcoal and pastel grain covering the frame; beach and sea-breeze scenes in warm, mellow greys; characters with tousled hair in simple, unrefined strokes; realistic props such as old phones entering the frame for contrast; overall the rough yet gentle texture of a hand-drawn picture book.

1786674803954_style.name: Cool-Toned Cel Urban Animation
1786674803954_style.prompt: Cool-toned cel urban animation style, nineties 2D hand-drawn cel look, realistic proportions and cool, stern character designs, sharp, angular linework, and flat color with large hard-edged two-tone shadows. A gloomy, low-saturation palette of dark green, gray-teal, deep blue and black, accented with mustard yellow and dark red. Strong contrast with noir chiaroscuro, much of the background sinking into darkness. Overlaid with weathered, mottled texture, grain and slight fading. Large foreground close-ups paired with background figures for depth tension; overall a restrained, sharp, decadent and cold adult animation mood with the air of an urban crime film.

1786674804091_style.name: Bright French Animation
1786674804091_style.prompt: Bright French animation style; gouache-textured warm yellow stairwells and teal-green railings; bright colors with transparent light; exaggerated, fluid character motion full of comic rhythm; soft brushstroke edges; varied high- and low-angle composition; overall the light, nimble texture of a French animated short.

1786674804228_style.name: Surreal Uncanny Flat Color
1786674804228_style.prompt: Surreal uncanny flat-color style; pale figures juxtaposed with gloomy grassland; black smoke rising in the distance creating unease; low-saturation grey-green colors; calm, delicate brushwork setting off the eerie atmosphere; symmetrical, static composition like a stage; overall a cold, surreal sense of psychological pressure.

1786674804365_style.name: Live-Action Hand-Drawn Composite
1786674804365_style.prompt: Live-action hand-drawn composite style; hand-drawn 2D characters layered over real photographic scenes; extremely minimal line-drawn figures forming a cute contrast with the live footage; light, shadow and perspective matched naturally to the footage; overall the mixed-media fun of reality and the doodle dimension breaking into each other.

1786674804502_style.name: Fauvist Naive Picture Book
1786674804502_style.prompt: Fauvist naive picture book style, painted in large flat areas with gouache and printmaking texture, color freed from nature and led by emotion, forms simplified and slightly naive with irregular hand-drawn edges, often blended with cut-paper collage-like decorative motifs. Intense clashing colors, with vermilion orange, ultramarine, lemon yellow, black and pastel green boldly juxtaposed. Nearly flat lighting with only a little hatching to hint at volume. Visible paper texture and brushstrokes with slight print grain. Flat, collage-like compositions layering space and decorative patterns; overall a fiery, free, radiant picture book quality with modernist decorative flair.

1786674804639_style.name: Warm-Light Fairy-Tale Impasto
1786674804639_style.prompt: Warm-light fairy-tale impasto animation style; the contrast of warm tavern light against a cold rainy night; a rounded boy in fine impasto; light beams pouring through window lattices with visible dust; colors full as candy yet with an old-time filter; overall the warm, comforting texture of a fairy-tale film.

1786674804776_style.name: Retro Decorative Pattern Illustration
1786674804776_style.prompt: Retro decorative pattern illustration style; the frame filled with dense decorative motifs and printed textures; distressed palette dominated by earthy yellow and olive green; car interiors and objects all treated as patterns; archaic line work like a block print; overall the retro illustration texture of mid-century textiles intertwined with decorative art.

1786674804913_style.name: 1990s Japanese Nostalgic Animation
1786674804913_style.prompt: 1990s Japanese nostalgic animation style, 2D hand-drawn cel look, characters with near-realistic proportions and features, finely drawn eyes without excessive exaggeration, clean, delicate linework, and flat color with hard-edged shadow blocks. A cool, dark palette of deep blue, indigo and gray-violet with cool skin tones and a few warm accents on lips and highlights. Strong lighting contrast, side and top light carving large shadows across faces. The slight grain and softening of VHS-era animation. Mostly close-ups and oppressive framing; overall a cold, delicate, nostalgic nineties adult animation quality with psychological suspense.

1786674805050_style.name: Retro Paper Collage Surrealism
1786674805050_style.prompt: Retro paper collage surrealist style, faded old photographs, scenic postcards and flower pictures torn, cut and layered, with ragged torn edges and white borders, partial covering and misaligned juxtaposition creating a surreal feel. Colors like yellowed old photos, faded brick red, teal, beige and gray-pink at low saturation. Lighting keeps the soft original light of the photographs. Visible grain, noise and aged paper texture over the image. Often a centered subject against a background of fragments assembled into a grid; overall a nostalgic, poetic, quiet and slightly mysterious found-object collage art quality.

1786674805187_style.name: Fantasy Doodle Town
1786674805187_style.prompt: Fantasy doodle-town animation style; twisted, winding buildings and streets covered in doodle detail; warm orange lights bleeding into the night; energetic chibi big-head characters; colors as rich as syrup; overall the fantastical illustration texture of a wild amusement park bursting with density.

1786674805324_style.name: Cozy European Flat Animation
1786674805324_style.prompt: Cozy European flat animation style; soft flat color with slight paper-grain texture; morning-light kitchen scenes full of everyday life; geometrically summarized characters with relaxed, natural movement; creamy, warm palette; lighting simplified into soft color blocks; overall the warm, everyday texture of European animation.

1786674805461_style.name: Expressionist Acrylic Painting
1786674805461_style.prompt: Expressionist acrylic painting style; intense brushstrokes applied directly; blue skin against a bright yellow kitchen in glaring contrast; distorted, elongated figures with emotions laid bare; strong frame-by-frame painted jitter; smoke, light and shadow flowing roughly; overall the raw expressionist texture of adult-oriented art animation.

1786674805598_style.name: Grotesque Pen & Wash Comic
1786674805598_style.prompt: Grotesque pen-and-wash comic style; skewed, jittery pen lines outline rooms and corridors from a first-person view; light flat washes dominated by mustard green and beige; fisheye perspective distortion; dense doodle details, humorous and grotesque; overall the absurd narrative texture of an independent comic turned into animation.

1786674805735_style.name: French Retro Comic
1786674805735_style.prompt: French retro comic style; faces in flat ginger-yellow with exaggerated features; thick lines outlining neurotic expressions; Parisian streets and vintage cars in nostalgic watercolor texture; crowded, lively composition; retro, slightly faded palette; overall the biting humor texture of French satirical comics adapted into animation.

1786674805872_style.name: Ethnic Decorative Illustration
1786674805872_style.prompt: Ethnic decorative illustration style; grassland song-and-dance and galloping-horse imagery laid out as patterns; colors as rich as a woven carpet, interweaving sapphire blue, crimson and bright yellow; finely detailed costume patterns; circular, symmetrical composition full of ritual feel; overall the decorative beauty of ethnic textiles combined with folk painting.

1786674806009_style.name: B&W Dithered Comic
1786674806009_style.prompt: Black-and-white dot-matrix comic style; the image composed of 1-bit pixel dithering; characters with thick outlines in stark black and white; dot gradients simulating greyscale; like a mix of old computer software and photocopied comics; overall a unique lo-fi digital-retro graphic texture.

1786674806146_style.name: Rich Gouache Street-Life Illustration
1786674806146_style.prompt: Rich-color gouache street-life illustration style; late-night diner scenes in dense warm orange lamplight; crisp impasto gouache strokes with high-saturation colors; vivid, street-smart character expressions; food and counter details deliciously tempting; overall the rich gouache illustration texture brimming with everyday warmth.

1786674806283_style.name: Retro Photo Collage Stop-Motion
1786674806283_style.prompt: Retro photo-collage stop-motion animation style; real photographs and paper-cut materials collaged into stage-like scenes; figures as a mix of old-photo silhouettes and hand-drawing; retro elements such as red curtains and old televisions stacked together; flat perspective with strong stage feel; overall the collage stop-motion texture of a surreal old-album theater.

1786674806420_style.name: Realistic Doll Stop-Motion
1786674806420_style.prompt: Realistic doll stop-motion animation style; ball-jointed dolls filmed frame by frame; refined makeup and realistic strand-by-strand hair; shallow depth of field with lighting like a miniature studio; toy-scaled props; overall the stop-motion texture where the refinement of doll photography coexists with subtle eeriness.

1786674806557_style.name: Handmade Cloth Puppet Fairy Tale
1786674806557_style.prompt: Handmade cloth puppet fairy-tale stop-motion style, physically shot frame by frame, puppets and props hand-made from knitted yarn, crochet and coarse burlap, with loops, frayed edges and stitches clearly visible, and endearing big-headed, round-eyed designs. A warm, aged palette of oatmeal, warm camel, mustard yellow and gray-brown, softly saturated with the plainness of natural fibers. Soft studio light with a side key, faint soft shadows, and backgrounds often a simple seamless gray backdrop. Rich fuzzy texture and slightly shallow depth of field. Simple, centered, eye-level compositions; overall a rough yet tender handmade puppet-theater stop-motion quality with dry humor.

1786674806694_style.name: Minimal Matte 3D
1786674806694_style.prompt: Minimal matte 3D render style; black and white figures in a pure white weightless space; forms highly simplified like rounded chess pieces; matte materials with soft reflections; clean lighting with fine tonal layering; composition with generous negative space; overall the calm, elegant minimal 3D aesthetics of installation art.

1786674806831_style.name: Macaron Teal Cartoon Render
1786674806831_style.prompt: Macaron teal-blue cartoon render style; 3D characters flat-shaded like 2D illustration; fresh, unified macaron palette of teal, blue, pink and white; rounded, simplified classrooms and streets; soft lighting with no hard shadows; overall the fresh, comforting low-saturation cel-shaded 3D cartoon texture.

1786674806968_style.name: Wool Felt Stop-Motion
1786674806968_style.prompt: Wool felt stop-motion style, puppets, props and sets physically made from needle-felted wool, yarn and knitwear, with fluffy fibers and fine stitch textures visible, simple naive designs, and miniature scenes built from real objects. A gray, quiet palette of charcoal, oatmeal white and sand brown with a few dark red accents at very low saturation. Soft top or side light as in a studio, long soft shadows, and backgrounds sinking into dark gray. Rich fuzzy texture, slightly shallow depth of field and light vignetting. Simple symmetrical compositions, often using surreal prop installations to build imagery; overall a quiet, melancholy, poetically metaphorical handmade felt stop-motion quality.

1792513005774_style.name: Black-Ground Floral Decorative Gouache
1792513005774_style.prompt: Contemporary decorative narrative illustration, painted in flat gouache and opaque pigments with fine visible strokes and slightly hand-roughened edges. Backgrounds are mostly deep black, with muted pinks, olive greens and ochre-gold shapes popping forward and touches of warm gold highlights. Lighting is almost flat, with depth carried by value shifts between color blocks. Paper grain and dry-brush pigment texture are clearly visible; space is often filled with dense botanical patterns, and figures are elongated, poised and calm-faced. Compositions are symmetrical and stately, echoing medieval miniatures and folk textile motifs, creating an overall mysterious, ornate and slightly melancholic decorative storybook feel.

1792513005775_style.name: Vivid Film Outdoor Fashion Photography
1792513005775_style.prompt: 1990s vivid-film outdoor fashion photography, photorealistic live-action photographic work, with slide-film-like high saturation dominated by cobalt blue, emerald green, warm red and bright yellow in clean, rich color blocks. Light is strong direct daylight on a clear day, with crisp shadows, bright highlights that never blow out, and clear open skies. Film grain is fine and colors feel full and dense. The camera favors low-angle wide shots with a low horizon, figures staged theatrically in open space with dramatic styling and props, creating an overall bright, romantic, slightly surreal magazine fashion-editorial look.

1792513005776_style.name: Glitter Collage Art Deco Illustration
1792513005776_style.prompt: Art Deco fashion illustration combining soft airbrushed gradients with flat silhouettes, with collaged elements of real glitter, sequins and jewel-like textures. The palette centers on pure black, nude pink and pale lavender-gray, accented with silver-white and pearly highlights. Lighting is soft, with airbrushed gradients modeling facial volume while silhouettes stay completely flat. The paper has a fine grain and the glitter particles sparkle in the light. Compositions favor extreme close-ups and profile outlines, with elegant curved, geometrically simplified lines and refined, heavily made-up features, creating an overall retro-modern, glamorous and dreamy 1980s magazine beauty-illustration look.

1792513005777_style.name: Pink-Ground Oil Pastel Scribble
1792513005777_style.prompt: Quick oil-pastel sketch illustration, scribbled rapidly with chunky oil pastels or crayons; lines are wobbly and lively, strokes overlap visibly, and forms are naive and loose rather than structurally precise. The ground is a large flat candy pink, with the foreground in high-contrast cobalt blue, orange-red, grass green and white, all bright and saturated. There is almost no light and shadow; forms are separated by color blocks and lines. Waxy grain and paper-drag texture are obvious, and empty space is often filled with free doodled curves. Compositions are centered and full, creating an overall fiery, innocent contemporary doodle-art feel bursting with handmade energy.

1792513005778_style.name: Cool-Toned Film Street Fashion Snapshot
1792513005778_style.prompt: Cool-toned film street-fashion snapshot style, photorealistic live-action photographic work, emulating casual 35mm documentary shooting. Tones lean cool gray-blue, skin carries a slight cyan-pink cast, blacks are deep, and overall saturation is low. Light is flat ambient indoor or overcast light, occasionally with direct on-camera flash, keeping shadows soft. Film grain is clear, focus is slightly soft, with light vignetting at the edges. Framing is crowded and casual, often with foreground figures cut off by the frame, shot up close at eye level, with languid, aloof expressions, creating an overall cool, authentic street-snap look with an urban fashion-magazine air.

1792513005779_style.name: American Adult Comedy Animation
1792513005779_style.prompt: American adult sitcom animation style, 2D digital drawing with uniform dark outlines and flat fills with minimal shading. Colors are bright yet fairly natural, with mid-saturation skin tones and clothing set against simplified flat-painted backgrounds. Lighting is nearly flat, with depth separated by color blocks, and the image is clean with no grain. Characters are exaggerated and cartoonish, with simplified features, vivid over-the-top expressions and comedically varied body shapes, often framed in frontal ensemble shots or eye-level medium shots, creating an overall lighthearted, satirical, everyday TV-comedy animation feel.

1792513005780_style.name: Quiet Black-and-White Stipple Illustration
1792513005780_style.prompt: Black-and-white stipple illustration, drawn dot by dot with a technical pen; tone, volume and space are rendered entirely through dot density, with no outline strokes. The palette is pure black, white and gray, with large pale-gray open areas contrasting sharply with dense dark zones. The light source is soft and single, transitions are delicate, and forms feel relief-like and solid. Paper texture is clear and the stippling is even and fine. Compositions are clean and geometric, often framed by rectilinear structures, with generous negative space and tiny figures, creating an overall quiet, solitary, meditative surreal print-like quality.

1792513005781_style.name: 1960s Warm-Lamp Hand-Drawn Animation
1792513005781_style.prompt: 1960s retro hand-drawn animation style, characters outlined in smooth ink lines with flat cel coloring, backgrounds richly hand-painted in gouache and packed with lived-in details. Tones lean warm, built on olive green, mustard yellow, brick red and cream at moderate saturation. Lighting often comes from warm practical point sources such as lamps, giving soft gradations and cozy glows. Paper and paint grain is subtle, with the soft texture of old film. Compositions favor everyday medium shots with layered, cluttered surroundings and calm, relaxed characters, creating an overall nostalgic, cozy animation feel with a leisurely lo-fi mood.

1792513005782_style.name: American Round-Eyed TV Cartoon
1792513005782_style.prompt: American TV cartoon animation style, 2D digital drawing with thin, even dark outlines and flat fills with almost no shading. Colors are bright and saturated, with varied, playful skin and hair hues and clearly separated color blocks. Lighting is flat with no defined light source, and the image is clean without texture or grain. Character design is highly iconic, with signature large round white eyes and tiny dot pupils, exaggerated noses and startled, comical expressions, often arranged in dense, crowded ensemble compositions, creating an overall absurd, lively, briskly paced TV-comedy cartoon feel.

1792513005783_style.name: 1920s Art Deco Fashion Illustration
1792513005783_style.prompt: 1920s Art Deco fashion illustration, fine pen lines combined with stencil-style color application; lines are long and elegant and garment patterns intricate. The palette centers on lavender, dusk pink, deep green and ivory, with figures often set in strong pure-black and bright-white contrast. Lighting is soft and flattened, with dusky skylight setting the mood. The paper looks aged with slight printing grain. Figures are elongated and gracefully posed, and compositions emphasize foreground, midground and distant silhouette layers, creating an overall romantic, luxurious, retro-modern Jazz Age magazine illustration feel.

1792513005784_style.name: Soft Decorative Flat Gouache Painting
1792513005784_style.prompt: Contemporary decorative flat gouache painting, applied evenly with opaque gouache or acrylic, with crisp edges and patterns detailed in fine brushwork. The palette is soft and refined, built on mint green, pale pink and ivory with accents of cobalt blue and coral red. Lighting is gentle and restrained, with only slight cast shadows and space expressed through flat color shapes. The surface is matte with almost no visible brushstrokes or grain. Compositions are steady and favor deep perspective for layering, rich in decorative motifs, creating an overall tranquil, elegant contemporary figurative painting feel full of everyday poetry.

1792513005785_style.name: 19th-Century Genre Oil Painting
1792513005785_style.prompt: 19th-century realist genre painting in traditional oil on canvas, with loose visible brushwork: distant areas thinly scumbled and scraped, near figures refined with small brushes. Tones are calm and cool, built on gray-white, warm brown, deep green and black with touches of crimson. Light is diffuse overcast light, contrast is gentle and aerial perspective clear. The surface shows aged craquelure and yellowed varnish with fine grain. Compositions spread horizontally, with small figures scattered across open settings, creating an overall classical, quiet, narrative museum-painting feel.

1792513005786_style.name: Victorian Realist Oil Painting
1792513005786_style.prompt: Victorian-era realist oil painting with classical academic technique, brushwork fine and concealed, and a porcelain-smooth surface. Tones lean warm brown and olive gray, with clothing mostly in deep black, wine red and off-white, overall low-saturated with an aged sheen. Light is cloudy skylight, soft and diffused, with heavy voluminous clouds and natural tonal transitions. The surface has slight yellowed varnish and paint grain. Compositions are arranged horizontally, often with figures in rhythmic side-on procession, a low horizon and an open sky, creating an overall solemn, nostalgic, poetic 19th-century narrative painting feel.

1792513005787_style.name: Flat Clear-Line Period Comic
1792513005787_style.prompt: European clear-line comic style, outlined with crisp ink lines of even weight and flat fills with almost no gradients, occasionally using fine hatching to suggest shadow. Tones are warm and retro, built on mustard yellow, olive green, navy and pale pink at low saturation. Lighting is flat, with volume separated by line and color. The paper shows slight printing grain. Characters are realistic with mild exaggeration and carefully rendered period details, mostly framed in eye-level medium narrative shots against simplified period backgrounds, creating an overall dignified, humorous, nostalgic early-20th-century comic feel.

1792513005788_style.name: Dusk Clear-Line European Comic Illustration
1792513005788_style.prompt: European clear-line comic illustration, forms drawn with fine steady ink lines, combining flat color with a little line-based shading and clearly stated details. The palette is a warm dusk scheme, with orange-yellow, dusky pink and gray-blue in warm-cool contrast at soft saturation. Lighting is flat, with large areas of sky color setting the time of day. The paper carries slight printing grain. Compositions are open with deep perspective, clearly layering foreground figures against tiny distant figures, often blending in whimsical elements, with lightly exaggerated cartoon characters, creating an overall romantic, nostalgic European adventure-comic feel with a sense of journey.

1792513005789_style.name: Tonalist Misty Oil Painting
1792513005789_style.prompt: Tonalist oil painting, built mainly with thin washes, glazing and soft-edged blending; forms dissolve at the edges like mist, with brushstrokes barely visible. The palette is near-monochrome in grayish olive green, foggy brown and dark black, extremely low in saturation and highly unified. Light is diffuse skylight in dense fog, with no clear light source or cast shadows and very weak contrast. The surface has fine grain and canvas texture. Compositions are minimal, the subject often isolated at center against an empty blurred background, with depth built through gradual value steps, creating an overall still, melancholic, distant and meditative poetic mood.

1792513005790_style.name: Detailed Pixel Art Bird's-Eye Illustration
1792513005790_style.prompt: Detailed pixel-art illustration, built pixel by pixel at high density with crisp, non-anti-aliased edges, using pixel dithering to express layering and material. Colors are layered emerald and olive greens with off-white and stone gray, bright but not harsh. Light is soft overhead light, with volume and shadows expressed through light and dark pixel steps. The image is clean, with the pixel grain itself forming the texture. Compositions often use high-angle bird's-eye views with orderly perspective and strong depth, and figures stay tiny, creating an overall serene, refined pixel-art feel reminiscent of nostalgic games.

1792513005791_style.name: Gray-Backdrop Needle-Felt Stop-Motion
1792513005791_style.prompt: Needle-felt stop-motion style, shooting physical puppets and props shaped from needle-punched wool, with fluffy fibers clearly visible and rounded, naive forms carrying a hint of quirky eeriness. The palette is natural white, oatmeal beige, light gray and warm brown, low in saturation, clean and understated. Light is soft diffused studio lighting, a single-side key with broad fill and faint shadows. Images show fine fuzzy texture with a slight shallow-focus blur. Compositions are simple, often against a plain gray backdrop with the subject centered at eye level, creating an overall quiet, handmade felt still-life feel with a touch of absurd humor.

1792513005792_style.name: 1970s Faded Warm Film
1792513005792_style.prompt: 1970s faded warm-toned film photography, photorealistic live-action photographic work, emulating old color-negative prints. Tones lean warm yellow-green, reds look muted and blues turn cyan, overall low-saturated and faded, with shadows slightly brownish. Light is strong natural afternoon sun with clear contrast and crisp shadow edges. Film grain is fine, with slight color shifts and gentle softness. Compositions are open, often leaving large areas of sky and horizon, with figures casual and natural in the distance like a travel snapshot, creating an overall nostalgic, relaxed retro documentary feel full of summer memories.

1792513005793_style.name: Limited-Color Retro Lithograph Decorative Illustration
1792513005793_style.prompt: Early-20th-century retro lithographic decorative illustration, pen line work combined with limited-color overprinting; lines are clean and fluid and forms simplified and flattened. Only a few colors are used — vermilion orange-red, deep green, warm beige and light gray — with a dominant color highlighting the focal point. Lighting is flat with almost no volumetric rendering, layers separated by color blocks and lines. The paper is yellowed, with subtle printing screen texture and slight misregistration. Compositions are elegant, often framed by geometric structures and decorative elements, with elongated figure silhouettes, creating an overall refined, nostalgic poster-illustration feel bridging Art Nouveau and Art Deco.

1792513005794_style.name: 1950s Low-Key Color Melodrama
1792513005794_style.prompt: 1950s Hollywood color melodrama film style, photorealistic live-action photographic work, emulating the rich color of vintage dye-transfer film. Tones center on warm amber, gray-blue and pinkish skin tones, with deep cyan-leaning shadows and full but not garish saturation. Lighting is a low-key interior setup, with warm practical lamps and a soft key light carefully lifting faces while backgrounds sink into shadow. Film grain is fine with a slight soft-focus glow. Medium close-up two-shots and shallow depth of field are favored, with restrained, heartfelt performances, creating an overall romantic, ambiguous classic-Hollywood noir-melodrama feel.

1792513005795_style.name: Golden Low-Sun Staged Photography
1792513005795_style.prompt: Staged narrative photography, photorealistic live-action photographic work, each frame like a meticulously arranged film still. Tones contrast rich dusk gold with deep cobalt blue, highly saturated, clean and intense. Light is very low-angle golden side light from the setting sun, rimming figures, stretching shadows and keeping detail in the darks. Film grain is fine and the image sharp. Compositions line figures up horizontally as if frozen in a row against simple, geometric backgrounds, shot at eye level or slightly lower, creating an overall eerie, still narrative image with a surreal sense of detachment.

1792513005796_style.name: 1980s Flash Family Snapshot
1792513005796_style.prompt: 1980s family snapshot photography, photorealistic live-action photographic work, emulating old prints shot with a point-and-shoot camera's direct on-camera flash. Tones lean warm pink-yellow, reds are strong and whites slightly yellowed, with moderate saturation and a faded-print feel. Light is frontal direct flash, making subjects bright and flat, casting hard shadows on the wall behind and letting the background fall off quickly. Film grain is visible, sharpness modest, with occasional red-eye and blown highlights. Colors are warm and bright, centered on wood brown, grass green, sky blue and true red at moderate, clear saturation. Light is clear afternoon sun with gentle shadows and an airy feel. Backgrounds carry hand-painted brushwork and paper texture, characters crisp and clean. Compositions are steady and eye-level, layering detailed foregrounds with open distant views, characters natural in demeanor, creating an overall warm, leisurely classic hand-drawn animation feel full of everyday life.

1792513005844_style.name: Foam-Head Knitted Puppet Stop-Motion
1792513005844_style.prompt: Knitted-yarn puppet stop-motion style, physical handmade puppets shot frame by frame; heads are sculpted from matte sponge or foam, while hats, clothing and moustaches are knitted from chunky yarn with clearly countable stitches. Colors center on saturated moss green, brick orange and skin pink against clean solid-color backdrops. Soft frontal studio lighting with faint shadows. Fuzzy fibers and small imperfections keep a handmade warmth; compositions favor centered frontal half-body framing with deadpan, understated expressions. Overall it presents a rustic, humorous, warmly handcrafted yarn stop-motion look.

1792513005845_style.name: Retro Fisheye Wide-Angle Cinema
1792513005845_style.prompt: 1970s retro cinema style, live-action realism, photographic work, making heavy use of fisheye and ultra-wide lenses with pronounced barrel distortion at the edges, often framed from a high, centered overhead angle. Tones are mainly creamy off-white and warm brown with orange-red accents, low in saturation, with soft film grain and a slight vignette. Lighting comes from soft interior overhead light and practical lamps, with gentle tonal transitions. Deep depth of field, richly detailed yet orderly set dressing, and a hint of quirky retro-futurism. Overall it presents an odd, lonely yet meticulous auteur-film feel.

1792513005846_style.name: 1980s Direct-Flash Snapshot
1792513005846_style.prompt: 1980s–90s film snapshot style, live-action realism, photographic work, shot with an on-camera direct flash so the subject is lit head-on while the background falls quickly into darkness; skin looks slightly pale and lips vivid. Colors run warm with high contrast, shadows carry magenta and brown casts, with obvious film grain and slight soft focus. Cluttered frames and casual, grab-shot compositions with moderate depth of field, plus the fading and light leaks of vintage prints. Overall it presents an intimate, nostalgic, slightly decadent everyday snapshot from another era.

1792513005847_style.name: Fine-Hatched Contemporary Comic Illustration
1792513005847_style.prompt: Contemporary realist comic illustration style, digitally hand-drawn, with fine, crisp ink lines defining figure structure and abundant hatching and cross-hatching building volume in folds and shadows; proportions are realistic and faces finely detailed. Large areas of saturated red contrast with cool grey, off-white and teal, using flat fills with subtle gradients. Lighting is split into clear hard-edged light and shadow, with highlights left as bare paper. The surface carries faint print halftone dots and grain; compositions lean toward cinematic medium close-ups. Overall it presents a mature, restrained, emotionally rich contemporary comic image.

1792513005848_style.name: Neon Goth Dark Cartoon
1792513005848_style.prompt: Dark gothic cartoon animation style, 2D digital drawing with bold black outlines and simplified shapes; characters have huge eyes with glowing pupils, exaggerated startled expressions and skinny builds. Colors sit on a deep blue-black base, with large clashes of magenta and neon cyan artificial light at high saturation. Shading is flat, overlaid with strong colored light from screens and lamps, edges wrapped in glow. Clean surfaces with little grain, backgrounds crammed with clutter and posters, mostly interior medium shots. Overall it presents an eerie, gloomy yet humorous neon-goth cartoon mood.

1792513005849_style.name: Aged Surreal Photomontage
1792513005849_style.prompt: Surreal vintage photomontage style, combining digital photo compositing with painting; realistic fragments of portraits are fused illogically with landscapes, buildings and other elements, the seams blended by clouds and mist. Tones are desaturated grey-green, ink blue and dark brown with only a few red and white accents. Lighting is somber and soft with dramatic local highlights. The surface is covered in heavy distressed scratches, mold spots and coarse grain like an old print; compositions are mostly symmetrical and frontal. Overall it presents a nightmarishly uncanny, oppressive yet poetic surreal horror atmosphere.

1792513005850_style.name: Warm Brown Symmetrical Indie Film
1792513005850_style.prompt: Contemporary indie film style, live-action realism, photographic work, favoring symmetrical, centered frontal compositions with the subject on the central axis and neatly layered foreground and background. Tones are mainly warm brown, amber, caramel and olive green at moderate saturation, with vintage film color. Light comes from diffused daylight through windows combined with warm interior pendant lamps, soft and even with mellow shadows. Fine film grain and a slight glow, moderate depth of field, rich yet tidy detail. Overall it presents a warm, quiet, bookish indie-film feel.

1792513005851_style.name: Purple-Blue Night City Pop Animation
1792513005851_style.prompt: Retro Japanese city-pop animation style, 2D digital drawing with thin, crisp lines, cel-style flat color and hard-edged shadows; faces are simple with melancholy eyes. The palette is dominated by deep purple and indigo, accented by pink and warm yellow neon signs and window light, saturated yet dark overall. Lighting contrasts night ambient light with local neon color. Smooth, clean surfaces with slight grain; street-level medium close-ups and low angles, with power lines and signboards building depth. Overall it presents a lonely, nostalgic, lo-fi-music-like urban night mood.

1792513005852_style.name: Damp Faded Nostalgic Film
1792513005852_style.prompt: Nostalgic film photography style, live-action realism, photographic work, with low-saturation, faded colors dominated by grey-green, misty white and warm brown, with only sparse touches of red. Light is soft overcast daylight diffused through windows; haze turns the distance pale and blurry while interior shadows stay deep but readable. Obvious film grain and slight color casts give a damp, hazy feel. Compositions lean toward still-life and empty-frame eye-level views, layering from a dark foreground to a bright exterior. Overall it presents a quiet, damp, faintly melancholic sense of bygone days.

1792513005853_style.name: 1980s Urban Cel Animation
1792513005853_style.prompt: 1980s Japanese urban-drama TV animation style, traditional hand-painted cels with clean, even lines; characters have long, sharp eyes, simplified noses and lips, and clearly blocked hair strands. Colors are bright and mostly flat, shadows limited to one or two hard-edged tones, backgrounds often a single color or simple blocks. Lighting is minimal, with highlights dotted in as white shapes. Slight film grain and the softness of old video; compositions mostly side-by-side medium close-ups. Overall it presents a stylish, cool, urban-romance retro animation feel.

1792513005854_style.name: Pastel Dreamy Retro Fashion Photography
1792513005854_style.prompt: 1970s–80s retro fashion photography style, live-action realism, photographic work, placing subjects before painted-looking skies or backdrops for a contrast between realism and staging. Tones are peach pink, rose and pale lavender blue, saturated yet soft and warm overall. Lighting is soft frontal studio light with slight soft focus and glow. Fine film grain and natural skin texture; compositions are mostly centered frontal full or half-body shots, poses relaxed yet ceremonial. Overall it presents a dreamy, romantic, slightly absurd retro fashion-magazine look.

1792513005855_style.name: Blue-Hour Dark Minimalist Photography
1792513005855_style.prompt: Minimalist low-key photography style, live-action realism, photographic work, framing the image with large areas of deep black and leaving a single blue-toned bright zone as the visual center. Colors are nearly monochrome—deep indigo, steel blue and grey-blue—at low saturation. Light is faint dusk or dawn skylight, high contrast with heavy shadows and crisp reflections and silhouettes. Smooth, fine texture with minimal grain; level, orderly compositions with ample negative space and clean lines. Overall it presents a still, solitary, cold and profound blue-hour atmosphere.

1792513005856_style.name: Teal-Orange Clash Retro Film
1792513005856_style.prompt: 1970s retro film style, live-action realism, photographic work, built on saturated color clashes: teal and lake-blue walls set off orange-red and brick-red costumes and props. Lighting is soft interior side light with warm shadows and slightly ruddy skin. Obvious film grain and slight soft focus, with shallow depth of field blurring the foreground. Compositions favor slightly low-angle close and medium shots, set dressing busy, vintage and playful, characters deadpan and eccentric. Overall it presents a witty, nostalgic, quirky-comedy retro film feel.

1792513005857_style.name: Warm Window-Light Film Documentary
1792513005857_style.prompt: Contemporary film documentary photography style, live-action realism, photographic work, using low-angle warm sunlight pouring through large windows as the key light, creating bright patches, light shafts and backlit outlines while the rest of the room sinks into soft shadow. Tones are warm gold, cream white and wood brown at moderate saturation. Fine film grain, gentle halation and lens flare. Wide-angle, eye-level environmental portraits with the subject centered amid naturally messy everyday surroundings and deep depth of field. Overall it presents a warm, intimate, tranquil slice-of-life documentary feel.

1792513005858_style.name: Cyan-Magenta Overexposed Film
1792513005858_style.prompt: 1990s faded film photography style, live-action realism, photographic work, where strong window sunlight causes broad overexposure and blooming highlights that turn pale and cyan. Colors carry pronounced cyan and magenta casts, shadows lean purple, saturation uneven. Light passing through blinds forms striped patterns with strong backlight. Coarse grain, low sharpness, halation and slight light leaks; compositions are casual high-angle downward shots with objects filling the frame. Overall it presents a hazy, nostalgic, sun-glared old-film memory.

1792513005859_style.name: Blue-Pink Flat Minimalist Illustration
1792513005859_style.prompt: Minimalist flat illustration style, digitally hand-painted to mimic gouache; forms are highly simplified with almost no outlines, the image built from a few large areas of solid color whose edges keep a slightly irregular hand-painted feel. Colors center on rich deep blue and grey-blue against pale pink and coral red, with clear contrast. No obvious lighting; space is separated only by the value of color blocks. Subtle paper grain on the surface; calm, open compositions with generous negative space, simplified perspective and naive repeating patterns. Overall it presents a quiet, languid, holiday-like contemporary flat painting feel.

1792513005860_style.name: Plaster-Textured Symmetrical Stage Illustration
1792513005860_style.prompt: Relief-textured illustration style, digitally painted with simple, orderly forms; elements such as clouds and plants carry thick grain and raised, plaster-like texture, as if hand-sculpted and then painted. Colors are mainly lake blue, dusty pink, dark green and beige, vintage and soft. Lighting is even and flat with only faint volume shadows. Fine noise and rough surface texture cover the whole image; compositions favor symmetrical, frontal stage-set framing with a flat, theater-like space. Overall it presents a quiet, quirky, miniature-model-like retro fairy-tale atmosphere.

1792513005861_style.name: Bold Ink-Line Retro Flat Illustration
1792513005861_style.prompt: Retro bold ink-line flat illustration style, digitally drawn to evoke woodcut and screen printing, with heavy, fluid black outlines defining forms and shadows rendered as solid black shapes. A limited vintage palette sits on olive and greyish dark green, accented with vermilion, tangerine and mustard yellow. Lighting is simple, using black-and-light block contrast to create a nocturnal mood. Flat color fills without gradients and slight print grain; airy compositions with strong silhouettes. Overall it presents a languid, mysterious, literary retro graphic illustration feel.

1792513005862_style.name: Folk Surrealist Wash Illustration
1792513005862_style.prompt: Folk surrealist picture-book illustration style, hand-painted in mixed watercolor and gouache with naive, economical lines; figures are elongated with exaggerated proportions, and elements of mismatched scale are often placed side by side. Colors are beige, dusty pink, faded red and grey-green, low in saturation and mellow. Lighting is very faint, relying almost entirely on flat color and light shading. Visible paper grain and watery blooms; compositions are mostly eye-level horizontal spreads with figures parallel to building facades. Overall it presents a quiet, witty, fable-like surreal atmosphere.

1792513005863_style.name: Blue with Warm Accents Modern Picture Book
1792513005863_style.prompt: Modern children's picture-book illustration style, digitally painted to mimic layered colored pencil and gouache; characters have round faces, big eyes and noticeable blush, with soft linework. Large areas of blue and indigo dominate, with small highlights of mustard yellow and warm orange for strong warm-cool contrast. Lighting mixes warm light from windows with cool interior ambient light. Fine grain and paper texture cover the image, edges may carry a torn-paper border; compositions often pair a foreground character close-up with a background crowd. Overall it presents a delicate, gentle, slightly uneasy modern picture-book feel.

1792513005864_style.name: Night Street Motion-Blur Film Snapshot
1792513005864_style.prompt: Night street film snapshot style, live-action realism, photographic work, using slow shutter speeds and casual panning so people and vehicles show strong motion blur and streaks. Tones are mainly amber yellow and orange-brown with teal signage accents and deep shadows. All light comes from streetlamps, headlights and shop lightboxes, highlights blooming outward. Heavy film grain and loose focus; casual tilted framing with subjects often cut by the edges. Overall it presents a hurried, weary, lonely yet romantic urban night feel.

1792513005865_style.name: Slow-Shutter Urban Documentary
1792513005865_style.prompt: Urban street documentary photography style, live-action realism, photographic work, shooting from a high angle with a slow shutter so moving crowds dissolve into ghostly blurs while a single subject stays relatively sharp. Tones are cool and desaturated—charcoal, black and off-white—with one saturated warm color as the focal point. Lighting is even overcast diffuse light with moderate contrast. Fine grain; graphic road markings and dense crowds create rhythm. Overall it presents a detached, hurried urban loneliness where the individual is swallowed by the crowd.

1792513005866_style.name: Grainy Black-and-White Close-Up Film
1792513005866_style.prompt: Black-and-white film close-up photography style, live-action realism, photographic work, using macro or extremely close framing focused on details such as eyes and skin texture, with shallow depth of field melting the rest into soft blur. Pure monochrome with a rich grey scale and delicate midtones. Soft side lighting leaves one side bright and the other in shadow. Pronounced coarse film grain covers the frame, with a slight softness like old disc video; bold cropping and partial occlusion. Overall it presents an intimate, gazing, art-house poetic image quality.

1792513005867_style.name: Action-Cam Fisheye Selfie
1792513005867_style.prompt: Action-camera fisheye selfie style, live-action realism, photographic work, shot with an ultra-wide fisheye lens right up against the subject so the nearest parts are hugely magnified and the surroundings curve outward. Colors are natural and slightly cool at moderate saturation, with everyday outdoor white balance. Lighting is natural daytime diffuse light with even exposure. Crisp, sharp digital image with slight compression noise; compositions are mainly low-angle upward shots or in-your-face close-ups with exaggerated perspective. Overall it presents a lively, comical, highly immersive casual selfie-video feel.

1792513005868_style.name: Newspaper Comic Strip Cartoon
1792513005868_style.prompt: Newspaper comic-strip cartoon style, 2D hand-drawn with black ink lines of slightly varying weight and a loose, sketchy wobble; characters have big noses, round eyes and spiky, messy hair, with exaggerated, simplified proportions. Colors are bright flat fills of sky blue, grass green and brick orange at moderate saturation. Lighting is barely drawn, with only a little hatching to suggest texture. Clean linework with white space and a printed-comic feel; compositions are mostly wide horizontal group shots. Overall it presents the relaxed, humorous, everyday-adventure charm of classic newspaper comics.

1792513005869_style.name: Pastel Chalk on Dark Paper
1792513005869_style.prompt: Soft pastel and chalk illustration style, rubbed onto dark paper with short, rough, fuzzy-edged strokes that let the paper show through. Deep ink green and near-black form the base, layered with saturated cobalt blue, vermilion, bright yellow and pinkish white for strong contrast. Lighting is simplified, with volume read through color value. Pronounced grain and powdery texture, fluffy like a rug; forms are naive and rounded, compositions eye-level with centered subjects. Overall it presents a gentle, innocent, handmade childhood-memory atmosphere.

1792513005870_style.name: Dark-Ground Rough Naive Illustration
1792513005870_style.prompt: Naive rough-brush character illustration style, with a hand-made look mixing gouache and charcoal; forms are exaggerated and distorted, with big noses, dot eyes, and hair built up from scribbled thick black lines. A near-black background sets off flesh pink, pink, vermilion orange and grey-blue in flat fills. Almost no realistic lighting—only blush and color blocks separate volume. Coarse strokes, ragged edges and paper grain; compositions are mainly big-head close-ups with full, frame-filling subjects. Overall it presents a humorous, absurd, slightly melancholy handmade picture-book feel.

1792513005871_style.name: Ochre-Orange Impasto Oil Texture
1792513005871_style.prompt: Impasto oil texture style, with thick paint built up by palette knife and short strokes so the background is full of raised texture, while figures are rendered in smoother color blocks and simple outlines, contrasting flatness with impasto. Colors are ochre orange, rust red, off-white and burnt brown in a unified warm key, with black branch-like lines dividing the picture. Lighting is subdued, expressed mainly through color temperature and value. Strong paint materiality and decorative, flat arrangements. Overall it presents a rich autumnal, warm yet slightly wistful hand-painted oil feel.

1792513005872_style.name: Gold-Dust Fine-Line Decorative Illustration
1792513005872_style.prompt: Decorative mythic narrative illustration style, digitally drawn, using fine parallel and radiating lines to form textures of feathers, waves and rays, with fluid, elegant, rhythmic contours. Deep indigo and midnight purple form the base, set off by rose pink, coral pink and ivory, sprinkled with glittering fine gold dust. Lighting uses radiating rays and gold highlights to create a sacred feel. Subtle paper texture and gold-leaf grain on the surface; sweeping compositions with strong diagonal tension. Overall it presents a lavish, romantic, epic decorative picture-book beauty.

1792513005873_style.name: Star-Chart Psychedelic Visionary Art
1792513005873_style.prompt: Psychedelic visionary art style, combining digital painting and collage, with the image built from star points, constellation lines, radiating rays and geometric rings; figures dissolve translucently into nebulae. Pure black forms the ground, spread with glowing fluorescent blue, violet, magenta and golden orange at high saturation. All light comes from self-luminous stars and rays, with strong cross-shaped star flares and glow. Fine, glittering texture; compositions are mostly radial from the center or symmetrical diptychs. Overall it presents a mysterious, sacred, cosmic-meditation spiritual atmosphere.

1792513005874_style.name: Retro Airbrush Grainy Glamour Illustration
1792513005874_style.prompt: Retro airbrush illustration style, digitally painted to mimic 1980s airbrush art, shaping forms with smooth color fields and soft gradients, simple contours and almost no outlines; characters have long, narrow eyes and heavy red-lipped makeup. Colors are deep purple, magenta, dark green and cool pink, saturated yet shadowy. Lighting is soft gradient shading, edges melting naturally into the background. Fine noise grain covers the whole image; compositions often use bold cropping of large shapes and profile close-ups. Overall it presents a cold, mysterious, retro-glamorous fashion-illustration air.

1792513005875_style.name: Color-Clash Minimalist Surreal 3D Animation
1792513005875_style.prompt: Minimalist surreal 3D animation style, CG-rendered, with highly simplified, geometric character designs and smooth matte surfaces contrasting against dense, fluffy foliage volumes. Colors are unnatural, highly saturated clashes—cobalt blue skies with fluorescent pink, magenta and violet. Lighting is strong side-backlight that gives foliage edges a glowing rim. Clean images with little noise and soft depth of field; compositions with lots of empty space and isolated subjects. Overall it presents a strange, quiet, absurdly humorous dreamlike atmosphere.

1792513005876_style.name: Shin-Hanga Ukiyo-e Woodblock
1792513005876_style.prompt: Japanese shin-hanga woodblock style, digitally imitating multi-block color printing, with concise shapes and fine lines outlining landscape forms and slight registration offsets between color areas. Colors include sunset gradients of orange-red and pink-violet, deep indigo mountain shadows and teal-blue water, the gradients soft like brushed woodblock color. Lighting conveys time of day through the contrast of sky and reflections. Wood grain and paper fiber cover the surface, with optional beige margins and a seal; compositions are horizontal landscapes. Overall it presents a tranquil, far-reaching, poetic East Asian print sensibility.

1792513005877_style.name: Cold Grey Black-and-White Auteur Film
1792513005877_style.prompt: Black-and-white auteur film style, live-action realism, photographic work, purely monochrome and lit mainly by soft overcast diffuse light, with a rich grey scale, medium-to-high contrast and deep shadows. It favors low-angle upward shots and symmetrical, stable framing, setting figures in graphic contrast against large natural lines or architectural structures. Fine film grain and slight soft focus with deep depth of field; calm, restrained compositions with ample negative space. Overall it presents a detached, mysterious, allegorical noir atmosphere.

1792513005878_style.name: Cobalt Black-White Minimal Graphic
1792513005878_style.prompt: Minimalist graphic illustration style, digitally drawn, composing the image from large geometric color blocks and silhouettes with extremely reduced forms and no detailing. Colors are strictly limited to pure black, pure white and saturated cobalt blue for extreme contrast. Positive and negative shapes of silhouettes and blocks replace tonal shading. Some areas carry rough noise and torn, grainy edges; compositions are concise and forceful, often centered on a huge circle or geometric form with tiny figures. Overall it presents a lonely, stark, symbolic modern-poster feel.

1792513005879_style.name: Candlelit Blue-Haze Fantasy Film
1792513005879_style.prompt: 1980s fantasy film style, live-action realism, photographic work, with warm candlelight illuminating faces, shoulders and necks while the background is shrouded in cool blue haze for a vivid warm-cool contrast. Colors are amber, orange-gold and floral reds against deep blue-grey, rich and saturated. Light is soft with glow and light mist scatter, shadows mellow. Fine film grain and slight soft focus, shallow depth of field with blurred foliage often in the foreground; romantic, ornate compositions. Overall it presents a dreamy, mysterious, aesthetic retro fantasy feel.

1792513005880_style.name: Teal-Crimson Line Cartoon Illustration
1792513005880_style.prompt: European line-drawn cartoon illustration style, 2D digital drawing with fine brown-black lines of slight hand-drawn variation; characters have exaggerated, rotund bodies, and interior furnishings and textile patterns are densely detailed. Compositions are usually complete interior medium shots full of lived-in detail. Overall it presents a cozy, languid, humorous European cartoon image.

1792513005881_style.name: Orange Paper-Texture Naive Flat Style
1792513005881_style.prompt: Naive paper-textured flat illustration style, digitally made to mimic gouache cut-outs; forms are highly simplified, figures built from long color strips and circles, features merely dotted in with fine lines. A minimal palette floods the background with rich orange, paired with vermilion orange, black and grey-violet in a unified, intense key. Almost no lighting, with only simple value shifts around light sources such as fire. Coarse-fibered handmade paper texture covers the image; compositions are mostly horizontal rows of figures in repeating rhythm. Overall it presents a rustic, ritualistic yet humorous folk-fable atmosphere.

1792513005882_style.name: Outline-Free Solid Color Flat Style
1792513005882_style.prompt: Contemporary pop flat illustration style, digitally drawn with no outlines at all, forms assembled directly from clean solid color blocks with crisp edges and extremely simplified detail. Colors are high-saturation clashes, mainly bright blue and rose pink, with rainbow-like touches of bright yellow, green and red. No lighting and no gradients—layers are separated only by darker and lighter blocks. Smooth, clean surfaces; bold cropping with subjects filling the frame. Overall it presents a light, bright, emotionally charged contemporary graphic-art feel.

1792513005883_style.name: Grainy Soft-Light Flat Illustration
1792513005883_style.prompt: Grain-textured flat character illustration style, digitally drawn with simple forms and very few outlines; faces are modeled with smooth color blocks and soft gradients, eyes long and narrow, blush clearly diffused. Fine noise grain and paper texture cover the image; compositions are mostly half-length or over-the-shoulder glances with ample negative space. Overall it presents a quiet, cool, reserved East Asian girlish temperament.

1792513005884_style.name: 1970s Hyperreal Airbrush Illustration
1792513005884_style.prompt: 1970s hyperrealist airbrush illustration style, digitally painted to mimic airbrush and oil, with figures and settings rendered in precise, lifelike detail and photo-smooth transitions. Lighting is strong, hard side light with sharp contrast and crisp cast shadows for a stage-like drama. Fine print grain; compositions often group figures in clearly layered arrangements. Overall it presents a mysterious, lavish, fashion-editorial retro surreal air.

1792513005885_style.name: Nostalgic Grey-Tone Antique Photograph
1792513005885_style.prompt: Late-19th-century antique documentary photograph style, live-action realism, photographic work, in monochrome grey with a slight brown tint, delicate grey scale and soft, pale highlights. Visible silver-halide grain, light scratches and old photo-paper texture with slightly darkened edges. Deep depth of field and rich detail; eye-level interior medium shots with naturally still poses and elaborate furnishings. Overall it presents a calm, weighty, period-steeped historical image atmosphere.

1792513005886_style.name: Dusk Side-Backlit Film Portrait
1792513005886_style.prompt: Film portrait photography style, live-action realism, photographic work, with low-angle warm golden dusk light from the side and behind catching faces and hair in a soft rim, while the background sinks into cool blue twilight. Compositions are mostly off-center medium close-ups leaving space, expressions introspective. Overall it presents a dreamy, tranquil, faintly sorrowful emotional portrait feel.

1792513005887_style.name: Teal Cross-Processed Retro Film
1792513005887_style.prompt: Retro cross-processed film style, live-action realism, photographic work, with an overall teal-green cast, yellowish highlights and dark green shadows, skin tones pushed into an unusual mix of warm and cool. Compositions often use foreground occlusion and peeking-through-a-doorway framing with shallow depth of field. Overall it presents a mysterious, tense, suspenseful retro thriller feel.

1792513005888_style.name: Grey Solitary Surreal Photography
1792513005888_style.prompt: Surrealist cinematic photography style, live-action realism, photographic work, with nearly desaturated color—grey-white, grey-brown and grey-green—keeping only one small warm red light source as the focal point. Empty, stable compositions with a low horizon and subjects isolated in vast space, often using figures seen from behind and symmetrical elements. Overall it presents a lonely, detached, dreamlike and uncanny surreal atmosphere.

1792513005889_style.name: Warm-Lit Fine-Line Fantasy Adventure Comic
1792513005889_style.prompt: Western fantasy adventure comic illustration style, digitally hand-drawn with dense, crisp ink lines defining rocks, buildings and figures, shadows reinforced with hatching and heavy black shapes. Overall it presents an expansive, romantic, adventure-filled fantasy comic image.

1792513005890_style.name: Fluorescent Inflatable Tube 3D Render
1792513005890_style.prompt: Abstract inflatable 3D render style, CG-rendered, with forms made of spheres and curving tubes intertwined, plump and rounded like balloons or inflatable toys. Colors are fluorescent yellow-green, mint green, cherry-blossom pink and pale blue set before a saturated blue-violet solid backdrop. Lighting is soft studio light with rounded highlights and gentle shadows. Clean, grain-free surfaces with the subject floating at center. Overall it presents a light, playful, dreamy trendy visual feel.

1792513005891_style.name: Retro Fantasy Film Set
1792513005891_style.prompt: 1980s fantasy film style, live-action realism, photographic work, with a retro set-built look blending practical construction and matte painting; environments are lush and slightly theatrical. Lighting is strongly chiaroscuro, warm local light picking out the subject while the surroundings sink into darkness, under dramatic cloudy skies. Fine film grain and dense color; compositions with clearly layered foreground, midground and background. Overall it presents a mysterious, lavish, dreamlike classical fantasy epic feel.

1792513005892_style.name: Folk-Pattern Flat Animation Illustration
1792513005892_style.prompt: 2D animation illustration style, digitally drawn with clean, fluid dark linework; characters have big eyes and lively expressions, with a touch of Western-animation exaggeration. Shading is soft two-tone flat color with slight brush texture. Backgrounds are richly detailed and full of objects; compositions are mostly interior medium shots. Overall it presents a warm, nostalgic, fairy-tale folk animation image.

1792513005893_style.name: Dense Colored-Pencil Dreamscape Illustration
1792513005893_style.prompt: Dense colored-pencil texture illustration style, built from layer upon layer of colored pencil hatching with short, tightly packed, flowing strokes that form a fine, fabric-like texture.
