1792513005989_style.prompt: Colorful flat cut-paper illustration style, 2D. Rounded organic silhouette shapes are flat-filled and pieced together like paper collage, with no outlines, elements repeated in simplified decorative forms. Colors are highly saturated and bright—orange-red, bright yellow, emerald, pink and sky blue boldly juxtaposed, the sky in a soft blue-pink gradient. No realistic lighting, completely flat, depth separated by overlapping color layers. Fine risograph-like grain. Compositions are symmetrical and full, foreground elements stacked in layers around a central focal point. Overall it delivers a cheerful, vibrant, decorative poster-like mood.

1792513005990_style.name: Pink-Gold Warm Vintage Period-Drama Film
1792513005990_style.prompt: Vintage period-drama film photography style, live-action realism, photographic work with the color-shifted texture of old color film. Pink, rose gold and golden straw tones dominate, the distance tinted pink-violet and shadows touched with teal, soft and slightly dreamlike overall. Lighting is low-angle natural side light, highlights blooming into soft glow, shadows delicate. Film grain, slight light leaks, vignetting and worn edges. Shallow depth of field; figures are often shown in medium shots standing side-on within open natural surroundings. Overall it delivers a nostalgic, romantic cinematic mood with a sense of period storytelling.

1792513005991_style.name: Loose Line Comic Illustration on White
1792513005991_style.prompt: Loose hand-drawn line comic illustration style, 2D. Thin, casual black lines sketched quickly, slightly shaky and broken; characters are simplified with messy hair and exaggerated, humorous expressions. Coloring is partial flat fill, vivid blocks such as pure red and warm yellow on only a few elements, the rest left as line art on white. No modeling; emotion shown through motion lines and small symbols. Clean with a slight hand-drawn feel. Compositions are horizontal and eye-level with ample white space and everyday props scattered casually. Overall it delivers a relaxed, witty, slightly self-deprecating everyday comic mood.

1792513005992_style.name: Black-and-White Minimalist Epic Spectacle Imagery
1792513005992_style.prompt: Black-and-white minimalist spectacle imagery, live-action realism, photographic work with a refined monochrome art texture. Pure black and white: sky and ground are broad bright gray-whites, structures and figures deep black silhouettes, with very few midtones and crisp contrast. Lighting is high-key diffuse light with almost no shadows, forms expressed by silhouette contours. Fine, clean image with slight grain. Compositions are simple and monumental, towering subjects and tiny figures, large negative space and a low horizon establishing scale. Overall it delivers a solemn, mysterious, surreal mood with an epic, allegorical feel.

1792513005993_style.name: Natural-Light Documentary Color Film
1792513005993_style.prompt: Documentary color film photography style, live-action realism, photographic work with the plain texture of consumer film. Colors are natural and slightly faded—brick brown, wood tones, gray blue and warm white at low saturation. Lighting is natural daylight slanting in through windows, bright patches on the floor while the rest of the space stays softly dim. Visible film grain, slight softness and a mild color cast in the shadows. Wide-angle framing, often from above or at an observational distance, figures small and absorbed in their own activity, unposed, with rich authentic surroundings. Overall it delivers a quiet, truthful, nostalgically warm everyday documentary mood.

1792513005994_style.name: Soft-Glow Felt Miniature Diorama
1792513005994_style.prompt: Felted-wool miniature diorama stop-motion style; sets and props are hand-needled from wool with visible fluffy fibers and soft, rounded, toy-like forms. Palette of gentle pastels such as mint teal and peach-coral, low in saturation and warm. Warm practical lights give a soft glow over even, diffused ambient light. Macro lens with shallow depth of field and strong foreground and background blur conveys a tabletop-miniature scale. Overall a gentle, healing, fairy-tale world of handcrafted felt miniatures.

1792513005995_style.name: Painterly Vintage Cinematic Realism
1792513005995_style.prompt: Vintage realist cinematic style, live-action photorealistic photography with a subtle oil-paint-like brush texture and painterly color treatment. Muted earth tones of umber, olive green and slate blue, accented by warm orange firelight. Overcast natural diffused light combined with warm practical sources, with soft tonal transitions. Rugged, rich material detail: leather, metal, wood and hair feel tactile, with fine film grain. Mid-shot narrative compositions with moderate depth of field and dense environmental detail. Overall a rugged, weighty, lived-in vintage film feel.

1792513005996_style.name: Misty Cold-Blue Out-of-Focus Imagery
1792513005996_style.prompt: Misty atmospheric imagery style, live-action photography that uses defocus, soft focus and motion blur to dissolve detail, putting mood ahead of sharpness. A tightly restricted, almost monochrome palette of cold blue and gray-cyan at low saturation. Light is skylight scattered through dense fog with no clear source; contrast is very weak and the distance fades away layer by layer. Noticeable grain and low-definition texture, like old digital footage or rephotographed film. Compositions leave large empty areas, with figures appearing as silhouettes or blurred outlines. Overall a lonely, sleepwalking, half-real cold-toned atmosphere.

1792513005997_style.name: Vivid Fauvist Flat-Paint Style
1792513005997_style.prompt: Fauvist painting style, hand-painted in thick oil or acrylic with bold, loose, directional brushstrokes; forms are highly simplified with flat, decorative outlines. Intense, non-naturalistic color: pink, cobalt blue, lemon yellow, vermilion and grass green laid side by side in large areas with strong complementary clashes. Lighting ignores realistic shading, using warm and cool color patches in place of volume. Paint buildup and brush marks stay visible, keeping the handmade texture. Flattened composition with casual perspective and abundant decorative patterning. Overall a fiery, bright, emotionally subjective Fauvist color image.

1792513005998_style.name: High-Gloss Glazed Sculpture
1792513005998_style.prompt: High-gloss sculpture rendering style: 3D-modeled forms rendered to look like porcelain or resin sculpture, with smooth, rounded, slightly exaggerated shapes that feel lifelike yet artificial. Soft pastel gradients of skin pink, pale violet and gray-blue blend naturally across the surfaces. Soft studio lighting creates crisp highlights and specular reflections with gentle shadows. Glazed, lacquered or ceramic materials carry a faint vintage print grain. Clean compositions on plain or light-gray backgrounds put the sculptural subject first. Overall a refined, quiet and slightly uncanny glazed-sculpture beauty.

1792513005999_style.name: Dreamy Morning-Backlight Cinematic Style
1792513005999_style.prompt: Dreamlike realist cinematic style, live-action photography with a strong cinematic, theatrical flair. Creamy white and warm gold dominate, with cyan-blue in the shadows for a soft warm-cool contrast. Strong side backlight streams through windows, producing god rays, dappled light and blooming highlights with slight local overexposure. Film grain, gentle halation and light leaks give a soft, silky texture. Wide or medium framing with shallow depth of field, dust seemingly floating in the air. Overall a warm, languid, dreamlike immersive cinematic atmosphere.

1792513006000_style.name: Retro Cel-Shaded Night Animation
1792513006000_style.prompt: Traditional cel animation style, hand-drawn 2D built from clean outlines and large flat color areas, with simplified, decorative forms and the feel of vintage animation background art. A base of deep teal-blue and dark green night tones, punctuated by saturated burgundy and warm orange patches. Dramatic lighting sets large silhouettes against pockets of warm light for a strong mood. Smooth, clean surfaces with stacked foreground, midground and background planes. Grand compositions framed by foreground silhouettes, with clear depth. Overall a mysterious, romantic, richly atmospheric retro animated nightscape.

1792513006001_style.name: Early Sepia Photograph Style
1792513006001_style.prompt: Early vintage photograph style, live-action photography imitating black-and-white and sepia prints from the early twentieth century. Nearly monochrome color in sepia, taupe and off-white, with no vivid hues. Natural diffused daylight with fairly strong contrast and brooding shadows. Clear marks of age, including grain, soft focus, scratches, dust and fading, with slight edge vignetting. Mostly fixed-camera, eye-level wide or medium shots with stiff, still poses. Overall an antique, silent atmosphere of a bygone era with a hint of the uncanny.

1792513006002_style.name: Sweet Pastel Pop Surrealism
1792513006002_style.prompt: Pop-surrealist painting style, rendered in fine acrylic or digital painting with smooth transitions and almost invisible brushwork; figures have idealized proportions and delicate, doll-like features. A pastel palette of candy pink, cream yellow and pale blue, often on large flat pink backgrounds. Soft, even lighting with light shadows and delicate blush gradients on the skin. Surfaces carry a faint canvas grain. Clean compositions with a prominent subject and intricate, dense decorative detail. Overall a sweet, dreamy, slightly detached pastel surreal mood.

1792513006003_style.name: Rainy Urban Street Documentary Photography
1792513006003_style.prompt: Urban street documentary photography style, live-action photography with the look of 1970s and 1980s color film. Gray, cool and desaturated overall, built on fog gray and damp blue-gray, accented by warm yellow and orange-red city lights and traffic colors. Soft diffused light of a rainy day, with mist and steam drifting and a hazy distance. Fine film grain and reflective wet pavement give a real, gritty texture. Handheld candid framing with a normal lens, moderate depth of field and a strong sense of the moment. Overall a damp, melancholic, lived-in urban documentary atmosphere.

1792513006004_style.name: Retro Pastoral Japanese Hand-Drawn Animation
1792513006004_style.prompt: 1980s Japanese hand-drawn animation style, 2D cel coloring with simple, soft character lines, large eyes and round faces with subtle yet lively expressions, set against watercolor-like hand-painted backgrounds. Bright, fresh colors: sky blue and grass green paired with warm red and wheat yellow, at moderate, slightly faded saturation. Clear sunny daylight, with shadows rendered as simple color shapes. Film grain and mild fading make it look like a frame from old animation film. Compositions often pair medium close-ups of characters with open, airy distant views. Overall a fresh, nostalgic, warm pastoral Japanese animation atmosphere.

1792513006005_style.name: Naive Red-Line Doodle Sketch
1792513006005_style.prompt: Naive line-sketch style, drawn by hand in thin single-color red ink with casual, wobbly, slightly crooked lines and simplified childlike forms, close to children's drawings or journal doodles. Minimal color: only red lines and a few solid red shapes on off-white paper. No light or shading and no hatching; everything is carried by outline alone. Clean paper with generous white space, sometimes with handwritten notes and scribbles. Flat composition with casual perspective and sparsely scattered elements. Overall a relaxed, humorous, slightly lonely hand-drawn sketchbook charm.

1792513006006_style.name: Pastel Cute Line-Art Illustration
1792513006006_style.prompt: Cute line-art illustration style, outlined in fine, soft colored lines; characters have round heads and small bodies with simplified, adorable features, and the image is filled with dense decorative patterns and tiny motifs. Low-saturation pastels of lavender, cherry-blossom pink, pale yellow and mint blend into a soft, light overall tone. No obvious lighting; areas are filled with flat pale washes and fine textures. Off-white paper base with a slight colored-pencil, hand-drawn grain. Full, symmetrical compositions, richly detailed without clutter. Overall a sweet, gentle, dreamy girlish journal-illustration atmosphere.

1792513006007_style.name: 1980s Urban Night Anime
1792513006007_style.prompt: 1980s Japanese urban anime style, 2D hand-drawn cel animation with crisp character lines, voluminous hair and realistic, elongated proportions, set against detailed hand-painted city-at-night backgrounds. Deep indigo and ink-blue night tones dominate, with clothing accented by saturated red and beige blocks for strong contrast. Cool blue ambient light plays against distant warm yellow lights, with hard-edged shadow shapes. Film grain and a vintage color cast give a warm, mellow texture. Cinematic compositions, often low angles and medium two-shots. Overall a lonely, romantic, city-pop nostalgic night atmosphere.

1792513006008_style.name: Flash Film Everyday Documentary
1792513006008_style.prompt: 1990s everyday documentary photography style, live-action photography with the look of a point-and-shoot camera's built-in flash. Warm tones dominated by tungsten yellow and browns, with patches of cool cyan-blue. Light comes from direct flash and dim interior light: a bright foreground with the background falling quickly into darkness and hard shadows. Visible film grain, slight color casts and vignetting, with cluttered, authentic surroundings. Casual snapshot framing, subjects looking straight into the lens or glancing back, in crowded, full spaces. Overall a raw, intimate, unretouched sense of real life.

1792513006009_style.name: Surreal Blue-Green Pastoral Painting
1792513006009_style.prompt: Surreal magic-realist painting style, hand-painted with fine acrylic or oil technique; forms are precise with crisp contours and brushwork so smooth it is nearly invisible. Deep, saturated sky blue and lush grass green dominate, accented by brick red and warm ochre, pure and saturated. Low-angle raking sunlight casts long, sharp shadows with clearly divided lights and darks. Smooth, refined surfaces with a faint painterly grain. Open compositions with a low horizon, elements arranged with dreamlike strangeness in vast, silent space. Overall a tranquil, suspenseful, dreamlike surreal pastoral atmosphere.

1792513006010_style.name: Retro Photo Color-Block Surrealism
1792513006010_style.prompt: Graphic surreal collage style, placing vintage sepia-toned realistic figures like cutouts against large flat fields of pure color, assembled with a graphic-design approach. Strong contrast between saturated magenta-pink and bright blue color blocks and the muted brown-gray figures. The figures keep realistic lighting and detail while the background is completely flat with no shading. Photographic grain contrasts with the pure flat color. Clean geometric compositions, often divided by a horizontal line, with figures lined up neatly as if displayed on a stage. Overall an absurd, cool, theatrical graphic surrealism.

1792513006011_style.name: VHS Chromatic-Aberration Surreal Imagery
1792513006011_style.prompt: Surreal digital imagery style, live-action photography processed digitally to feel both real and artificial. High-key, desaturated tones: dusky cyan-gray accented with lemon yellow and pink. Prominent cyan-magenta chromatic aberration, misregistered ghosting and faint scan lines, like a copy of an old videotape. Soft post-sunset skylight with flat shadows. Fine grain and slightly reduced sharpness. Calm, still compositions with the subject at or near center in empty surroundings. Overall a lonely, eerie, dreamlike surreal digital mood.

1792513006012_style.name: Modern Anime Sunlit-Sky Style
1792513006012_style.prompt: Modern Japanese animation style, digitally drawn 2D with fine, crisp linework, refined realistic character designs and shadows rendered as clean hard-edged color shapes. Vivid but not garish color, with sky blue and warm golden clouds in warm-cool contrast. Strong sunset or backlit sunlight, with shadows of trees or buildings forming large graphic patterns of light and shade on figures. Clean, smooth surfaces with soft gradients and slight bloom. Frequent low angles and close-ups with a large share of sky. Overall a clear, wistful, cinematic coming-of-age animation atmosphere.

1792513006013_style.name: Victorian Engraving Spot-Color Collage
1792513006013_style.prompt: Vintage print collage illustration style, drawn with fine engraving-like lines and hatching in the manner of copperplate etching, combined with Victorian scrollwork ornaments in a collage arrangement. Selective spot color in vintage print inks such as mustard yellow, burgundy and gray-teal, layered over black linework on aged cream paper. No realistic lighting; tonal values come from hatching density. The paper shows misregistration and worn texture. Symmetrical or centered compositions with ornaments framing the subject and elements juxtaposed surreally. Overall a mysterious, classical, symbolic vintage-engraving narrative feel.

1792513006014_style.name: Retro Cool-Green Gouache Flat Style
1792513006014_style.prompt: Vintage gouache illustration style, painted mainly in flat opaque gouache with simplified forms and a few strokes to suggest volume, close to mid-twentieth-century poster illustration. A cool palette of teal and gray-green, with faces and accents in warm orange and coral red for strong warm-cool contrast. Soft directional light, with highlights picked out directly in warm color patches. Paper grain and a slightly aged print feel. Often top-down or flattened repetitive arrangements that create rhythm. Overall a quiet, detached gouache atmosphere with a retro narrative feel.

1792513006015_style.name: Minimal B&W Long-Exposure Photography
1792513006015_style.prompt: Minimal black-and-white fine-art photography style, live-action photography using long exposure and soft focus so that edges soften and flow. Pure black and white, with large areas of deep black and bright white in strong contrast and few midtones. Soft skylight or reflected light makes the highlights seem to glow and flow. Fine grain and slight bleeding, close to a darkroom silver gelatin print. Minimal compositions with generous negative space emphasizing line and shape, often with a white paper border. Overall a serene, abstract, poetic black-and-white mood of light and shadow.

1792513006016_style.name: Twilight Light-Mote Cinematic Anime
1792513006016_style.prompt: Cinematic Japanese animation style, 2D hand-drawn characters combined with digital background art; character lines are delicate with realistic proportions, and backgrounds are painterly and detailed. A palette of dusky lavender and pink-orange skies with deep green foliage, soft and richly layered. Soft twilight light with motes and particles floating in the air, forming dreamy bokeh. Soft focus, slight grain and atmospheric perspective. Frequent back views and deep vistas with clearly layered depth. Overall a tender, nostalgic, magical cinema-grade animation atmosphere.

1792513006017_style.name: Retro Stage-Set Film Still
1792513006017_style.prompt: Vintage film still style, live-action photography with the look of 1970s and 1980s color film and handmade studio sets. Slightly desaturated tones, with deep navy-black backgrounds setting off warm yellow lamps and vivid red and blue costumes. Dramatic studio lighting: soft front fill, with practical lamps adding warm points of light. Film grain and slight vignetting, with set materials that feel handcrafted and theatrical. Framed like a frozen movie frame, often from a low angle with the subject centered. Overall a fantastical, nostalgic retro-film atmosphere with the charm of practical effects.

1792513006018_style.name: Indigo-Pink Minimal Surrealism
1792513006018_style.prompt: Minimal surreal digital art style, combining flat collage and painting with large color fields and rough textures, with realistic elements shrunk and placed in vast empty space. Strong, unnatural color: indigo-violet clashing with dusty pink, with touches of dark red. Lighting is subdued and shadows are rendered in non-naturalistic colors. Pronounced texture, with paper grain, noise and rough rock-like surfaces across the color fields. Minimal compositions with lots of negative space and a tiny subject tucked into a corner. Overall a lonely, quiet, dreamlike surreal poetry.

1792513006019_style.name: Dark Gothic 3D Animation
1792513006019_style.prompt: Dark stylized 3D animation style: 3D-rendered characters with a hand-drawn feel, exaggerated designs, strong silhouettes and angular, cartoonish faces. Deep indigo and dark gray with accents of rust red and warm brown, low in saturation overall. A single overhead or lamp-like point light creates strong contrast and large areas of shadow. Materials carry a painted, smudged quality and fine texture, somewhere between stop-motion puppetry and CG. Deep, oppressive compositions, often with narrow framing and foreground occlusion. Overall a gloomy, reclusive, gothic cinematic animation atmosphere.

1792513006020_style.name: Neon Purple-Teal Line-Art Illustration
1792513006020_style.prompt: Neon line-art illustration style, drawn with clean ink outlines and flat color, varied line weights and dense detail, with traits of Japanese anime and digital illustration. A neon palette dominated by electric purple, teal and magenta, highly saturated and high in contrast. Light comes from dusk skylight and warm interior lamps, with warm and cool light intertwining in the shadows. Clean, smooth surfaces, with shadows handled as deep purple blocks. Often deep interior views or window-framed scenes with rich spatial layers. Overall a calm, psychedelic nighttime mood with a cyber, lo-fi music vibe.

1792513006021_style.name: 1980s Retro-Futurist Poster
1792513006021_style.prompt: Retro-futurist poster style, digital collage combined with realistic painting, imitating 1980s printed magazines and sci-fi covers. Intense color led by bright red and lemon yellow, with touches of black and gray-white, nearly duotone. Dramatic lighting with large washes of warm light and a sunset-like glow. Scan lines, print creases, wear and glitch stripes give an aged yet strongly synthetic texture. Layered compositions where foreground figures and background sci-fi elements are overprinted together, with sharp lines. Overall a nostalgic, dazzling retro-futurist mood from the synthesizer era.

1792513006022_style.name: Blue Ink Stipple Engraving
1792513006022_style.prompt: Stipple engraving illustration style, building form with fine single-color blue ink stippling and short engraved lines, with the density of dots and lines defining light and shadow. Minimal color: only cobalt-blue ink on cream paper. Light is expressed through dot density, with large blank highlights and dense marks in the shadows. A texture like intaglio printing or pen stippling, on slightly aged paper. Simple centered compositions, often inside a square printed frame with blank margins. Overall a classic, quiet, elegant engraving with a vintage printed quality.

1792513006023_style.name: Colorful Floral Dot-and-Line Decorative Style
1792513006023_style.prompt: Decorative dot-and-line illustration style, hand-painted in gouache or colored ink, with forms built from dense dots, short strokes and repeated patterns, flattened and stylized into botanical motifs. Bright, varied colors of cobalt blue, rose pink, lemon yellow, mint green and lilac, saturated yet harmonious. No realistic lighting; volume comes from pattern density and layered color. Off-white paper with clear brush and dot texture. Lush, full compositions with elements stacked in layers and pockets of white space for breathing room. Overall a lively, dreamy, fairy-tale decorative illustration atmosphere.

1792513006024_style.name: 1970s Interior Film Portrait
1792513006024_style.prompt: 1970s film portrait style, live-action photography with a strong vintage color-negative look. Mixed warm and cool tones, with gray-blue walls set against earthy browns and dark green at low saturation. Soft, slightly dim natural window light indoors, with heavy shadows. Visible film grain and mild soft focus, in spaces full of stacked objects and traces of daily life. Often wide-angle low viewpoints with the subject centered and looking into the lens, balancing shallow depth of field with environmental detail. Overall a nostalgic, intellectual, characterful vintage humanist atmosphere.

1792513006025_style.name: Red Marker Sketch Style
1792513006025_style.prompt: Marker sketch style, rapidly drawn with saturated vermilion marker in bold, directional strokes, building forms from quick, short hatching, with brown marker laid in for shadows. Highly restrained color: red dominant, supported by brown and a little gray-green. Light and shade come from layered strokes and the depth of the color blocks, with broad flat shadow areas. Light gray-beige paper with visible marker overlap and bleed-through. Casual composition with natural white space and the subject roughly centered. Overall a fiery, lively hand-sketched charm full of on-the-spot energy.

1792513006026_style.name: Dark Tonalist Oil Painting
1792513006026_style.prompt: Tonalist classical oil painting style, hand-painted with thin oil glazes and soft scumbling; contours are hazy and edges melt into the background, with subtle, delicate brushwork. Deep, simple color of black, dark gray-green and browns, lit up locally by warm skin tones and off-white. Weak, soft side light with strong chiaroscuro, large shadows swallowing detail. Canvas texture, aged craquelure and a dim varnish sheen. Simple, still compositions, usually with the figure centered in a close view. Overall a quiet, melancholic, introspective classical portrait atmosphere.

1792513006027_style.name: Classical Pastoral Landscape Oil Painting
1792513006027_style.prompt: Eighteenth-century classical pastoral oil painting style, hand-painted with traditional layered glazes and fine brushwork, scenery modeled with soft dabbing. A palette of dark browns, olive green and lake blue, with clothing accented in vermilion and off-white. Soft skylight, with a darker foreground and a luminous distance showing clear atmospheric perspective. Yellowed old varnish, craquelure and canvas texture. A classic pastoral layout combining foreground figures with distant landscape. Overall a peaceful, nostalgic, poetic classical pastoral atmosphere.

1792513006028_style.name: Minimal Grayscale Stipple Drawing
1792513006028_style.prompt: Black-and-white stipple illustration style, building light and shadow from dense graphite or ink dots with no outlines, relying entirely on dot density to shape form and space. Monochrome grayscale with delicate transitions from pure white to deep gray. Strong directional sunlight casts crisp, sharp geometric shadows with clearly divided lights and darks. Fine grain and paper texture, like etching or lithograph prints. Minimal compositions with large blank areas, organizing space through simple geometric volumes. Overall a quiet, austere minimalist atmosphere with an architectural feel.

1792513006029_style.name: Dark Romanticist Oil Painting
1792513006029_style.prompt: Romanticist oil painting style, hand-painted with a mix of thick and thin oil paint and visible brushwork, emphasizing emotion and narrative. Dark browns and deep greens dominate, with cyan-blue sky and warm white clouds for strong warm-cool contrast. Dramatic lighting picks out the figures, surrounded by heavy shadows and vignetting. Canvas grain and an aged varnish feel. Figures are often set within natural landscape, with lush foregrounds and vast distances. Overall a passionate, sublime, slightly wistful Romantic image.

1792513006030_style.name: Emerald Grainy Gouache Landscape
1792513006030_style.prompt: Digital gouache illustration style, soft brushes imitating gouache and acrylic with dry-brush texture, simplified, gentle forms and a light impressionistic touch. Emerald and teal greens lead the palette, with warm yellow grass tones and dots of white, fresh and balanced. Soft, diffused daylight with light shadows. A fine overall grain gives a vintage print feel. Often top-down or distant views, with small figures dotted in open space. Overall a fresh, tranquil, slightly nostalgic poetry of open fields.

1792513006031_style.name: B&W Smeared Silhouette Photography
1792513006031_style.prompt: Black-and-white experimental photography style, live-action photography using slow-shutter shake and digital smearing so that contours tear and shift horizontally. Pure black and white, with the subject nearly a silhouette against a clean pale gray-white background. Flat backlight or background light crushes the subject's shadows to black with minimal detail. Grain and motion blur, with edges stretching into pixel streaks like a glitch. Minimal compositions with the subject in profile, centered and surrounded by negative space. Overall an anxious, hazy, cold image of dissolving identity.

1792513006032_style.name: 1990s Japanese Family Cartoon
1792513006032_style.prompt: 1990s Japanese TV animation style, 2D hand-drawn cel animation with simple, rounded character lines, exaggerated features and lively comedic expressions, set against watercolor-painted backgrounds. A soft, warm palette of gray-blue, beige, burgundy and warm pink at moderate saturation. Even lighting with few shadows and mostly flat coloring. Vintage film grain and slight fading, with finely brushed backgrounds. Eye-level medium shots, often with several characters lined up in the frame. Overall a cozy, humorous, nostalgic family-comedy animation atmosphere.

1792513006033_style.name: Playful Loose Watercolor Sketch
1792513006033_style.prompt: Loose watercolor illustration style, with broad watercolor washes and naturally bleeding edges, simple, naive lines drawn casually, and rounded, childlike character designs. Bright, warm colors, with large rose-pink and orange-red washes for backgrounds and figures touched in with light tints and gray. No defined lighting; depth comes from the strength of the washes. Paper grain, water blooms and white space are clearly visible. Loose, free compositions with casually scattered figures. Overall an innocent, cheerful, airy children's picture-book sketch atmosphere.

1792513006034_style.name: Grainy Soft-Light Pastel Character Illustration
1792513006034_style.prompt: Soft-light grainy character illustration style, with digital brushes imitating soft pastel and colored pencil, finely colored on coarse-grained paper, simplified forms and delicate features. Low saturation, on a base of lavender gray-violet and misty white, with skin graded in warm orange and pale pink. Soft raking light forms a bright band across the image, with hazy shadows. Fine grain and paper texture throughout. Simple compositions with negative space, figures often in half-length profile. Overall a quiet, reserved, slightly melancholic artistic mood.

1792513006035_style.name: European Period Drama Cinematic Style
1792513006035_style.prompt: European period drama cinematic style, live-action photography recreating the costumes, hair and makeup of the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries. Soft, desaturated tones of gray-green, beige-brown, ivory and pale pink, with warm, delicate skin. Soft natural diffused light of an overcast day, smooth facial transitions and almost no hard shadows. Fine film grain and gentle soft focus, with fabric, lace and curls clearly textured. Mostly medium close-ups and two-shots, with a telephoto lens and shallow depth of field blurring the background. Overall an elegant, romantic period atmosphere with a classic-literature air.

1792513006036_style.name: Monochrome Blue Crayon Sketch
1792513006036_style.prompt: Monochrome crayon sketch style, quickly drawn with cobalt-blue crayon or grease pencil in bold, broken, spontaneous lines, with the side of the crayon smudged into blocks. Only a single vivid blue on pure white paper. Light and dark are conveyed by the density and pressure of the strokes, with shadows laid in as large blocks. Rough texture, with crayon grain and paper tooth clearly visible. Loose compositions, partly unfinished, edges fading away naturally. Overall an improvised, lively, unpolished hand-drawn vitality.

1792513006037_style.name: Bold-Outline Flat Scene Illustration
1792513006037_style.prompt: Outlined flat-color illustration style, drawn with thick dark outlines and flat color blocks, with simplified forms and the traits of comics and indie game background art. A grayish, cool palette of gray-green, dark green and blue-gray, accented with rust red and warm white. Soft, diffused overcast light, with shadows handled simply as dark shapes. Slight paper and brush texture with moderate detail. Wide horizontal compositions with clearly layered foreground framing and distant background. Overall a quiet, nostalgic, slightly desolate narrative illustration mood.

1792513006038_style.name: Fine-Line Graphic Novel Style
1792513006038_style.prompt: Graphic novel illustration style, outlining contours and details with fine, precise ink lines, flat color blocks with subtle gradients, and realistic yet stylized characters with finely drawn eyes. A palette of vintage warm tones such as orange-red, olive green and mustard yellow at moderate saturation. Soft, even light, with shadows rendered as smooth gradients. Clean finish with slight paper grain. Mostly close-ups and near shots with the subject filling the frame. Overall a refined, cool graphic-novel aesthetic with a European comics sensibility.

1792513006039_style.name: Retro Airbrush Gradient Surrealism
1792513006039_style.prompt: Retro airbrush decorative illustration style, drawn with smooth airbrushed gradients and flat color areas, with forms built from flowing wave curves and simplified geometry. Vivid, dreamy colors of cyan blue, indigo violet, coral red and orange-yellow blending into one another, often with a large warm-yellow circle as the focal point. Color gradients replace shading, with almost no cast shadows. Smooth, fine surfaces with a slight print grain. Layered compositions like stage scenery, with undulating curves guiding the eye. Overall a surreal, romantic, dreamlike image with a 1970s poster sensibility.

1792513006040_style.name: 1970s Sci-Fi Cover Screenprint Style
1792513006040_style.prompt: 1970s sci-fi cover illustration style, combining rough brushwork with a screen-printed feel, bold lines and intricate detail. A palette of blazing orange, teal and ink black, highly saturated and high in contrast, with strong warm-cool clashes. Dramatic lighting rims the subject from the side against large dark silhouettes. Visible print grain, ink buildup and worn old paper. Compositions often overlay an extreme close-up face with a spectacular distant vista. Overall a mysterious, epic cover-art atmosphere full of retro science-fiction imagination.

1792513006041_style.name: Naive Cobalt-Blue Gouache Style
1792513006041_style.prompt: Monochrome gouache illustration style, painted with broad strokes of cobalt-blue gouache or acrylic, fluid and free, with strong variation in density and simplified, naive forms. Only shades of a single cobalt blue on cream paper, reminiscent of blue-and-white porcelain. No realistic lighting; layers come from paint density and white space. Brush edges alternate between wet and dry, with clear paper texture. Flattened compositions with elements arranged along a horizontal line and ample white space. Overall a crisp, calm decorative painting with handmade warmth.

1792513006042_style.name: Bold-Line Cute Doodle Comic
1792513006042_style.prompt: Cute doodle comic style, outlined with thick black hand-drawn lines, with rounded, simplified shapes and big-headed, small-bodied characters with minimal, adorable features. Bright colors of grass green, orange-yellow and brown on an off-white ground, flat with no gradients. Almost no lighting, just a few color blocks for separation. Slightly wobbly lines with a relaxed hand-drawn feel. Often framed by comic panel borders, with elements laid out flat. Overall a cute, healing, lighthearted hand-drawn doodle atmosphere.

1792513006043_style.name: Emerald Dry-Brush Crayon Picture Book
1792513006043_style.prompt: Contemporary picture-book illustration style, hand-drawn in mixed gouache, colored pencil and crayon, with visible dry-brush marks and crayon texture, and simplified characters with big eyes, round faces and lively expressions. Rich emerald and dark green dominate, contrasted with orange-red and white accents. Soft, even light, with depth expressed through warm and cool color. Rich paper grain and brush texture. Full compositions with the subject centered, surrounded by lush hand-drawn textures. Overall a natural, warm, childlike picture-book atmosphere.

1792513006044_style.name: Pink-Blue Retro Pixel Art
1792513006044_style.prompt: Retro pixel art style, drawn pixel by pixel at low resolution with crisp stair-stepped edges, with shading and transitions achieved through dithering. A limited palette led by misty blue, cherry pink and coral red, soft with bright accents. Simple lighting with two or three tonal steps to show volume. Clean digital pixel texture. Often floating-island miniature scenes surrounded by large areas of flat color. Overall a cute, nostalgic pixel-art atmosphere with a retro-game feel.

1792513006045_style.name: B&W Photo Color-Blob Collage
1792513006045_style.prompt: Mixed-media collage style, combining cut-out black-and-white portrait photographs with colorful geometric blocks and hand-painted round blobs, with a strong graphic-design sense. Bright clashing colors of grass green, coral pink, cobalt blue and orange-yellow contrast vividly with the monochrome photos. The photos keep their realistic light and shade while the color blocks are flat. Rich texture of halftone dots, grain, crayon smears and paper. Layered collage compositions with the subject centered and color blocks scattered freely around it. Overall a retro, playful collage with an art-magazine sensibility.

1792513006046_style.name: Colorful Fine Stipple Illustration
1792513006046_style.prompt: Stipple illustration style, covering the entire image with countless tiny color dots and short strokes, shaping form and gradients through dot density and optical color mixing. Natural, bright colors: layered yellow-greens and olive greens with brick red and orange, under a soft gray-cyan sky. Clear, gentle daylight, with shadows formed by clusters of darker dots. Fine granular texture like embroidery or stippled print. Broad horizontal compositions with a steady horizon and orderly elements. Overall a calm, delicate pastoral atmosphere with a patient handmade quality.

1792513006047_style.name: Vignetted Warm-Light Film Snapshot
1792513006047_style.prompt: Vintage film snapshot style, live-action photography imitating expired film stock and old cameras. Warm orange-red tones, with shadows from deep brown to near black and patches of cyan cast. Low-angle warm sunlight or window light illuminates the subject locally while the surroundings fall quickly into darkness. Heavy vignetting, light leaks, coarse grain and film-border marks, with soft sharpness. Casual framing with the subject centered and surroundings full of clutter. Overall an intimate, nostalgic film mood of youthful memories.

1792513006048_style.name: Cold-Gray Minimal Surreal Scene Render
1792513006048_style.prompt: Minimal surreal scene style, photorealistic 3D rendering of architectural spaces with simple, monumental volumes, combined with impossible objects to form conceptual images. Cold gray-blue tones, nearly monochrome and very low in saturation. Overcast diffused light with cold white light pouring through openings, and gentle tonal transitions. Rough concrete materials and soft, fog-like volumetric effects with clean detail. Symmetrical or off-center compositions with generous negative space and tiny silhouetted figures to emphasize scale. Overall a lonely, contemplative surreal atmosphere with a philosophical air.

1792513006049_style.name: Retro Pink-Gray Flat Oil Painting
1792513006049_style.prompt: Post-impressionist flat oil painting style, with thin, flat layers of oil or gouache, simplified forms and clean contours, and brushstrokes faintly visible across the color areas. Soft vintage colors of pink, gray-white and gray-blue, accented with black and vermilion. Flat overcast diffused light with almost no cast shadows. Canvas texture and a slightly aged feel. Steady compositions with simplified perspective and small figures dotted throughout, with the feel of plein-air street sketching. Overall an elegant, tranquil, nostalgic early-twentieth-century European painting style.

1792513006050_style.name: Dreamy Motion-Blur Film Photography
1792513006050_style.prompt: Dreamy film photography style, live-action photography using handheld shake, slow shutter and defocus to create strong motion blur. Soft colors, with sky blue set against pink-orange and warm brown, moderately saturated and slightly faded. Bright natural daylight, softly scattered with no hard shadows. Film grain and slight light leaks, with blurred, diffused edges. Casually tilted framing with the subject partly cut off, like a captured instant. Overall a light, hazy, dreamy mood of private memory.

1792513006051_style.name: Grainy Noise Gradient Blur Illustration
1792513006051_style.prompt: Noise-gradient illustration style, painted with digital airbrush and blur brushes, with color fields softly fused at the edges and forms reduced to almost no detail. Bright, saturated colors of cobalt blue, orange-red, bright yellow and pinkish white in large gradients. Light is expressed through color brightness, soft and diffuse with no clear source. Coarse noise grain covers the image like sandblasting or screen-print grit. Minimal compositions with a small, crisp silhouette set in a blurred color field. Overall a dreamy, tranquil modern illustration with abstract poetry.

1792513006052_style.name: Dark Horror Anime Line-Art
1792513006052_style.prompt: Horror anime illustration style, outlined with hard ink lines, with Japanese manga-style characters, densely detailed settings and a rough line texture. Dark tones of deep ink-blue and gray-cyan, accented by warm orange candlelight and a little dark red. Local warm light from below creates strong contrast with large dark areas. Grain and an aged paper feel. Often frontal, symmetrical compositions with the subject centered and surrounded by oppressive elements. Overall an eerie, tense dark manga atmosphere with a gothic horror flavor.

1792513006053_style.name: Candy-Colored Psychedelic Dreamscape
1792513006053_style.prompt: Psychedelic dreamscape painting style, digital painting imitating acrylic and oil brushwork, with soft, simplified forms and the flat colors and gradients of vintage illustration. Highly saturated, unnatural colors, with fluorescent lemon yellow, coral pink and teal clashing in a candy-sweet palette. Stylized lighting with strong color shifts and shadows tinted pink-violet or cyan. Canvas texture and slight grain. Open compositions filled with layered, voluminous soft forms. Overall a surreal, sweet, psychedelic retro dreamscape.

1792513006054_style.name: Loose Ink-Line Color-Patch Sketch
1792513006054_style.prompt: Ink-line sketch style, quickly drawn with black ink pen or marker, with boldly varied line weights and hatching and solid blacks for the shadows. Minimal color: mostly black and white, with a few loose patches of blue and green marker that do not fully follow the contours. Light and shade are separated simply by solid black areas. Clean ink-on-paper texture. Open compositions with lots of white space and free perspective. Overall an improvised, breezy hand-drawn sketch full of the joy of drawing from life.

1792513006055_style.name: Gradient Soft-Glow Minimal 3D
1792513006055_style.prompt: Minimal soft-glow 3D rendering style, with scenes built from smooth, rounded volumes and abstract, simplified forms with soft edges and no hard corners. Smooth color gradients run from deep blue night into peach-orange and pink-violet twilight tones, with objects in translucent, glowing materials. Soft, diffuse light makes objects seem to glow from within, and the floor shows soft reflections. Clean, fine textures close to frosted glass and soft silicone. Symmetrical, centered compositions in simple, orderly space. Overall a calm, dreamy, soothing minimalist 3D atmosphere.

1792513006056_style.name: Retro Warm-Red Film Documentary
1792513006056_style.prompt: 1970s and 1980s film documentary style, live-action photography with the color-negative look of old Japanese magazines. Rich, warm tones of pure red, dark green and brown, fairly saturated yet slightly faded. Natural interior light with soft fill and gentle shadows. Fine film grain, a slight color cast and soft focus. Steady medium or wide compositions with richly furnished spaces and natural poses. Overall a nostalgic, quiet retro atmosphere with a humanist documentary feel.

1792513006057_style.name: Minimal White-Space Ink Sketch
1792513006057_style.prompt: Minimal ink-brush sketch style, loosely drawn with a black ink brush, with forms reduced to a few silhouette-like strokes and no facial features or detail. Only pure black on white paper. No modeling of light; the image is built from solid ink shapes and white space. Strokes are slightly dry with broken dry-brush marks, simple in texture. Loose compositions with small elements sparsely scattered across large blank areas, strongly rhythmic. Overall a light, poetic, observational minimalist hand-drawn mood.

1792513006058_style.name: Low-Key Warm-Lamp Interior Night Cinema
1792513006058_style.prompt: Low-key cinematic style, live-action photography borrowing the chiaroscuro of film noir while staying in color. A base of deep brown and ink black, with warm yellow lamplight contrasting the cold blue night outside the window. A single practical, lamp-like warm source lights the subject partially, with large shadows swallowing the surroundings. Fine film grain with moderate shadow detail preserved. Often framed through doorways or dark foreground elements, with clear layers of depth. Overall a quiet, introspective, lonely nighttime cinematic mood.

1792513006059_style.name: Minimal Color-Block Architectural Photography
1792513006059_style.prompt: Minimalist architectural photography style, live-action photography presenting space through clean geometry and flattened composition. High-key pastel colors dominated by turquoise and sky blue, accented with pure red and white in bold contrast. Strong direct sunlight casts crisp, hard shadows. Sharp detail with visible wall texture and fine grain. Frontal, eye-level, strictly symmetrical or repetitive compositions, with evenly spaced elements and horizontal dividing lines. Overall a bright, quiet minimalist aesthetic with a retro holiday feel.

1792513006060_style.name: Saturated Wide-Angle Selfie Style
1792513006060_style.prompt: Stylized realist photography style, live-action photography mixing a social-media selfie look with film filters. Highly saturated color with strong contrasts of warm orange, red-brown and teal, and warm skin tones. Frontal flat light or flash with light shadows, the skin slightly smoothed while keeping detail. Light grain and sharpening, with artistically graded color. Wide-angle, close-range shots from slightly below or at eye level, the subject centered and looking into the lens against busy, decorated backgrounds. Overall an individualistic, trendy realism with a youth-subculture vibe.

1792513006061_style.name: Pink-and-Black Pop-Surreal Acrylic
1792513006061_style.prompt: Pop-surreal acrylic painting style, with flat acrylic color fields combined with localized realistic rendering, simplified forms, and dry-brush and brushstroke textures in places. Strong contrast between a pink ground and pure black organic shapes, accented with sky blue and gray-green. Shading is kept only in the realistic parts, while the background is fully flat. Canvas texture and the materiality of paint. Flattened compositions where large graphic shapes contrast with small realistic elements. Overall an absurd, cool surreal image with a contemporary-art sensibility.

1792513006062_style.name: Retro Airbrush Hyperreal Grotesque
1792513006062_style.prompt: Retro surreal digital painting style, with airbrush-smooth rendering of near-photographic forms and glossy, plastic-like surfaces, splicing together impossible elements. Bright, saturated colors led by sky blue, pure red and white, with warm skin tones. Bright daylight with sharp highlights and starburst glints. Slight grain like 1980s magazine printing. Frequent extreme close-up profiles, with elements arranged tightly against the subject. Overall a bizarre, polished, dreamlike retro surrealism.

1792513006063_style.name: Art Nouveau Decorative Fairy-Tale Painting
1792513006063_style.prompt: Art Nouveau decorative painting style, softly hand-painted in tempera or gouache, with flowing organic curves and swirling cloud ornaments throughout and long, sweeping drapery. A base palette of deep cobalt and gray-blue, accented with ochre red, pinkish white and gold. Soft, even light, with warm-cool color and flat ornament replacing strong chiaroscuro. Mural-like grain and an aged texture. Rich narrative compositions where layered patterns intertwine with the distance. Overall an elegant, mysterious decorative painting with a folk fairy-tale spirit.

1792513006064_style.name: Twilight Surreal Cinematic Photography
1792513006064_style.prompt: Surreal cinematic photography style, live-action photography using meticulously lit, staged images to create the uncanny within the everyday. Twilight cold-blue tones, accented with warm yellow window light and cold white glowing elements in strong warm-cool contrast. Dramatic lighting where multiple artificial sources intertwine with dusk skylight, with deep shadows. Clear, fine detail with slight grain and mist. Wide compositions with stable perspective and tiny figures in empty surroundings. Overall a mysterious, silent, suspense-laden surreal cinematic atmosphere.

1792513006065_style.name: Naive Colored-Pencil Picture Book
1792513006065_style.prompt: Naive picture-book illustration style, hand-drawn in colored pencil and crayon, with wobbly, casual lines and slightly crooked forms, and characters with big eyes, thin limbs and deadpan expressions. A cobalt-blue color block as the ground, with figures and objects accented in pure red, light blue and white. No realistic lighting; layers come from hatching and smudging. Clear paper and pencil grain with loose strokes. Flattened compositions with stacked elements and handwritten, signature-like marks. Overall a humorous, warm, childlike hand-drawn picture-book atmosphere.

1792513006066_style.name: Pink-Violet Sunset Dreamy Illustration
1792513006066_style.prompt: Dreamy landscape illustration style, digital painting combined with fine brushwork, with richly rendered clouds and light and exquisite detail. A romantic, dreamy palette of pink-violet, lavender and pale blue, paired with warm yellow and grass green. Soft, pervasive sunset glow with luminous cloud edges. Watercolor-like brushwork and fine grain. Open compositions with a large share of sky and the subject in the midground. Overall a romantic, tender, soothing aesthetic illustration atmosphere.

1792513006067_style.name: Pop-Art Halftone Retro Comic
1792513006067_style.prompt: American retro comic pop-art style, drawn with thick black outlines and flat color, with shading and transitions rendered in Ben-Day halftone dots. Saturated primaries of bright yellow, pure red, sky blue and skin pink. Simple lighting, with lights and darks separated by dot density and black areas. Texture of print halftones, ink splatter and rough paper. Bold, exaggerated compositions, often with close-ups, speech balloons and burst frames. Overall a lively, exaggerated, dramatic mid-twentieth-century comic pop feel.

1792513006068_style.name: Woodland Felt Doll Miniature
1792513006068_style.prompt: Felt doll miniature scene style, with dolls and sets handmade from felted wool, knitting and real materials and photographed as physical objects; designs are rounded and cute, with simplified features and blushing cheeks. A low-saturation woodland palette of moss green, olive, off-white and carrot orange. Soft natural diffused light with light shadows. Clearly visible fiber fuzz and knit texture, warm and tactile. Tabletop miniature compositions with the subject centered and a shallow-depth-of-field blurred foreground. Overall a cute, cozy, healing woodland handcrafted fairy-tale atmosphere.

1792513006069_style.name: Foggy Green-Light Retro Horror Film
1792513006069_style.prompt: 1980s retro horror film style, live-action photography with the coarse grain and low definition of old film stock. Sickly fluorescent green and yellow-green dominate, with near-black shadows and low saturation overall. Nighttime artificial light from fluorescent tubes and streetlamps blooms in thick fog while the surroundings sink into darkness. Visible grain, slight soft focus and vignetting. Empty compositions with tiny figures in the distance and large areas of darkness. Overall a cold, uneasy, suspenseful and oppressive retro horror atmosphere.

1792513006070_style.name: Vintage Sparkle Light-Fleck Film
1792513006070_style.prompt: 1970s vintage film photography, live-action realism, photographic work. Strong backlight and side light pass through shimmering surfaces, scattering countless rainbow light flecks and sequin-like sparkles across the environment; the palette is warm gold, amber and cream white with deep brown shadows, high contrast that still keeps shadow detail. Fine film grain, soft halation around highlights, an opulent texture. Compositions lean toward wide shots with silhouettes and backlit rims at moderate depth of field; overall it presents a luxurious, hazy, slightly fantastical vintage sparkle atmosphere.

1792513006071_style.name: Macaron Symmetrical Retro Set
1792513006071_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work, a vintage film set-design style built on symmetry. Frames are strictly centered and symmetrical, shot frontally at eye level, with figures often placed dead center and props and furnishings arranged in neat stacked rows; colors are dominated by macaron tones such as pink, mint green and butter yellow, low in saturation and highly unified. Lighting is even and soft, almost shadowless; the texture is clean with slight film grain, deep depth of field and crisp detail. Overall it presents a refined, quirky, deadpan vintage storybook-set feeling.

1792513006072_style.name: 1950s Saturated Color Film
1792513006072_style.prompt: 1950s color cinema style, live-action realism, photographic work, imitating the lush hues of three-strip dye-transfer film. Colors are rich and saturated, with bold clashes of teal, tangerine and coral red, and rosy, luminous skin tones; soft studio key light and rim light give faces even, delicate illumination and rounded highlights. Slight film grain and soft focus, with meticulously styled hair and makeup. Compositions favor medium close-ups and two-shots with gently blurred backgrounds; overall it presents a vivid, nostalgic, elegant and theatrical classic Hollywood color-film look.

1792513006073_style.name: Quiet Narrative Realist Oil
1792513006073_style.prompt: Realist oil painting style, hand-painted work, with fine smooth brushwork and naturally blended paint layers; figures and fabrics are rendered realistically yet slightly simplified. The palette centers on calm teal, ochre yellow, sienna, black and white at low saturation, with large areas such as walls laid in evenly. Lighting is soft, even diffused daylight with faint shadows. A light canvas texture shows through; compositions are flat and horizontal, favoring frontal facades and figures lined up side by side with generous space. Overall it presents a quiet, detached, stage-like narrative painting atmosphere.

1792513006074_style.name: Risograph Halftone Organic-Pattern Illustration
1792513006074_style.prompt: Stencil duplicator print style illustration, overprinted with a limited set of two or three inks, mainly cobalt blue and bright orange with touches of lavender; tones are built from halftone dots, grain and overlapping layers. Forms are flat, combining decorative textures such as ripples and spots with large organic shapes, with slight misregistration at the edges. Off-white paper, coarse visible ink grain and no realistic lighting. Compositions are decorative and rhythmic; overall it presents a vintage, lively, handmade-print look with a contemporary graphic design sensibility.

1792513006075_style.name: Red-Blue Saturated Film Still
1792513006075_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work with the feel of a 1980s film still. Colors are intense and saturated, with pure red and deep cobalt blue clashing strongly and warm practical lights set against cool walls; lighting is dramatic, with hard light picking out the subject, pronounced reflections and a wet sheen on the floor, and deep shadows. Medium film grain and slight diffusion, with rich, layered detail. Compositions favor symmetrical depth and centered figures seen from behind; overall it presents a mysterious, intense cinematic narrative charged with psychological tension.

1792513006076_style.name: 1970s Airbrushed Soft-Light Portrait
1792513006076_style.prompt: 1970s vintage portrait photography, live-action realism, photographic work, with skin softened in an airbrushed manner so transitions are extremely smooth and slightly porcelain-like. Tones lean toward warm browns and faded teal, low in saturation with a vintage color cast; soft window light and diffused light wrap the face with delicate highlights. Slight film grain and soft-focus glow, with polished, voluminous hair and makeup. Compositions favor close half-length framing with shallow depth of field; overall it presents an idealized, dreamy, nostalgic vintage glamour portrait quality.

1792513006077_style.name: Peach Fine-Line Picture Book
1792513006077_style.prompt: Hand-drawn picture book illustration style, outlined with thin brown-black pen lines that wobble casually, filled with flat color and no obvious shading. The palette centers on peach and apricot with accents of mint green, gray blue and terracotta, soft and low in saturation overall. Lighting is minimal, with depth separated by color blocks. Fine paper grain, dense and charming details, and figures with round heads, small bodies and naive proportions. Compositions favor eye-level wide views with rich stacked layers; overall it presents a cozy, tranquil, playful hand-drawn storybook atmosphere.

1792513006078_style.name: Bold Crayon Cartoon on Black
1792513006078_style.prompt: Crayon hand-drawn cartoon style, laid down with heavy crayon or oil pastel strokes; lines are bold and rough-edged, forms are highly simplified and naive, and facial features are reduced to simple symbols. Colors are flat blocks of coral pink, orange and pale yellow-green set against a dense pure black ground for strong contrast. No realistic lighting; volume comes only from the pressure of the strokes. Waxy grain and paper texture are obvious, often finished with a hand-drawn colored border, and compositions are full and centered; overall it presents a humorous, candid, slightly odd handmade cartoon quality.

1792513006079_style.name: Retro Print-Grain Flat Illustration
1792513006079_style.prompt: Retro flat illustration style, outlined with clean fine lines, filled with flat color and overlaid with fine print grain that mimics old book printing. The palette centers on olive green, orange yellow, warm red and off-white, moderately saturated and harmoniously vintage. Lighting is simplified with almost no shadows, depth separated by layered color blocks. Details are dense with abundant foliage and floral ornament, and figures are rounded and simple. Compositions are full, often high-angle or eye-level ensemble scenes; overall it presents a warm, peaceful, lived-in vintage storybook atmosphere.

1792513006080_style.name: Hard-Light Teal Film Portrait
1792513006080_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work with the feel of a 35mm film portrait. Strong hard sunlight falls in narrow diagonal strips, creating large deep shadows and sharp patches of light with stark contrast; tones lean teal and dark olive, interspersed with saturated sky blue and warm skin tones. Film grain is visible and colors carry a slight cross-processed cast. Compositions favor low-angle close shots or close-ups with medium-shallow depth of field, often with flat elements layered in the background; overall it presents a youthful, detached, poetic indie film quality.

1792513006081_style.name: 1980s Practical-Effects Fantasy Film
1792513006081_style.prompt: 1980s fantasy film style, live-action realism, photographic work, emphasizing practical effects and special makeup, with fantastical designs realized through silicone prosthetics and animatronic puppets and lifelike skin textures. Colors are warm and rich, mainly ochre red, gold, deep brown and gray green; lighting is soft yet dramatic, with side backlight tracing contours against dark backgrounds. Noticeable film grain and soft focus, with rich metal and fur detail in costumes. Compositions favor close face-to-face framing with shallow depth of field; overall it presents a classical, mysterious, fairy-tale-epic vintage fantasy film atmosphere.

1792513006082_style.name: Knitted Yarn Texture 3D Render
1792513006082_style.prompt: 3D render style in which characters and objects are built from soft materials such as knitted yarn, pom-poms and woven textures, with rich fiber detail and rounded, doll-like forms. Colors are soft pink, pale blue, cream yellow and bright yellow, often against a plain dusty-pink backdrop. Even, soft studio lighting with short gentle shadows. The materials feel highly tactile and finely detailed; compositions are frontal and eye-level, arranged in a horizontal row like a display stand; overall it presents a playful, gentle, slightly quirky designer-toy handmade feel.

1792513006083_style.name: Soft Green Naive Tempera Picture Book
1792513006083_style.prompt: Naive hand-painted picture book style, flatly applied with matte gouache or tempera-like paint in small soft strokes, with figures simplified like dolls in naive proportions. The palette centers on gray green, mint green and off-white, accented with pale pink, ochre and ink black, low in saturation and gentle overall. Lighting is flat with almost no cast shadows. Fine paper grain and paint texture, often framed by symmetrical trees and plants; compositions are flat with figures in rows; overall it presents a quiet, archaic folk fairy-tale atmosphere with a slightly uncanny dreamlike feel.

1792513006084_style.name: Blue Palette-Knife Impressionism
1792513006084_style.prompt: Expressive impressionist painting style, laid down quickly with broad brushes and palette-knife strokes; stroke direction is obvious, edges are crisp and forms are highly abbreviated. The dominant colors are cobalt, ultramarine and white, punctuated by saturated orange red, bright yellow and emerald for strong warm-cool contrast. Light is bright and airy, sunlight expressed through warm and cool color blocks rather than fine modeling. Paint texture is thick, and compositions often open into spacious perspective; overall it presents a brisk, relaxed, sun-drenched summer improvisational painting feel.

1792513006085_style.name: 1980s Cel Bishojo Anime
1792513006085_style.prompt: 1980s and 1990s Japanese hand-drawn cel animation style, with clean crisp lines, elegant elongated character designs, finely detailed large eyes with distinct lashes and highlights, and hair drawn in solid shapes. Flat coloring with a single layer of hard-edged shadow, set against soft pink-violet and blue-violet gradient backgrounds with low-saturation skin tones. Simple lighting. The image carries slight videotape-like blur, fading and noise grain. Compositions favor close-ups with the character centered; overall it presents a retro, elegant, nostalgic animation quality with an urban romantic mood.

1792513006086_style.name: Green Japanese Fine-Line Landscape Illustration
1792513006086_style.prompt: Japanese flat illustration style, finely outlined with thin ink lines, flat colored with slight paper grain and dense detail. The palette is dominated by rich teal and grass green, paired with deep blue, cream white and accents of pink, orange and yellow, with a vintage print feel. Lighting is flattened, clouds and volumes described by color blocks, with full, decorative cloud shapes. Compositions favor sweeping high-angle vistas or framed views that build depth layer by layer; overall it presents a fresh, expansive landscape illustration atmosphere with nostalgic summer air.

1792513006087_style.name: Blue-Red Dual-Light Low-Key Portrait
1792513006087_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work, a low-key portrait lit with colored gels. The whole frame is immersed in deep cobalt blue ambient light, with a red side light tracing the contours of the face for a strong warm-cool contrast; most of the image sits in shadow and highlights are restrained. Fine texture with light grain and a clean, blurred background. Compositions favor close head-and-shoulders framing slightly centered with color space around, at shallow depth of field; overall it presents a cool, mysterious, introspective contemporary image atmosphere.

1792513006088_style.name: Bright Digital Cartoon Animation
1792513006088_style.prompt: Contemporary digital cartoon animation style, combining clean lines and cel-style block shadows with softly hand-painted backgrounds, and simple character designs with cartoon proportions. Colors are bright and saturated, with warm orange and brick red set against lake blue; lighting is bright, with luminous sky light in the distance and soft ambient occlusion in the foreground. Light texture and a clean image. Compositions favor low-angle deep perspective with stacked foregrounds and small subjects; overall it presents a whimsical, upbeat, adventurous animated feature art-direction atmosphere.

1792513006089_style.name: Vermilion Japanese Poster Illustration
1792513006089_style.prompt: Japanese vintage poster illustration style, built from heavy crisp ink lines and flat color blocks, with sharp facial features, cool alluring eyes and hair rendered in solid shapes. Vermilion and pure red dominate absolutely, paired with black, white, skin tones and small accents of teal for strong contrast. Lighting is flattened, with hard-edged shadows describing volume. Slight print grain, often with vertical calligraphic lettering as a layout element; compositions are dense and intricate with a clear hierarchy; overall it presents an intense, eerily beautiful, high-tension Eastern poster feel.

1792513006090_style.name: Anime Model-Sheet Light Wash
1792513006090_style.prompt: Japanese anime character model-sheet style, outlined with clean, flowing fine lines that carry slight hand-drawn variation, with volume suggested only by light washes and a little pale gray shading. Colors are delicate, mainly white, light blue gray and warm skin tones, low in saturation and airy. Simple lighting with highlights left as white paper. Plain white background with no scenery, often presented as multiple angles and expressions arranged on the sheet with handwritten signature notes. Overall it presents a crisp, refined design quality like professional key animation drawings.

1792513006091_style.name: Gothic Pen Hatching Sketch
1792513006091_style.prompt: Pen-and-ink drawing style, meticulously rendered with ultra-fine technical pen lines, using extensive hatching, cross-hatching and dense short strokes to build light, shadow and volume; the linework is intricate and full of tension.
