Character designs are elegant and elongated, hair rendered as curling solid shapes. Lighting is strong one-directional hard light with sharp-edged shadows. A clean finish like screen printing. Compositions often place multiple panels side by side, favoring close-ups; overall it presents a cool, decadent comic style steeped in film noir mood.

1792513006144_style.name: Cute Big-Eyed Chibi 3D Animation
1792513006144_style.prompt: Chibi cartoon 3D animation style, characters with big heads, small bodies and large glossy eyes, rounded and cute designs, and smooth surfaces with a subtle hand-painted touch. Colors center on cyan blue, lilac and warm brown, saturated yet soft, accented with sparkling fluorescent tones. Lighting is dreamy ambient glow with soft volumetric light, backgrounds hazy with halos. Rendering is soft with light shadows. Compositions favor medium close two-character interactions with shallow-focus backgrounds; overall it presents a fantastical, sweet, heartwarming children's animated film atmosphere.

1792513006145_style.name: Minimal Stick-Figure Line Comic
1792513006145_style.prompt: Minimal stick-figure comic style, outlined with black lines of even weight and a slight wobble, characters drawn as round-headed stick people and simple cute shapes, with features made of dots and short dashes. Mostly black and white, accented only by a single orange-red block with a little light gray and solid black fill. No lighting. Clean white background with an obvious hand-drawn line quality. Compositions line characters up horizontally along a single ground line with plenty of white space; overall it presents a dorky, humorous comic style that is deadpan yet warm.

1792513006146_style.name: Vintage Magazine-Print Photography
1792513006146_style.prompt: Eighties vintage magazine-print photography style, photorealistic live-action photographic work, as if re-shot from the pages of an old magazine. Colors show print separation with slight posterization and a faint hand-tinted feel, with fine halftone dots and paper texture visible. The palette is dominated by warm browns, brick red and amber yellow, with deep brownish shadows and moderately low saturation. Lighting is warm indoor tungsten with low fill, soft yet deep contrast. Noticeable grain and slight fading, frontal centered compositions with rich set dressing and moderate depth of field; overall a nostalgic, intimate, collectible vintage print look.

1792513006147_style.name: Dry-Brush Color-Clash Illustration
1792513006147_style.prompt: Dry-brush color-clash illustration style, digitally painted to mimic screen printing and dry gouache brushwork, with large flat layered color planes, rough broken edges and visible brush drag, forms highly simplified. Palette of sky blue, grass green, pink and off-white, bright and saturated with strong contrast, a little deep teal for the darks. Almost no volumetric shading; light and shadow are separated by warm and cool color blocks. Strong paper grain and slight misregistration, often with irregular brushed borders around the image. Open, horizontally spread compositions; overall a lively, relaxed travel-poster feel with handmade print texture.

1792513006148_style.name: Black-and-White Motion-Blur Street Photography
1792513006148_style.prompt: Black-and-white motion-blur street photography style, photorealistic live-action photographic work, shot with a slow shutter and handheld following so the subject stays partly sharp while the surroundings streak into ghostly trails and flowing afterimages. Fully monochrome grayscale with rich midtones, soft highlights and slightly crushed blacks. Overcast or diffuse street daylight with gentle tonal transitions. Coarse grain, faint film scratches and slight lens flare. Mostly close candid framing, often through glass or past foreground obstructions, shallow depth of field and tilted angles; overall a hazy, restless, fleeting street-documentary mood.

1792513006149_style.name: Chalk-Textured Whimsical Cartoon
1792513006149_style.prompt: Chalk-textured whimsical cartoon style, hand-drawn-feel 2D illustration with large flat areas of chalk or soft pastel, dry grainy edges, and very simple rounded characters whose features are drawn with a few fine lines. Highly saturated clashing colors such as hot pink, cobalt blue and lemon yellow, with skin tones freely non-naturalistic. Almost no shading; depth comes only from stroke density. Strong paper grain and powdery smudges, backgrounds sprinkled with loose cut-paper-like shapes. Frontal, centered, simple compositions; overall an innocent, bright, playful children's picture-book feel.

1792513006150_style.name: Nineties Neon Dreamy Shoujo Animation
1792513006150_style.prompt: Nineties neon dreamy shoujo animation style, traditional hand-drawn cel animation look with fine clean lines, large-eyed softly contoured characters, and flat cel fills with one simple shadow tone. Rich, dreamy colors: magenta, pink-violet and electric blue neon over deep blue-purple night tones, strongly contrasted. Lighting is mainly ambient colored glow, characters lit by colored bounce light with soft halos on the highlights. Light film grain and a soft VHS-like blur. Compositions favor frontal duos or groups, often with bokeh light spots in the foreground; overall a romantic, wistful, dreamlike retro shoujo anime atmosphere.

1792513006151_style.name: Stippled Flat Decorative Illustration
1792513006151_style.prompt: Stippled flat decorative illustration style, digitally drawn flat illustration built from simple silhouette shapes, textured inside with dense small dots and short strokes, with no outlines. Bright retro palette of pink, mustard yellow, lavender, deep green and near-black in vivid contrast. Shading is almost omitted; depth comes only from value differences between color blocks. Slight paper grain and a matte, gouache-like finish. Clearly layered compositions with foreground, middle ground and background laid flat, strongly decorative; overall a leisurely, warm, holiday-like retro decorative-print atmosphere.

1792513006152_style.name: Bold Crayon Hatching Sketch
1792513006152_style.prompt: Bold crayon hatching sketch style, drawn directly with wax crayons and oil pastels on white paper, building forms from masses of parallel short hatches and undulating wavy lines, strokes rough and loose rather than precise. Bright pure colors, orange, lemon yellow, lake green, cyan-blue and pale pink, layered over one another and partly blended, with paper white left showing. No modeled light; depth comes from warm-cool contrast and line density. Waxy grain and paper tooth clearly visible. Horizontally layered, abstracted compositions; overall an improvised, free, rhythmic childlike scribble feel.

1792513006153_style.name: Eighties Shoujo Manga Pop
1792513006153_style.prompt: Eighties shoujo manga pop style, retro Japanese manga illustration with heavy black ink outlines, hair rendered in dense fine lines, and large eyes with layered highlights and long lashes. Highly saturated flat fills with a spot-color print feel, pink skin, orange-yellow, cobalt blue and deep black in strong pop contrast. Light and shadow are split by hard-edged color shapes, and backgrounds often use expressive graphics such as swirling clouds and lightning to heighten emotion. Visible print grain and slight misregistration. Compositions favor big close-ups and emotive angles; overall an intense, dramatic, retro shoujo cover-art feel.

1792513006154_style.name: Grainy Gradient Color Blobs
1792513006154_style.prompt: Grainy gradient color-blob style, digitally made flat illustration built from large soft gradients and blurred color patches, edges fully dissolved, figures reduced to small simplified silhouette dabs. Vivid multicolor palette of pure reds, yellows, greens and blues bleeding into one another over a light ground. No specific light modeling; space comes from color value and degrees of blur. A pronounced fine noise grain covers everything, like airbrush crossed with screen print. Open, airy compositions with scattered small subjects; overall a dreamy, light, abstractly poetic hazy atmosphere.

1792513006155_style.name: Faded Teal Film Portrait
1792513006155_style.prompt: Faded teal film portrait style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the feel of a contemporary art-house film still, subjects usually facing the camera head-on with a detached expression. Palette of faded teal-green and gray-blue, accented with dusty pink and old red, low saturation and cool overall. Soft diffused window light indoors with no hard shadows, true skin texture with imperfections kept. Fine film grain with slightly cyan shadows. Symmetrical centered framing, old and cluttered backgrounds, moderate depth of field; overall a quiet, melancholic art-house mood with the nostalgia of an old lived-in home.

1792513006156_style.name: High-Contrast B&W Documentary Portrait
1792513006156_style.prompt: High-contrast black-and-white documentary portrait style, photorealistic live-action photographic work shot on black-and-white film, emphasizing texture in faces and hair. Full grayscale with deep blacks and clean highlights, strong contrast while the midtones keep their gradation. Side window daylight creates distinct light and shadow planes and sculpted contours. Fine grain with a classic silver-gelatin print quality. Mostly close or medium shots, backgrounds softened yet still carrying environmental context, often shot wide-angle at close range; overall a contemplative, truthful, tense classic documentary portrait feel.

1792513006157_style.name: Soft-Palette Hand-Drawn Cel Animation
1792513006157_style.prompt: Soft-palette hand-drawn cel animation style with the feel of eighties-nineties Japanese theatrical animation: characters outlined in fine clean lines, flat cel fills with one soft shadow tone, large expressive eyes. Backgrounds are hand-painted in watercolor and gouache with visible brushwork, restrained color and rich, painterly detail. Low-saturation warm beige, olive green, ochre and gray-blue, gentle on the eye. Soft, mostly diffuse natural light. Slight paper and film grain. Steady compositions with clear separation between characters and backgrounds; overall a gentle, delicate, nostalgic classic hand-drawn animation feel.

1792513006158_style.name: Sunny Hand-Painted Theatrical Anime
1792513006158_style.prompt: Sunny hand-painted-background theatrical anime style with a Japanese feature-animation feel: characters in simple flat cel fills, backgrounds painted in rich gouache with detailed, visibly brushed layers of grass, clouds and distant scenery. Fresh bright colors dominated by emerald green, sky blue, cloud white and warm sunny gold, moderately saturated. Clear afternoon sunlight, voluminous clouds with golden rim light and strong aerial perspective. Light paper grain. Open compositions, frequent extreme long shots and far-reaching views with a large share of sky; overall a sunny, healing, hopeful pastoral-adventure atmosphere.

1792513006159_style.name: Two-Tone Screen-Print Picture Book
1792513006159_style.prompt: Two-tone screen-print picture-book style, 2D hand-drawn illustration mimicking screen printing and gouache, forms highly simplified and endearingly naive, lines fine and slightly wobbly. Color is limited to a few hues: a large peacock-blue ground with paper white and orange-red accents, clearly contrasted. No realistic shading; depth comes only from flat fills and negative space. Visible print grain, brush marks and uneven handmade edges. Simple, airy compositions with elements laid out flat and decoratively; overall a quiet, gentle, slightly humorous Nordic children's picture-book feel.

1792513006160_style.name: Foggy Low-Key Teal Night Film
1792513006160_style.prompt: Foggy low-key teal night film style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the nighttime feel of a suspense film, most of the frame sinking into shadow. Palette of dark green and cyan-gray, small cold white practical lights blooming in thick fog, almost no warm tones. Extremely low ambient night light, contours picked out only by scattered lamps and fog scatter, with large crushed-black areas. Noticeable night-shooting noise and fog softening. Often framed through a window or doorway in the foreground from a static, observational viewpoint, fairly deep focus; overall a claustrophobic, damp, uneasy suspense atmosphere.

1792513006161_style.name: Fuzzy-Stroke Quirky Picture Book
1792513006161_style.prompt: Fuzzy-stroke quirky picture-book style, 2D hand-drawn illustration where dense fine hatching in colored pencil and crayon builds furry forms with loose, bristly edges, shapes blunt and oddly charming, faces reduced to a few dots. Soft coral orange, lake blue, mint green, pink and charcoal black sit lively against a cream paper ground. No volumetric shading; depth comes from line density alone. Clear paper texture and dry-stroke grain, often accented with black silhouette-like plant forms. Flat side-by-side arrangements with even negative space; overall a quirky, cute, warm indie picture-book feel.

1792513006162_style.name: Neon Glitch Cyberpunk Anime
1792513006162_style.prompt: Neon glitch cyberpunk anime style, Japanese cel-shaded animation combined with cyberpunk night scenes, hard clean lines and characters given volume by large shadow shapes. Deep black and blue-purple base tones lit by neon red and pink-violet signage glow, skin tinted cool violet by the ambient light. High-contrast lighting with strong side and back rim light and large crushed shadows. Chromatic aberration, scanlines and slight signal-glitch effects give a VHS texture. Low camera angles and layered foreground figures against deep urban backgrounds; overall a cold, decadent, restless cyber-city night atmosphere.

1792513006163_style.name: Mid-Century Modern Documentary Film
1792513006163_style.prompt: Mid-century modern documentary film style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the documentary look of a seventies architecture and design magazine, spaces furnished sparingly and with care, mostly wood and plain walls. Warm wood brown, off-white, gray-blue and deep black, low saturation and warm-leaning. Soft daylight from large windows plus a few ceiling lights, with gentle tonal transitions. Fine film grain and slightly faded color. Eye-level medium or wide shots with figures small within the space, often framed by doorways or walls, deep focus; overall a quiet, restrained, cultured mid-century atmosphere.

1792513006164_style.name: Soft-Focus Iridescent Halo Photography
1792513006164_style.prompt: Soft-focus iridescent halo photography style, photorealistic photographic work shaped by extreme soft focus, backlight and lens imperfections, the subject's contours nearly dissolving into light. Silver gray, pale violet and light gold, with fine rainbow dispersion in the highlights. Strong backlight shining through produces feathery rays, large bokeh and flares, colors bleeding into each other. Slight haze and a low-contrast airy quality, with little visible grain. Abstract partial close-ups and shallow depth of field; overall an ethereal, dreamy poetry of light glittering like ice crystals.

1792513006165_style.name: Saturated American Nostalgic Film Still
1792513006165_style.prompt: Saturated American nostalgic film-still style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the look of a fifties-sixties American family film still, retro costumes and props and richly dressed sets. Rich saturated color dominated by warm wood brown, cherry red, pink gingham and cream, leaning warm. Soft warm interior light mixed with window light, luminous skin and clean shadows. Fine film grain with a slight glow. Symmetrical centered framing with subjects facing the camera, dense yet orderly background detail, moderate depth of field; overall a nostalgic, tidy, faintly absurd-comic American retro cinema feel.

1792513006166_style.name: Geometric Color-Block Flat Pop
1792513006166_style.prompt: Geometric color-block flat pop style, digital vector illustration dividing the image into circles, triangles and rectangles, faces radically simplified with facial structure assembled from color blocks, outlined in thin black lines. Highly saturated flat fills of peach pink, lake green, bright yellow, sky blue and violet butted together without gradients. No shading; forms are separated by color clashes. Clean, grain-free surfaces with crisp edges. Frontal centered compositions over abstract geometric backgrounds, strongly graphic; overall a bright, playful, modern pop-design feel.

1792513006167_style.name: Glossy Hyperreal Digital Painting
1792513006167_style.prompt: Glossy hyperreal digital painting style, using digital painting to reach photographic detail while keeping an over-sharpened, smoothed, painted sheen somewhere between photography and illustration. Highly saturated, eighties-retro palette with mint green, hot pink and dusky deep blue in vivid contrast. Twilight skylight plus frontal fill, gleaming highlights on the subject with crisp contours and darkened backgrounds. Smooth, refined surfaces with almost no grain and HDR-like enhancement in local detail. Centered full-length or medium framing with fairly shallow background depth; overall an exaggerated, vivid, retro-trendy hyperreal look.

1792513006168_style.name: Warm Afternoon-Sun Film Portrait
1792513006168_style.prompt: Warm afternoon-sun film portrait style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the feel of contemporary art-house film portraiture, subjects calm, gazing directly and naturally posed. Warm golden sunlight against indigo and deep green shadows, moderate saturation with a retro lean. Low-angle afternoon side light slanting in, creating crisp patches of light and soft shadows with detail kept in the darks. Fine film grain and true skin texture. Frontal medium shots with lived-in, layered backgrounds and moderate depth of field, often softened by out-of-focus foreground foliage; overall a warm, tranquil atmosphere full of everyday poetry.

1792513006169_style.name: Airbrushed Gradient Dreamscape
1792513006169_style.prompt: Airbrushed gradient dreamscape style, 2D digital painting imitating airbrush, with large smooth gradient bands forming sky and ground, softened edges, and distant details dotted in with dense tiny color specks. Saturated yet soft color, sky blue, orange-yellow, pink and fluorescent green blending smoothly, with darks held by deep blue-black silhouettes. No realistic lighting; luminosity comes from the color gradients. Smooth, nearly grainless surfaces with the matte feel of airbrushed acrylic. Horizontal compositions with a clear horizon line and blurred color patches below; overall a dreamy, serene, surreal poetry of color.

1792513006170_style.name: Sun-Drenched Retro Fashion Film
1792513006170_style.prompt: Sun-drenched retro fashion film style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the look of a nineties fashion-magazine location shoot, subjects posed crisply with retro styling. Vivid contrast between cobalt clear sky, olive green and warm skin, an overall warm-yellow shift and medium-high saturation. Strong direct midday or afternoon sun with crisp shadows and a sun-kissed sheen on the skin. Visible film grain and a slight cross-processed tint. Mostly low-angle upward shots against wide sky, centered subjects and deep focus; overall a bright, carefree, summery retro fashion feel.

1792513006171_style.name: Loose Ink-and-Watercolor Sketch
1792513006171_style.prompt: Loose ink-and-watercolor sketch style, pen or brush quickly laying down shaky, broken ink lines, followed by broad strokes of transparent watercolor that ignore the lines, bleed naturally at the edges and leave plenty of paper white. Light, airy color, sky blue, pinkish orange, sand yellow and leafy green, softly combined. Minimal shading, with light and dark only hinted by watercolor density. Visible water marks and dry-brush breaks in the ink. Loose, open, airy compositions with figures and scenery summarized in a few strokes; overall a relaxed, romantic, travel-journal-like French sketch feel.

1792513006172_style.name: High-Saturation Midsummer Retro Film
1792513006172_style.prompt: High-saturation midsummer retro film style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the summery film look of eighties-nineties Japanese cinema. Rich, saturated color with emerald green, sky blue, warm orange and brick red in vivid contrast, and cyan-blue leaning shadows. Strong clear midday or afternoon sun with high contrast between interiors and exteriors, often with dark interiors framing a bright outdoors. Clear film grain and a slight vintage color cast. Frequent door and window framing and deep inside-to-outside views, deep focus; overall a bright, lingering, nostalgic holiday-summer atmosphere.

1792513006173_style.name: Cold-Blue Night Warm-Lamp Film
1792513006173_style.prompt: Cold-blue night with warm-lamp film style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the indoor night look of a nineties American drama. Dominated by deep blue and cyan-gray night tones, with warm yellow lamps against the cold glow of screens creating warm-cool contrast, dark overall. Low-key lighting driven by scattered practical lamps and cold window light, heavy shadows, figures often in silhouette or half-silhouette. Visible film grain with slight noise in the darks. Mostly back views or static medium shots, darkened foregrounds and clear depth perspective; overall a lonely, oppressive psychological-drama mood with undercurrents of tension.

1792513006174_style.name: Cold-Lit Stage Theater Film
1792513006174_style.prompt: Cold-lit stage theater film style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the still-photo look of eighties experimental theater and art cinema, spaces empty and sets minimal. Cold blue, indigo and deep black dominate, with warm earth-toned costumes as small warm points. Theatrical top light and backlit light panels outline the forms, leaving large dark areas around figures and reflections on the floor. Fine film grain with cyan-leaning shadows. Wide-angle full shots with small centered figures and clearly layered depth; overall a detached, ritualistic, faintly surreal theatrical atmosphere.

1792513006175_style.name: Grainy Noise Twilight Soft-Focus
1792513006175_style.prompt: Grainy noise twilight soft-focus style, 2D digital painting building forms from dense stipple-like noise, the whole image heavily out of focus with contours melting into color bands and glowing masses. Twilight blue-violet, indigo and orange-yellow in a warm-cool gradient, cyan-violet shadows and scattered warm lights. Dusk or dawn backlight, glowing distance and silhouetted foregrounds, light sources blooming into soft spots. Coarse noise grain over the whole image like a faded print or an old scan. Wide horizontal compositions with a low horizon; overall a hazy, nostalgic, dreamlike atmosphere like fragments of memory.

1792513006176_style.name: Vermilion Single-Color Silhouette Print
1792513006176_style.prompt: Vermilion single-color silhouette print style, 2D flat graphics in a paper-cut or screen-print manner, all forms reduced to clean solid silhouettes, fine details rendered as delicate cut-out textures, with flowing undulating lines. Color is limited to a single vermilion on paper white, with a little pale gray-blue for distant layers, strikingly contrasted. No volumetric shading; space comes entirely from positive-negative shapes and layered silhouettes. Flat matte surfaces with crisp edges and a paper feel. Horizontal banded compositions with stacked foreground, middle ground and background and ample negative space; overall a clean, bright print feel with folk-decorative charm.

1792513006177_style.name: Low-Key Warm-Light Motion-Ghost Portrait
1792513006177_style.prompt: Low-key warm-light motion-ghost portrait style, photorealistic live-action photographic work using a slow shutter with flash or movement during exposure so that faces trail and double, partly sharp and partly flowing. Deep black backgrounds with orange-red warm skin, edges catching a little cyan-green cold light. A single warm hard light from the side, everything else falling into darkness, with extremely high contrast. Visible film grain with a slight cross-processed color cast. Mostly facial close-ups with off-center subjects against pure dark backgrounds; overall a mysterious, restless, phantom-like emotional tension.

1792513006178_style.name: Retro Japanese Airbrush Realism Illustration
1792513006178_style.prompt: Retro Japanese airbrush realism illustration style, with the feel of eighties Japanese illustration magazines and art books, painted with airbrush and fine brush: skin smooth and translucent with a soft pink blush, eyes and hair drawn in delicate fine lines. Metal and hard materials are rendered with high-gloss airbrushed reflections rich in warm and cool tones. Gray-blue, silver-black and warm flesh tones, soft and cool overall. Gentle, refined lighting with soft bright highlights and smooth transitions. Paper grain and a slightly yellowed printed quality. Side-profile close-ups and tight crops; overall an exquisite, cool, melancholic retro sci-fi beauty-portrait feel.

1792513006179_style.name: Composed Low-Key Environmental Portrait
1792513006179_style.prompt: Composed low-key environmental portrait style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the look of documentary-magazine environmental portraiture, subjects placed within their own working or living spaces amid rich, cluttered surroundings. Low-saturation dark brown, old wood, gray-green and off-white, slightly warm. Natural light from a large side window softly lights the subject while the background falls into shadow. Fine film grain with detail kept in the darks. Symmetrical, centered, wide-angle eye-level framing with subjects facing the camera and deep focus; overall a calm, dignified documentary feel rich in personal story.

1792513006180_style.name: Instant-Film Soft-Focus Light Leak
1792513006180_style.prompt: Instant-film soft-focus light-leak style, photorealistic live-action photographic work imitating instant film and old film cameras, with soft focus and pronounced edge falloff. A faded mix of warm yellow, old green and deep indigo, low saturation with slight color shifts. Natural window light, often with light leaks, glass reflections and overlapping light, parts of the image washing out. Coarse grain, low contrast and a mottled chemical-development texture. Close facial shots or details, often through glass that creates overlaid images, shallow depth of field; overall a private, nostalgic image quality, hazy as an old dream.

1792513006181_style.name: Tranquil Surrealist Oil Painting
1792513006181_style.prompt: Tranquil surrealist oil painting style, smoothly painted in traditional oil technique with soft, restrained brushwork and clear forms with slight texture, objects often scaled or combined against logic. Calm Prussian-blue skies, white clouds and ochre-orange ground, moderate saturation with an aged quality. Even, bright daylight with short crisp shadows and a hushed space. Visible canvas texture and faint craquelure. Minimal compositions with ample emptiness, level horizons and sparse isolated elements, figures often small, still silhouettes; overall a quiet, absurd, contemplative surreal dreamscape.

1792513006182_style.name: Violet-Orange Wash Minimalist Mood
1792513006182_style.prompt: Violet-orange wash minimalist mood style, 2D digital painting built from large soft-edged washes of color, forms fully dissolved, leaving only an undulating horizon and tiny silhouetted figures. Rich, soft gradients of violet, coral orange, rose red and a little deep green. Pervasive afterglow-like light with mirror-like reflections and light bands on the ground. Smooth airbrushed surfaces, almost no grain, all edges blurred. Minimal, wide horizontal compositions with tiny centered subjects and large fields of color; overall a lonely, still, meditative poetic atmosphere.

1792513006183_style.name: Macro Miniature Diorama Photography
1792513006183_style.prompt: Macro miniature diorama photography style, handmade physical miniature sets shot with a macro lens, tiny figurines and scenes placed on real everyday objects with deliberate scale mismatch, materials carrying the real texture of paper, moss and sand. Warm brown, beige and gray-green, low saturation with a warm nostalgic lean. Soft natural window light with a slight backlit rim. Extremely shallow depth of field and strong background blur create a tilt-shift miniature feel, with crisp texture where in focus. A low, tabletop-level camera with heavily blurred foreground and background; overall a quiet, wondrous, fairy-tale microcosm atmosphere.

1792513006184_style.name: Pink Designer-Toy Inflatable 3D
1792513006184_style.prompt: Pink designer-toy inflatable 3D style, 3D render with characters and props in rounded inflated-balloon, soft-vinyl and plastic-like forms, softly glossy highlights with fine grainy and knit-texture details, characters either realistic or figurine-like. Mostly pink, coral red and milky white with royal blue accents, soft and cohesive. Studio softbox lighting with light shadows and gentle reflections. Refined materials with visible subsurface scattering and slight film grain. Frontal centered compositions with foregrounded subjects and simple solid-color backgrounds; overall a playful, sweet, fashionable designer-toy art feel.

1792513006185_style.name: Dark-Ground Classical Oil Portrait
1792513006185_style.prompt: Dark-ground refined classical oil portrait style, rendered with realistic oil technique, brushwork smooth and concealed with soft transitions, porcelain-fine skin and clearly volumetric fabric folds, with a touch of contemporary simplicity. Dark brown-to-black grounds with ivory white, warm flesh tones and small vermilion accents, in steady contrast. A single soft light from the front-side, a crisp terminator and the background falling into darkness, close to classic portrait triangle lighting. Slightly visible canvas texture and a matte surface. Mostly side-turned half-length figures against plain dark backgrounds; overall a solemn, dignified, classical yet cool portrait feel.

1792513006186_style.name: Warm Coral Monochrome Flat Illustration
1792513006186_style.prompt: Warm coral monochrome flat illustration style, 2D digital illustration building forms from simple flat shapes, details added with fine lines and small color dabs, with light hand-drawn grain. Coral and watermelon red dominate as large grounds, accented with warm yellow, deep blue and a little dark green, unified within one color family. Lighting is nearly flat, with sunlight suggested by a large round warm glow. Fine paper grain and clean edges. Centered subjects on wide plain-color backgrounds with pared-down elements; overall a warm, romantic, postcard-like illustration feel of a Mediterranean afternoon.

1792513006187_style.name: Dark-Night Warm-Orange Single-Source Film
1792513006187_style.prompt: Dark-night warm-orange single-source film style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the indoor night feel of contemporary art-house cinema. Almost entirely bathed in warm orange, amber and deep brown, shadows sinking to brownish black, very few cool tones. Lit by a single warm practical lamp with soft falloff, the subject half lit and half lost in darkness, with strong contrast. Visible film grain with slight halation on the highlights. Mostly close side angles with blurred foreground occlusion, shallow depth of field and faintly visible background layers; overall an intimate, languid, contemplative warm-toned night atmosphere.

1792513006188_style.name: Hard-Shadow Cel Animation
1792513006188_style.prompt: Hard-shadow cel animation style with a hand-drawn Japanese animation feel, crisp firm lines, and large geometric hard-edged shadows carving the structure of faces and bodies, with detailed features and sharp eyes. Rich saturated color: dark areas such as deep skin tones and black hair set against bright sky-cyan and pink-orange sunset hues, strongly contrasted. Strong side and back light with decisive light-dark boundaries and few, precise highlights. Slight retro film grain. Big close-ups and low angles with backgrounds simplified into flat color shapes; overall a cool, hot-blooded, cinematically tense retro anime feel.

1792513006189_style.name: Seventies Sci-Fi Book-Cover Illustration
1792513006189_style.prompt: Seventies sci-fi book-cover illustration style, retro science-fiction illustration hand-painted in acrylic and gouache, brushwork fine and realistic yet partly flattened, often juxtaposing giant celestial bodies, geometric megastructures and wastelands in surreal imagery. Deep teal skies with orange-red and ochre ground, moderate saturation, slightly faded. Low-angle slanting sun with long shadows and crisp silhouettes. Noticeable halftone dots, paper grain and faded yellowing. Open compositions with low horizons and tiny isolated figures; overall a mysterious, desolate, imaginative vintage sci-fi paperback-cover feel.

1792513006190_style.name: Scarlet Monochrome Gothic Film
1792513006190_style.prompt: Scarlet monochrome gothic film style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the still-frame look of European art cinema and gothic thrillers. Almost entirely deep red, scarlet and dark wine-red monochrome, only skin and hair holding a little warm gold, all other colors suppressed. Soft top light and ambient red light, eyes often falling into shadow, heavy darks and restrained highlights. Fine film grain with a velvety smoothness. Symmetrical, centered eye-level framing, simple enclosed backgrounds and shallow depth of field; overall an oppressive, mysterious, ritualistic gothic aesthetic.

1792513006191_style.name: Pastel-Blue Soft-Glow Picture Book
1792513006191_style.prompt: Pastel-blue soft-glow children's picture-book style, 2D hand-drawn-feel illustration combining gouache and colored pencil, simple cute forms and tiny stick-like figures, with fine details such as branches drawn in thin lines. Gray-blue and snowy white with soft peach accents, low saturation, gentle and cool. Minimal shading, only a faint warm glow softening object edges. Fine white specks and paper grain across the image with soft strokes. Open compositions with ample space, low horizons and figures lined up near the bottom of the frame; overall a quiet, warm, wintry fairy-tale picture-book atmosphere.

1792513006192_style.name: Eighties Sci-Fi Anime Poster
1792513006192_style.prompt: Eighties sci-fi anime poster style, with the feel of retro animation promotional art hand-painted in acrylic and airbrush: characters in simple cel-style line art, backgrounds richly painted in realistic detail with grand futuristic cities and machinery. Deep-sea blue, peacock green and night-sky blue with red accents, cool and lush. Layered volumetric light and cloud scatter, highlights rendered with a soft airbrushed glow. VHS scanlines, slight color drift and print grain. Grand, deep compositions with figures seen from behind in the foreground gazing into the distance; overall an epic, nostalgic, future-yearning retro sci-fi anime feel.

1792513006193_style.name: Serene Block-Plane Flat Oil Painting
1792513006193_style.prompt: Serene block-plane flat oil painting style, oil or gouache forms summarized into even flat planes with short square strokes and crisp boundaries, detail heavily omitted and objects reduced to geometric color planes. Soft gray-blue, olive green, off-white and steady deep green, low-to-medium saturation, with clear blue tones for water and sky. Clear afternoon sun, shadows rendered as single dark shapes, with distinct light and shade. Visible matte texture of canvas and paint. Stable compositions with clear perspective, scenes often empty and sparsely populated; overall a quiet, bright, slightly detached modern figurative painting feel.

1792513006194_style.name: Torn-Paper Collage Surreal Portrait Painting
1792513006194_style.prompt: Torn-paper collage surreal portrait style, figures painted in fine realistic acrylic or oil, overlaid with torn paper strips and misaligned collaged fragments that create surreal breaks and repetitions. Muted, elegant color: powder-blue grounds with deep navy, warm skin and ochre red, soft and unified. Even, soft frontal light with understated volume. Clearly visible torn-paper fibers, canvas grain and print texture. Frontal centered compositions on plain backgrounds, subjects symmetrical and steady; overall a quiet, detached, intriguing contemporary surreal art feel.

1792513006195_style.name: Realistic Graphite Drawing
1792513006195_style.prompt: Realistic graphite drawing style, forms modeled with fine pencil and graphite hatching and blending, precise lines and rich tonal gradations, with detailed rendering of hair and fabric folds. Pure grayscale monochrome with smooth transitions from light gray to deep black and large areas of white paper. Soft side lighting with light cast shadows and believable volume. Paper texture, pencil grain and eraser marks clearly visible. Simple compositions, backgrounds left blank or suggested with a few light strokes, subjects contrasted against white space; overall a quiet, delicate, imaginative realistic drawing feel.

1792513006196_style.name: Eighties Japanese VHS City-Pop Illustration
1792513006196_style.prompt: Eighties city-pop illustration style with a retro Japanese illustration and animation look, characters drawn in fine lines with flat color, vivid red lips and makeup, and fashionable styling. Clear mint cyan and pale blue clashing with bright red and lemon yellow, bright overall with slight fading. Soft indoor daylight with pale shadows and simple highlights. Slight scanlines, color drift and VHS softening with light grain. Everyday compositions with period retro details in the set dressing and languid poses; overall a stylish, lazy, nostalgic urban city-pop atmosphere.

1792513006197_style.name: Eighties Fantasy Film Still
1792513006197_style.prompt: Eighties fantasy film-still style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the still-frame look of eighties practical-effects fantasy adventure films, strongly theatrical costumes and room for physical puppets and prop effects. Warm brown, moss green and ochre red, moderate saturation, warm and soft. Studio soft light imitating daylight with a slight diffusion-filter glow and softened skin. Visible film grain and slightly soft image quality. Mostly two-shots or group medium close-ups against built, softly blurred sets with moderate depth of field; overall a warm, innocent retro fantasy cinema feel with fairy-tale nostalgia.

1792513006198_style.name: Warm-Sepia Colored-Pencil Fairy Tale
1792513006198_style.prompt: Warm-sepia colored-pencil fairy-tale style, drawn with gentle colored-pencil hatching on paper, lines slightly trembling and sketch-like, characters with round heads, small bodies and simple endearing faces. Almost entirely one warm family of sepia brown, ochre yellow and creamy beige with a little orange-brown, warm and low in saturation. Soft lighting with faint light and shade shown through hatching density. Paper texture, pencil grain and light smudging clearly visible. Simple compositions with moderate white space and sparse elements; overall a warm, quiet hand-drawn feel with a touch of lonely fairy tale.

1792513006199_style.name: Vermilion Floral Decorative Illustration
1792513006199_style.prompt: Vermilion floral decorative illustration style, digital painting blending East Asian fine-line gongbi and contemporary graphic illustration, with delicate, tidy lines and slender, cool-toned characters with refined features. Large vermilion grounds paired with ink black, ivory white, pale pink and gray-green, vivid yet elegant. Shading is minimized and nearly flat, with volume shown only by faint washes. Fine paper and pigment grain with a vintage print feel. Full, dense compositions, backgrounds often filled with layered flowers, cloud scrolls and other ornamental patterns; overall a romantic, opulent decorative feel with classical Eastern charm.

1792513006200_style.name: Muted Line-and-Flat-Color Comic
1792513006200_style.prompt: Muted line-and-flat-color comic style, 2D digital illustration with fine, slightly loose ink lines that keep a few sketch lines, flat color and a single shadow layer. Low-saturation grayish palette dominated by dark cyan-gray, deep green, off-white and dark brown, calm and restrained. Diffuse overcast or dusk light with mild contrast. Clean surfaces with slight paper grain. Mostly two-person medium shots against open outdoor backdrops, slender figures with a literary air; overall a quiet, restrained webcomic feel with faint melancholy and ambiguous emotion.

1792513006201_style.name: Pale-Blue Sketch-and-Wash Animation
1792513006201_style.prompt: Pale-blue sketch-and-wash animation style with a 2D hand-drawn feel, loose and lively pencil or ink sketch lines that overlap and keep their rough traces, then light washes of color with plenty of white space. Pale blue and gray-blue as the main tone, accented with warm yellow, orange and light brown, fresh and airy. Minimal shading hinted by faint color patches. Clear paper grain and broken dry strokes. Everyday compositions rich in detail yet relaxed, characters with Japanese anime traits; overall a fresh, gentle, healing slice-of-life sketch-animation feel.

1792513006202_style.name: Teal Shadowy Dream Film
1792513006202_style.prompt: Teal shadowy dream film style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the dreamlike feel of fantasy art-house cinema, often shot through glass, foreground clutter or overlays so that parts of the frame blur. Dark green, cyan-gray and dim amber, low saturation and cool, with pronounced vignetting. Dim, soft ambient light, the subject lit by a faint source while the background sinks into shadow. Coarse grain with slight light leaks and haze. Close framing, often high-angle or detail shots, shallow depth of field and heavy foreground blur; overall a mysterious, hushed, fairy-tale dream atmosphere.

1792513006203_style.name: Teal Minimalist Surreal Painting
1792513006203_style.prompt: Teal minimalist surreal painting style, smoothly applied acrylic or colored pencil with a fine, even stippled texture, simple forms and clean contours. Nearly monochrome, mint green, gray-blue and teal blending softly, low saturation, cool and unified. Soft diffuse light with a little light spilling through gaps or doorways and faint shadows. Fine grain and paper texture. Minimal geometric compositions with large blank walls and empty floors, tiny still figures; overall a quiet, solitary, philosophical surreal mood.

1792513006204_style.name: Fine-Hatched Realistic Comic
1792513006204_style.prompt: Fine-hatched realistic comic style, realistic illustration combining American and European comics, with fine ink lines and dense cross-hatching describing skin, hair and texture, and skin blemishes and creases meticulously drawn. Warm earth yellow and rust red contrasted with cool blue accents, moderate saturation, colored with flat fills and light gradients. High-contrast lighting, shadows layered from hatching and solid black, strong volume. Visible paper texture and print grain. Big close-ups and confrontational close framing; overall a gritty, tough, tense hard-boiled comic feel.

1792513006205_style.name: Soft-Light Close-Up Film Portrait
1792513006205_style.prompt: Soft-light close-up film portrait style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the intimacy of art-house film portraiture, subjects looking straight into the lens, defiant or pensive. Warm skin and milky white against dark olive or deep gray-green backgrounds, low saturation and warm-leaning. Soft side window light with natural facial lighting and smooth shadows, true skin texture and imperfections visible. Fine film grain with a slight vintage color shift. Facial close-ups with centered subjects against clean blurred backgrounds and shallow depth of field; overall a sincere, intimate portrait feel with youthful emotion.

1792513006206_style.name: Seventies-Eighties Faded Color Print
1792513006206_style.prompt: Seventies-eighties faded color-print style, photorealistic live-action photographic work imitating old prints from home film cameras, with a casual snapshot feel. Heavily faded color shifting toward yellow and orange, brownish shadows, washed-out highlights and low saturation. Indoor ceiling or window light with slightly off exposure and low contrast. Coarse grain, prints aged with scratches, creases, mold spots and worn edges. Casual compositions with awkward crops or side angles, moderate depth of field; overall a private, nostalgic feel like pages pulled from an old family album.

1792513006207_style.name: Fresh Ink-Line Paneled Comic
1792513006207_style.prompt: Fresh ink-line paneled comic style, 2D hand-drawn comic illustration with clean, crisp ink outlines, foliage described with small broken strokes and dotted lines, flat color with a few light gradients. Bright, fresh palette of tender green, emerald, sky blue and cloud white, with orange-red blocks as panel borders or accents, lively contrast. Clear daylight with simple flat shadows. Faint paper grain and screentone texture. Often splitting one continuous view into vertical panels, with wide vistas and small scattered figures; overall a bright, leisurely, summery Japanese comic feel.

1792513006208_style.name: Nineties Flash Snapshot
1792513006208_style.prompt: Nineties flash snapshot style, photorealistic live-action photographic work imitating party snapshots taken with a point-and-shoot camera's direct flash, subjects casually posed and looking at the camera. Warm, reddish color, skin brightened by the flash while backgrounds quickly fall off into dark brown, moderate saturation, slightly faded. Hard frontal flash with shadows cast on the wall behind and strong vignetting. Coarse film grain, processing color shifts and light scratches. Casually centered, slightly tilted compositions, people often seated in a row, fairly deep focus; overall a candid, relaxed, private memory with a period party vibe.

1792513006209_style.name: Solid-Ground Minimal Newspaper Strip
1792513006209_style.prompt: Solid-ground minimal newspaper-strip comic style, imitating the hand-drawn simplicity of classic newspaper comic strips, with big-headed, small-bodied characters whose features are a few lines and dots, and slightly wobbly black ink lines. Large areas of solid ground color with black line work and small red and white accents, simple and striking. No shading, completely flat. Messy spiral scribbles often express mood or atmosphere, with printed paper grain. Lots of empty space with characters placed low in the frame, often with speech balloons; overall a humorous, melancholic comic-strip feel with childlike philosophy.

1792513006210_style.name: Dark Paneled Suspense Comic
1792513006210_style.prompt: Dark paneled suspense comic style, 2D digital comic with clear, even ink outlines, realistically proportioned characters and tense, nuanced expressions. Low-saturation dark palette of deep green, cyan-gray and dark olive with a few warm-orange skin tones in contrast, gloomy overall. Localized warm and cool lighting zones, flat blocky shadows and cyan-black darks. Visible paper grain and light screentone. Often arranging several character close-ups side by side in vertical panels for a tense narrative rhythm; overall an oppressive, suspenseful urban-thriller comic feel.

1792513006211_style.name: Gradient-Ground Thin-Line Minimal Cartoon
1792513006211_style.prompt: Gradient-ground thin-line minimal cartoon style, 2D illustration outlined in thin, even black ink lines, extremely simple designs with characters often bean- or blob-shaped and given just two dots for eyes. Large smooth gradient backgrounds shifting from rose pink to orange-yellow, with foreground plants and objects accented in low-saturation colored-pencil texture. Shading nearly omitted. Slight paper grain and faintly wobbly hand-drawn lines. Wide horizontal compositions with low horizons and expansive empty gradient above; overall a humorous, leisurely, slightly absurd magazine-cartoon feel.

1792513006212_style.name: Saturated Hyperreal Acrylic Painting
1792513006212_style.prompt: Saturated hyperreal acrylic painting style, smooth acrylic or oil reaching near-photographic precision with sharp edges and polished surfaces, touched by pop flatness. Pure, highly saturated color, large crisp fields of lemon yellow, cobalt blue and black-and-white checks in strong contrast. Even, bright frontal light with clean, simple shadows. Faintly visible canvas texture. Strictly symmetrical, frontal eye-level compositions, often multi-panel arrangements showing different viewpoints, figures upright and deadpan; overall a tidy, dryly humorous, slightly absurd contemporary realist painting feel.

1792513006213_style.name: Nostalgic Sepia Vintage Photograph
1792513006213_style.prompt: Nostalgic sepia vintage photograph style, photorealistic live-action photographic work imitating silver-gelatin photographs of the twenties and thirties, subjects composed and dignified with period clothing and hair. Fully sepia monochrome, deep brown shadows and cream highlights, soft and low in contrast. Soft window or diffused studio light with delicate gradations. Pronounced paper grain, scratches, spots, yellowing and aging, with slight edge vignetting. Frontal or three-quarter full-length and half-length portraits against simple or archival-textured backgrounds, moderate depth of field; overall a nostalgic, solemn image quality with the weight of a historical archive.

1792513006214_style.name: Naive Densely Patterned Decorative Painting
1792513006214_style.prompt: Naive densely patterned decorative painting style, naive art in flat acrylic or gouache, with childlike forms that ignore perspective and proportion, masses of repeated small elements densely filling the picture, and dot and dash decorations. Bright saturated color: pink grounds with royal blue, bright yellow, red and deep green, lively and colorful. No volumetric shading, fully flat. Visible canvas texture and brushwork. Bird's-eye flat layouts with evenly scattered elements and almost no empty space; overall an innocent, joyful, whimsical folk naive-art feel.

1792513006215_style.name: Stipple-Engraving Color-Clash Collage
1792513006215_style.prompt: Stipple-engraving color-clash collage style, flat collage built from vintage copperplate stipple and line-engraving illustrations, forms made of fine black, white and gray dots and lines, overlaid with large flat blocks of clashing color. Ink black and paper white with fluorescent pink and lemon yellow, bold and striking. Light and shade are expressed through stipple density, with delicate volume and an engraved quality. Pronounced paper grain, print misregistration and halftone texture. Paneled collage compositions juxtaposing images at different scales, often combining surreal symbols and motifs; overall a mysterious, avant-garde, metaphor-rich vintage collage-poster feel.

1792513006216_style.name: Desolate Surreal 3D Scene
1792513006216_style.prompt: Desolate surreal 3D scene style, 3D-rendered minimalist realistic scenes with simple matte materials and clean geometric forms, detail moderately omitted, with the smooth finish of a digital matte painting. Strong contrast between gray-blue skies and vast orange-red ground, supported by gray-white and dark brown, moderate saturation. Low-angle hard raking light with long, sharp shadows and clear volume. Smooth surfaces with almost no grain. Empty, open compositions with level horizons, sparse isolated elements and tiny figures or figures seen from behind; overall a cold, detached, half-dreaming surreal atmosphere.

1792513006217_style.name: Digital Pointillist Rhythmic Decoration
1792513006217_style.prompt: Digital pointillist rhythmic decorative style, 2D digital painting building forms from countless tiny color dots and grains, like pointillism crossed with pixel mosaic, with forms simplified into rounded geometric volumes. Richly layered grass green, emerald, cobalt and lake blue with a little black and pale cyan, bright and saturated. Light and shade are shown by gradients in dot value, with soft volume. Fine, even grain throughout, like fabric or embroidery. Symmetrical, repetitive compositions with evenly spaced elements creating rhythm, horizontal layering and tiny accent figures; overall a serene, fairy-tale decorative atmosphere full of orderly beauty.

1792513006218_style.name: Minimal Bright Negative-Space Photography
1792513006218_style.prompt: Minimal bright negative-space photography style, photorealistic live-action photographic work with the clean look of contemporary design-magazine and exhibition photography, tidy environments with minimal furnishing. Pure white, light gray and beige, accented only by a little warm orange or black, low saturation, clear and bright. Broad, soft diffused daylight with pale, soft-edged shadows and no blown highlights. Sharp, clean images with almost no grain. Symmetrical, balanced compositions with subjects centered or placed low and large blank wall areas, moderate depth of field; overall a quiet, restrained, orderly minimalist aesthetic.

1792513006219_style.name: Impasto Impressionist Plein-Air Oil
1792513006219_style.prompt: Impasto impressionist plein-air oil style, painted in thick oils directly as if from life outdoors, with loose, visible strokes twisting with the forms and layered paint creating pronounced texture and knife and brush marks. Lush color dominated by richly layered emerald and grass greens, interwoven with pink, lavender, cream and sky blue in a warm-cool interplay. Dappled outdoor sunlight, conveyed through warm-cool color shifts rather than value. Canvas texture and paint thickness clearly felt. Natural, spontaneous compositions with perspective depth; overall a lively, sunny, improvised plein-air painting feel.

1792513006220_style.name: Pink Gouache-Crayon Whimsical Illustration
1792513006220_style.prompt: Modern whimsical hand-drawn illustration style, flat 2D drawing that combines gouache flat fills with layered crayon and colored pencil, slightly wobbly hand-drawn lines, and simplified rounded shapes with cute proportions. The palette uses a soft coral-pink ground accented with cobalt blue, olive green, mustard yellow and brick red, moderately saturated and warm. Lighting is nearly flat, with only a few strokes suggesting volume and no strong cast shadows. Paper grain and brush texture are clearly visible, with dense yet orderly detail. Compositions favor eye-level frontal views, horizontal arrangements and all-over decorative layouts. Overall it presents a cozy, playful, handmade children's illustration mood.

1792513006221_style.name: Grainy Gradient Color-Field Minimalism
1792513006221_style.prompt: Grainy-gradient minimalist digital illustration style, 2D, built from large soft gradient color fields; form is implied by shifts in hue and value with almost no outlines. Saturated emerald green, cobalt blue, teal and bright orange bleed into one another in bold warm-cool contrast. Light is diffuse and seems to glow from within the color itself, with no clear source or cast shadows. Fine noise grain covers the whole image, giving a rough screen-print and airbrush texture. Compositions are minimal, placing only tiny silhouettes within vast open fields of color to stress scale. Overall it presents an ethereal, solitary, meditative abstract mood.

1792513006222_style.name: Eastern Neo-Ukiyo-e Flat Illustration
1792513006222_style.prompt: Modern East Asian neo-ukiyo-e flat illustration style, digitally drawn, borrowing crisp outlines, flat color blocks and layered mountain-and-water forms from traditional woodblock prints, softened with modern digital gradients in sky and water. The palette centers on lake blue, teal and indigo-violet, accented with peach pink, vermilion and warm white, bright and saturated yet elegant. Lighting is flattened, with depth expressed through tonal steps rather than realistic shadows. The surface carries subtle paper grain and print texture, and may include vertical calligraphy and seal-like ornaments. Compositions recede through layered foreground, middle ground and distance, often framed by foreground blossoms. Overall it presents a fresh, distant, poetic Eastern atmosphere.

1792513006223_style.name: Quiet Soft-Haze Matte Digital Painting
1792513006223_style.prompt: Quiet soft-haze digital painting style with a hand-painted 2D feel; forms are modeled with soft blended brushes, edges are loose and volumes fluffy like cotton. The palette is desaturated, mainly grey-blue, misty white and beige-grey, with occasional brick-red and moss-green accents. Light is evenly diffused, shadows are faint, with almost no highlights or strong contrast. The finish is matte with subtle grain, paper texture and restrained brushwork. Compositions are simple and stable, favoring level horizons and frontal eye-level views, with sparsely arranged objects and large areas of sky. Overall it presents a calm, dreamy, slightly surreal healing mood.

1792513006224_style.name: 1960s Avant-Garde Fashion Film
1792513006224_style.prompt: 1960s avant-garde fashion film style, live-action realism, photographic, with the feel of a European art-house film still. Styling is bold, often featuring futuristic materials such as mirror-polished metal and glossy plastic with geometric lines. The palette rests on cool white, silver-grey and black, punctuated by pure red, yellow and blue primaries. Lighting is bright, soft top and side light, with sharp specular highlights on metal surfaces. Film grain is fine, colors slightly faded, shadows faintly cyan. Framing favors close-ups and medium close shots, often with blurred foreground obstructions and shallow depth of field. Overall it presents a cool, surreal, experimental retro-futurist fashion mood.

1792513006225_style.name: Naive-Art Lush Decorative Landscape
1792513006225_style.prompt: Naive-art decorative landscape painting style, hand-painted 2D in flat gouache or acrylic, with careful, tidy yet slightly naive brushwork, simplified perspective and orderly arrangement of forms. Elements such as foliage and buildings are densely filled with repeating decorative patterns, layered over and over. The palette features warm ochre-orange and terracotta red with many shades of deep and olive green, under soft apricot and pale blue skies. Lighting is flattened with almost no cast shadows, depth separated by tonal color blocks. Fine canvas and paint texture is visible. Compositions are full but uncluttered, laid out as near-frontal panoramic views. Overall it presents a lush, tranquil, fairy-tale pastoral and exotic charm.

1792513006226_style.name: Sepia Misty Vintage Photograph
1792513006226_style.prompt: Sepia-toned vintage photograph style, live-action realism, photographic, imitating the monochrome look of early silver-gelatin and albumen prints. Tones are warm sepia brown and cream, with dense near-black shadows and soft, whitish highlights. Heavy fog or backlight creates large hazy bright areas, figures often read as silhouettes, with dramatic light-dark contrast. The image carries visible grain, faint scratches, vignetting and soft edge falloff. Compositions are symmetrical and deep, often placing small figures in open space for scale, with soft depth of field. Overall it presents a mysterious, silent, slightly surreal nostalgic dreamscape.

1792513006227_style.name: Impasto Color-Block Patchwork Oil
1792513006227_style.prompt: Impasto color-block patchwork oil painting style, 2D, with thick paint stacked by palette knife and bristle brush into horizontal rectangular blocks that interlock in a staggered patchwork, brush direction clearly visible. The palette is vivid and cheerful: pink, lemon yellow, sky blue, vermilion, deep green and navy side by side, highly saturated yet harmonious. Lighting is almost flat, with space created only by warm-cool contrast between blocks and occasional tiny shadows. Raised paint ridges and canvas texture are very pronounced. Compositions are abstract and geometric, sometimes dotting tiny figures among large color fields for strong contrast of scale. Overall it presents a lively, poetic, slightly lonely contemporary abstract painting mood.

1792513006228_style.name: Dry-Brush Ink Sketch with Pastel Accents
1792513006228_style.prompt: Dry-brush ink sketch style, hand-drawn 2D, quickly outlined with thick black dry brush or charcoal; lines are bold and broken, with dry-brush streaks and frayed edges, and large ink masses swept in to form shapes. Color is extremely restrained, with only small flat touches of pink or orange on cheeks, lips or collars and the rest left as off-white paper. There is no light-and-shadow modeling; everything relies on line and negative space. Paper grain and dry-scrubbed brush marks are clearly visible. Compositions are simple, with the subject centered and lots of empty space. Overall it presents a spontaneous, lively emotional sketch mood with a fashion-illustration feel.

1792513006229_style.name: Blue-Orange Two-Color Pen Sketch
1792513006229_style.prompt: Blue-and-orange two-color pen sketch style, hand-drawn 2D, with quick hatching in blue ballpoint or fountain pen; lines are loose and fluid, forms are built by repeated restated strokes, and vertical hatching conveys tone and texture. Only cobalt blue and orange are used, orange as sparse accents to highlight key points, the rest left as white paper. Light and shadow are expressed purely through line density, without blended rendering. The paper is clean, with natural variation in pen pressure. Compositions feel like on-the-spot sketches, with loose vignetted edges and slightly skewed interior perspective. Overall it presents a light, casual, everyday sketchbook feel.

1792513006230_style.name: Clear-Sky Japanese Anime
1792513006230_style.prompt: Fresh clear-sky Japanese anime style, digitally drawn 2D, close to the background art of modern Japanese animated films; linework is fine, scenery combines soft painterly rendering with flat fills, and clouds are voluminous with crisp edges. Colors are bright and saturated, dominated by sky blue, grass green and white clouds, with small purple and warm-colored flower accents. Light is clear sunshine with gentle backlight and glow, shadows leaning cool blue. The image is clear and delicate, with subtle light flares and depth-of-field blur. Compositions are open with a low horizon and large skies, often with blurred foreground flowers and grass. Overall it presents a bright, nostalgic, summery youthful healing mood.

1792513006231_style.name: Surreal Minimalist Symbolic Painting
1792513006231_style.prompt: Surreal minimalist symbolic digital painting style, 2D yet close to photographic realism, with smooth, refined brushwork; everyday objects are enlarged, distorted or displaced and juxtaposed into dreamlike symbolic images. The palette is desaturated, mainly grey-teal and misty blue skies with warm sand and ochre browns, in gentle warm-cool contrast. Light is soft and even with slight side lighting and faint shadows. The surface has fine grain and a matte finish. Compositions are minimal with wide level horizons, the subject isolated at center or to one side, leaving large areas of sky. Overall it presents a quiet, solitary, thought-provoking surrealist atmosphere.

1792513006232_style.name: Deep Green and Azure Grainy Gouache
1792513006232_style.prompt: Grainy gouache illustration style with a hand-painted 2D feel, combining flat gouache or acrylic with dense dabbed strokes; foliage and water surfaces are built from countless small color flecks, with simplified forms. Colors are rich and saturated: deep azure, ultramarine, grass green and yellow-green, accented with white and warm wood tones. Light is bright summer sunshine, with dappled light expressed through dark green shade shapes and bright yellow flecks. Visible paper grain and print noise cover the image. Compositions often use high-angle views framed by foreground branches, leaving large expanses of water or lawn. Overall it presents a cool, leisurely, summer-holiday literary illustration mood.

1792513006233_style.name: Retro Underground Comix Pen Hatching
1792513006233_style.prompt: Retro American underground comix style, hand-drawn 2D in black pen and ink, with richly varied line weight and heavy cross-hatching, parallel hatching and stippling to build volume and shadow. Characters are exaggerated and comical, with lively expressions and plump proportions, and objects often get quirky anthropomorphic faces. Strictly black and white with no color, with strong contrast between solid blacks and white paper. Light and shadow come from hatching density, with dense dark areas. The paper shows card-stock texture and irregular hand-drawn borders. Compositions are tight, with subjects filling the frame. Overall it presents a gritty, humorous, rebellious retro handmade comic feel.

1792513006234_style.name: 1970s Overcast Desaturated Film
1792513006234_style.prompt: 1970s European art-house film style, live-action realism, photographic, emulating the natural texture of 35mm film. Colors are desaturated, with grey-white skies, camel, grey-green and dark brown and an overall cool grey cast. Light is soft, diffused overcast daylight with no distinct shadows, gentle tonal transitions and slightly blown highlights. Film grain is clearly visible, colors faintly faded, with a slight soft focus. Framing favors medium and close shots, often through foreground elements such as car windows or doorframes, with subjects offset to one side and natural depth of field. Overall it presents a melancholic, detached, poetic nostalgic cinema mood.

1792513006235_style.name: Grainy Airbrushed Volume Illustration
1792513006235_style.prompt: Grainy airbrushed volume illustration style, digitally drawn 2D, using airbrush-like soft gradients and fine noise to model full, rounded volumes; forms are highly simplified with soft edges and a slight 3D-render feel. Colors are vivid and saturated, mainly bright orange and coral pink clashing with cobalt and royal blue, in strong warm-cool contrast. Light is soft, volume is expressed by value gradients, and shadows lean purple. The entire image is covered in grain noise for a frosted texture. Compositions are full, with densely stacked objects and a centered subject. Overall it presents a warm, playful illustration mood with a contemporary design sensibility.

1792513006236_style.name: Pastel Minimalist Surreal Architecture Render
1792513006236_style.prompt: Pastel minimalist surreal architectural rendering style, 3D CG render, built from clean smooth geometric volumes, curved walls and still water, with matte plaster materials and mirror-like water. Colors are soft, mainly dawn or dusk pale pink, lavender, misty blue and sand, low in saturation and airy. Light is gentle twilight or early-morning skylight, with delicate gradients across walls and crisp reflections in the water. The image is clean with almost no grain and a strong sense of atmosphere. Compositions are minimal with broad horizons and large empty areas, figures often tiny in the distance to show scale. Overall it presents a serene, ethereal, dreamlike surreal atmosphere.

1792513006237_style.name: Cobalt Night Coarse-Grain Brushwork
1792513006237_style.prompt: Coarse-grain brushstroke digital painting style, 2D, imitating oil pastel and stiff brush smeared on rough paper; strokes are short and loose, edges of hair and clothing are frayed, and forms are summarized. The palette is strong yet limited: deep cobalt and ultramarine fill large areas, skin is warm orange-brown, with bright yellow accents, in vivid warm-cool contrast. Light is like faint fill light at night, with simple facial modeling. Heavy noise grain and a video-like blur cover the image. Compositions are simple, with a centered subject against a plain background. Overall it presents a contemplative, lonely, retro-tinged nocturnal mood.

1792513006334_style.name: Black-and-White Ink Gray-Tone Manga Style
