Only black, white and gray, a light gray flat base with dark masses for weight. Simple lighting with a few gray tones for volume. Lines carry a slight hand-drawn roughness, backgrounds plain and empty. Mostly frontal bust close-ups with a direct gaze; overall a cool, sharp character quality with an urban noir edge.

1792513006335_style.name: Retro Grainy Print Surreal Illustration Style
1792513006335_style.prompt: Retro surreal illustration style imitating 1970s printed matter: forms are depicted with soft color areas and fine dotted strokes, outlines slightly diffused. Clashing pastel and saturated hues of pink, mint green and sky blue, slightly misregistered like color printing. Gentle lighting, with warm-cool shifts replacing light and dark. Heavy grain and halftone noise across the image with a faded paper feel. Simple compositions with straight horizons, reflections and floating elements adding strangeness; overall a nostalgic, tranquil, album-cover-like dreamy surreal mood.

1792513006336_style.name: Pink-Green Clash Matte Gouache Style
1792513006336_style.prompt: Gouache painting style: forms painted in flat, dense matte color areas, strokes visible but restrained, designs simplified and naive. Bold color clashes, with large fields of deep pink set against dark green, navy and lemon yellow, high in saturation and contrast. Simplified lighting, light sources hinted by a few warm bright accents. Pigment grain and paper texture. Flattened compositions with vertical elements forming a rhythm; overall a quiet, strange contemporary painting quality with a fairy-tale dream feel.

1792513006337_style.name: Faded Street Film Snapshot Style
1792513006337_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work, with the texture of 1970s street snapshots on film. Faded cyan-leaning tones, washed-out highlights, teal-green shadows, low saturation. Strong natural backlight through windows creates silhouettes and bright patches on the floor, with high contrast. Slight motion blur on figures captures the moment. Visible grain and a soft light-leak feel. Often framed through windows or doorways, with dark interiors filling large areas; overall a poetic, lonely documentary mood of urban everyday life.

1792513006338_style.name: Monochrome Red Retro Cel Anime Style
1792513006338_style.prompt: 1990s retro cel anime style: crisp black lines and flat color, characters with finely drawn eyes and brows, cool expressions and flowing clumped hair. A nearly monochrome red palette of vermilion, crimson and black-red with pale skin, strongly contrasted. Hard two-tone shadows with large darkened areas. Grain and slight fading from film transfer. Frequent extreme close-ups and tilted angles; overall a hazy, uneasy, psychological-thriller adult anime quality.

1792513006339_style.name: Misty Teal Minimal Architecture Realistic Render Style
1792513006339_style.prompt: Realistic 3D rendering style: minimalist architectural visualization with clean models, true-to-life materials, simple geometry and minimal furnishings. Nearly monochrome misty teal and gray-green, shadows sinking to black, accented by a single small warm light. Soft diffused light in dense fog with strong aerial perspective, distant layers fading away. Smooth, fine image with slight noise. Symmetrical compositions with pure black framing around the central view; overall a still, ethereal, meditative Zen mood.

1792513006340_style.name: Dusky Surreal Fine-Art Photography Style
1792513006340_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: surrealist fine-art photography. Real settings with off-balance relationships between elements create a fable-like strangeness. Low-saturation cool cyan and gray-blue at dusk with a strip of warm color on the horizon, light-toned subjects brightening the frame. Soft afterglow skylight without obvious shadows. Fine grain, with reflections and symmetrical structures often used to build the image. Open compositions with low horizons and distance between subjects; overall a quiet, lonely, dreamlike poetic mood.

1792513006341_style.name: Black-and-White Stippled Bold Poster Style
1792513006341_style.prompt: Graphic poster illustration style: dense stippling and halftone dots render form and value, details realistic and grainy, surrounded by curling hand-painted black brush squiggles and graphic shapes. Mainly black and white with only small orange accents, strongly contrasted. Light and shade are formed by dot density, highlights left white, shadows deep black. Rough screen-print grain. Enlarged subjects fill the frame edge to edge, with graphics overlapping the subject; overall a bold, brash street-poster visual impact.

1792513006342_style.name: Minimal Single-Line Contour Style
1792513006342_style.prompt: Minimal line-art illustration style: continuous black lines of even weight outline forms, with no shading or hatching, details heavily omitted, shapes rounded and simple. Pure black lines on white, no fill color at all. No lighting; space is conveyed only through overlapping lines and perspective. Clean, smooth lines without paper texture. Simple, airy compositions with lots of white space; overall a fresh, quiet, modern graphic beauty like coloring-book line art.

1792513006343_style.name: Classical Romantic Soft-Pastel Oil Style
1792513006343_style.prompt: Classical Romantic oil painting style: soft, blended brushwork with delicate rendering, edges slightly diffused, detail rich but never sharp. A soft pastel palette of cream white, rose pink, pale green and sky blue, bright and refined. Gentle diffuse daylight with light, translucent shadows and a hazy atmosphere. Canvas texture with a slightly aged sheen. Symmetrical, elegant compositions often using framing to build depth; overall a romantic, nostalgic, dreamy classical stage-set mood.

1792513006344_style.name: Blue-Hour Mist Warm-Window Film Style
1792513006344_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: a misty blue-hour cinematic image. Cool cyan-blue and gray-green dominate, with warm yellow interior light spilling from windows for warm-cool contrast. Faint post-dusk skylight and practical lights, shadows deep yet detailed. Dense fog fills the air, the distance fading away. Fine film grain. Mostly wide medium-to-long shots with figures seen from behind or placed slightly off-center; overall a lonely, mysterious, quietly suspenseful mood.

1792513006345_style.name: Dusk Blue-Orange Clear-Line Flat Illustration Style
1792513006345_style.prompt: Clear-line flat illustration style: fine black lines outline forms filled with flat color, almost no shading, moderate detail. Dusk gradients shift from deep blue to an orange-red horizon, with warm orange accents and soft warm-cool contrast. Lighting conveys time through the graded sky, subjects often silhouetted or backlit. Slight grain. Frequent frame-within-frame compositions with figures mostly seen from behind at center; overall a quiet, nostalgic, slightly lonely lo-fi music illustration mood.

1792513006346_style.name: Warm-Brown Low-Key Humanist Film Style
1792513006346_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: a warm-brown, low-key humanist cinematic image. Colors of deep brown, amber and dark green at moderate saturation, with warm skin tones. Soft side light from a window or desk lamp lights the face while the background stays dark, with clear contrast. Film grain and slight soft focus, shadow detail retained. Shallow depth of field with blurred foreground occlusion and medium close-up framing; overall a calm, weighty, bookish nostalgic narrative mood.

1792513006347_style.name: Cool-Blue Night-Glow Storybook Animation Style
1792513006347_style.prompt: 2D storybook animation style: painted with soft digital brushes, rounded, simplified, cute designs without obvious outlines, backgrounds with dry-brush texture. Varying shades of cool blue dominate, lit locally by warm yellow light sources for a cozy warm-cool contrast. Light comes from glowing objects in the scene, producing soft halos and rim light with translucent shadows. Fine grain and hand-painted texture. Simple compositions with negative space and centered subjects; overall a quiet, tender animated-short mood of a fairy-tale night.

1792513006348_style.name: Orange Monochrome Silhouette Sci-Fi Film Style
1792513006348_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: a monochrome orange sci-fi cinematic image. Bathed in rich orange-red and ochre, nearly monochrome, with deep brown shadows. Strong backlight and glowing light sources in haze turn subjects into clean silhouettes. Thick haze in the air with fading layers. Mirror-like reflections are often used for vertical symmetry. Clean image with slight grain. Minimal, symmetrical compositions with tiny figures; overall a grand, desolate, surreal epic sci-fi mood.

1792513006349_style.name: Direct-Flash Film Vintage Fashion Portrait Style
1792513006349_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: direct-flash film fashion portraiture. On-camera flash fired straight on gives bright skin highlights, short hard shadows and a background falling quickly into darkness. Rich, saturated colors with true-to-life detail in lips, freckles and skin texture, warm shadows. Film grain and slight color casts, raw and direct in texture. Mostly tight close-ups with the subject looking straight into the lens; overall a candid, rebellious mood with a vintage magazine-editorial feel.

1792513006350_style.name: Dark Haze Glow Lo-Fi Photography Style
1792513006350_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: lo-fi imagery where haze and light sources intertwine in darkness. Most of the frame sinks into black, lit locally by cool white and warm orange light, with smoke diffusing it into soft halos. Tones contrast cool white and gray-blue with warm orange. Underexposed with blown highlights, details swallowed by haze. Digital noise and slight blur, as if shot on an early digital camera. Simple, casual compositions with centered subjects; overall a faint, mysterious, ghostly dreamlike mood.

1792513006351_style.name: Orange-Gray Gradient Soft-Focus Silhouette Style
1792513006351_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: soft-focus silhouette art imagery. Subjects appear as dark silhouettes with soft, out-of-focus edges and hidden detail. Backgrounds are broad, smooth gradients from rich orange-red to gray-violet, saturated and warm. Strong backlight spreads into a hazy veil of light through mist and soft-focus optics. Fine grain. Minimal compositions with ample empty space and the subject to one side; overall an ethereal, quiet lyrical mood blurred like memory.

1792513006352_style.name: Green-Toned Surreal Staged Photography Style
1792513006352_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: surrealist staged photography. Carefully built and dressed sets where figures, costumes, furniture and walls are unified in a near-monochrome green, accented with intricate patterns and spots of warm pink lamplight for contrast. Soft, even interior lighting with faint shadows. A sharp, richly detailed image with a slight film texture. Frontal, eye-level, symmetrical and stable compositions with figures frozen as if posed; overall an absurd, dreamy surreal mood with dark humor.

1792513006353_style.name: Low-Key Side-Lit Documentary Texture Style
1792513006353_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: a low-key, high-contrast documentary portrait. A single hard side light illuminates the face and parts of the scene while large areas sink into shadow, strong chiaroscuro sculpting volume. Low-saturation tones of dark brown, charcoal and cool gray. Textures are emphasized, with skin and surface detail crisp, slight grain and sharpening. Large blurred foreground occlusion and medium close-up framing; overall a somber, weighty realism full of story.

1792513006354_style.name: Warm-Orange Gouache Pattern Landscape Style
1792513006354_style.prompt: Folk-art gouache illustration: forms built from flat color areas and repeated dashes, dots and arcs, simplified into rounded decorative shapes with visible strokes. Bright, fervent colors with saturated orange-yellow, coral red, pink-violet and lake blue side by side, warm hues dominant. No realistic lighting. Matte gouache grain and paper texture. Full, layered compositions with elements arranged in rhythm; overall a cheerful, warm, decorative and playful mood.

1792513006355_style.name: Warm-Teal Clash Motion Ghosting Photography Style
1792513006355_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: slow-shutter motion-blur art imagery. Figures and forms show clear streaks and ghosting, outlines dissolving into motion, details blurred. A soft clash of warm pink-orange and teal green at moderate saturation. Soft, diffused light, warm on the subject while the cool background falls darker. Film grain and soft-focus glow. Simple compositions with the subject on one side and a plain background; overall an ethereal, fleeting, dreamlike mood like a memory flashback.

1792513006356_style.name: Purple-Pink Videotape Glitch Vaporwave Style
1792513006356_style.prompt: Vaporwave retro digital art style: scenes painted with soft gradients and smooth color shapes, overlaid with videotape scanlines, color misregistration and glitch noise. Rich purple, pink and lavender dominate, saturated and dreamy. Light often comes from a huge setting sun or a neon-like glow, the whole image glowing softly. Old-videotape blur, horizontal streaks and grain. Steady compositions with clear near-far layering; overall a nostalgic, psychedelic retro-futurist dreamscape.

1792513006357_style.name: Warm Sunlight Soft Film Selfie Style
1792513006357_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: close-range, film-textured portraits in warm sunlight. Slanting afternoon sun falls across the face, strands of hair casting fine shadows, highlights soft and golden. Warm yellow against pale blue, low saturation, skin luminous and natural. Film grain and slight soft focus with true detail retained. Mostly close low angles or handheld selfie viewpoints with the subject looking into the lens; overall a languid, intimate everyday mood with youthful nostalgia.

1792513006358_style.name: Cobalt-Yellow-Pink Tricolor Anime Pop Style
1792513006358_style.prompt: Anime pop illustration style: black outlines of varied weight, flat color with almost no gradients, shadows expressed by another hard-edged color block. The palette is limited mainly to cobalt blue, bright yellow and pink, high in value and saturation with strong block contrast, like stencil-print color layering. Graphic lighting, with forms built from stacked color layers. Slight grain. Dynamic compositions with scattered elements and long-limbed figures; overall a bright, trendy, energetic graphic anime quality.

1792513006359_style.name: Dusky Eerie Realist Fantasy Painting Style
1792513006359_style.prompt: Realist fantasy digital painting style: delicate brushwork renders near-photographic forms and environments while keeping a soft painterly touch. Cool gray-blue dusk skies are set against wide magenta and crimson ground, with glowing red points of light. Dim post-sunset skylight with soft shadows and damp, cold air. Fine grain. Open, far-reaching compositions with elements arranged like silhouettes in the middle ground; overall an eerie, mysterious surreal mood with the air of folklore.

1792513006360_style.name: Black-and-White Window-Light Chiaroscuro Photography Style
1792513006360_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: black-and-white chiaroscuro photography. Strong direct window light serves as the only key, casting crisp light patches and window-frame shadows across floors and walls, with large areas falling into black. Rich black-and-white tonality with clean whites and delicate midtones. Fine silver-gelatin grain. Rigorous, stable compositions, often medium-wide shots with symmetrical depth and the subject placed within the light beam; overall a classical, calm, sculptural fine-art photography mood.

1792513006361_style.name: Faded Cyan Old Film Snapshot Style
1792513006361_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work, with the texture of 1970s–80s film snapshots. Faded cyan-leaning colors, whitened highlights, teal shadows, aged reds, low saturation overall. Natural indoor light or daylight, plain and soft, slightly overexposed. Visible grain, slight light leaks and color casts. Casual candid compositions with subjects looking into the lens and busy backgrounds; overall a raw, authentic, nostalgic personal-album mood.

1792513006362_style.name: Dense-Fog Night Practical-Light Film Style
1792513006362_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: a cinematic night scene shrouded in dense fog. Light comes from practical sources such as streetlamps, car lights and windows, forming soft halos and volumetric light in the fog that illuminate parts of the environment. Deep blue-black base tones with restrained accents of warm yellow and dark red. Deep shadows, highlights never blown. Fine film grain. Open compositions with small centered figures, mostly locked-off medium-to-wide shots; overall a lonely, suspenseful film mood like a frozen narrative tableau.

1792513006363_style.name: Dark-Red Warm Wide-Angle Close-Up Film Style
1792513006363_style.prompt: Live-action realism, photographic work: a dark-red, warm cinematic close shot. A wide-angle lens close to the subject gives slight perspective distortion, the subject facing the camera with an oppressive presence. Dark red, amber and deep brown dominate, with cool lights dotting the background. Low-level warm practical light lights the face evenly and softly while the surroundings darken. Film grain and slight soft focus. Rich but blurred background detail; overall a mysterious, tense, intimate mood with a thriller undertone.

1792513006364_style.name: Porcelain Fine-Line Dark Fairy-Tale Illustration Style
1792513006364_style.prompt: Refined digital painting style: smooth, delicate brushwork and fine linework, skin pale and glossy like white porcelain, eyes vacant and ethereal, hair drawn in layered fine strands. Ivory white, rich true red and dark gold dominate, contrast striking yet saturation restrained. Soft, even lighting with faint shadows, volume shaped by subtle gradients. Smooth, polished surface with slight paper texture. Intricate, compact compositions with elements layered around the subject; overall a lavish, uncanny surreal mood with a dark fairy-tale temperament.

1792513006365_style.name: Peach-Ground Dotted Decorative Illustration Style
1792513006365_style.prompt: Decorative folk-style illustration: simplified forms in flat color with clean outlines, surfaces covered in small dots, short dashes and floral-leaf patterns, naive yet ornamental. A peach-pink ground with bright orange-red, lemon yellow, lake blue and pink-violet, warm and soft. No realistic lighting. Slight paper grain and a hand-drawn feel. Horizontally spread compositions with densely layered foreground elements and generous empty space above; overall a gentle, romantic narrative mood rich in folk-pattern charm.

1792513006366_style.name: Minimalist Stage Silhouette Cinema Style
1792513006366_style.prompt: Minimalist, stage-like cinematic style; live-action photorealistic photography. Frames are built from large planes of bare white geometric walls and generous negative space, with clean lines and smooth, refined surfaces. The palette is nearly monochrome, mainly grey-white, charcoal black and pale mist grey, with very low saturation. Soft skylight and diffused side light set foreground silhouettes against bright areas for strong contrast, while floors and water carry mirror-like reflections. Texture is clean with almost no grain. Composition favors symmetrical, centered deep-perspective views from a fixed wide-angle camera with deep focus. Overall it presents a quiet, ethereal, ritualistic minimalist cinematic image.

1792513006367_style.name: 1980s Japanese Airbrush Portrait Illustration Style
1792513006367_style.prompt: 1980s Japanese retro airbrush illustration style, digitally hand-drawn to mimic an airbrush. Skin is shaped with smooth, delicate airbrushed gradients, facial lines are precise and crisp, eyes are rendered realistically with clarity and rich color, and lip and eye makeup have sharply defined contours. Colors are highly saturated and clashing, with large blocks of orange-red, royal blue, bright yellow and emerald green side by side and backgrounds often in flat solid color. Lighting is soft and even with clean highlights. A slight printed-paper feel with almost no visible brushwork. Composition favors close-up figures and side-by-side split-panel layouts. Overall it presents a chic, vivid pop illustration with the feel of a retro magazine cover.

1792513006368_style.name: Airy Watercolor Ink-Line Fairy-Tale Illustration Style
1792513006368_style.prompt: Hand-painted watercolor fairy-tale illustration style. Fine, lively brown-black ink lines outline the forms with a slightly wavering handmade quality; loose, airy watercolor washes, with small patterns and dots added here and there. Colors are soft and light, mainly grey-blue, warm ochre and pale beige with small touches of vermilion. Lighting is flat and gentle with almost no modeling of light and shade. Paper texture and large areas of white space are preserved, with natural watermark edges. Compositions are simple with the subject centered against a blank background; characters and animals are rounded and cute with slightly exaggerated proportions. Overall it presents a warm, tranquil, playful picture-book storytelling feel.

1792513006369_style.name: Muted Crayon Naive Illustration Style
1792513006369_style.prompt: Digital crayon hand-drawn illustration style, imitating the rough, dry strokes of crayon and chalk with fuzzy, frayed edges; outlines are irregular and come and go, and many short repeated scribbles form patterns. Colors are low-saturation greyish tones, with soft brick red, mustard, grey-blue and off-white on a warm grey ground. Mostly flat fills with almost no shading, only small touches such as blushed cheeks. Paper grain is clearly visible. Composition is flat, with repeated elements filling the frame; figures are simplified and naive, with big heads and round faces. Overall it presents a quiet, gentle handmade feel with the charm of a child's doodle.

1792513006370_style.name: Blood-Red Dusk Gothic Fantasy Illustration Style
1792513006370_style.prompt: Dark gothic fantasy illustration style, digital impasto combined with traditional illustration techniques; gothic organic and ornamental lines twist intricately, and dark areas are largely rendered as silhouettes. Blood-red and burnt-orange skies contrast with ink-black foregrounds, while the midground reveals dark green and earthy yellow. Lighting is strong backlight and twilight sky glow with extreme contrast and deeply crushed shadows. The image carries paper grain and brush texture. Composition favors symmetrical framing and depth guidance, with the foreground framing a distant focal point. Overall it presents an eerie, suspenseful fantasy atmosphere with the feel of a classic horror tale.

1792513006371_style.name: Black-and-White Organic Cut-Paper Graphic Style
1792513006371_style.prompt: Abstract organic cut-paper graphic style, made in a flat paper-cutout manner: full black silhouette shapes with rounded, jagged or wavy edges grow freely like plants, droplets and spots. Colors are high-contrast black and white with small accents of bright cobalt blue. No light-and-shadow modeling; fully flat. Paper texture and the slight irregularity of hand-cut edges are preserved. Compositions are all-over with an uneven rhythm, positive and negative shapes interlocking like a decorative pattern. Overall it presents a bold, lively modern graphic art feel with primitive charm.

1792513006372_style.name: Cobalt Two-Color Screen Print Style
1792513006372_style.prompt: Two-color screen-print portrait style: features and light and shade are summarized into large solid silhouette shapes, forms reduced to clear color-block boundaries, with details and transitions omitted. Only two colors, cobalt blue and cream, act as each other's positive and negative space in high contrast. No realistic lighting; lit planes and shadows are split purely by color blocks. Print grain, ink-bleed mottling and paper texture are prominent. Composition favors extreme close-ups with the subject filling and cropped by the frame. Overall it presents a calm, restrained, striking graphic poster look.

1792513006373_style.name: 1970s Warm-Gold Retro Film Style
1792513006373_style.prompt: 1970s retro film-photography style; live-action photorealistic photography with rich detail and clearly visible material and fabric textures. The palette is warm gold, amber, olive green and ochre brown, warm overall with medium-low saturation. Low-angle raking sunlight breaks into dappled patches; highlights are mellow, shadows rich, and tonal layering dramatic. Fine film grain and a slight soft glow. Composition favors medium-wide environmental portraits framed by layered foregrounds, with moderate depth of field. Overall it presents a languid, luxurious, nostalgic retro-fashion cinematic feel.

1792513006374_style.name: Muted Shallow-Focus Slice-of-Life Cinema Style
1792513006374_style.prompt: Slice-of-life cinematic realism; live-action photorealistic photography, shooting people up close with a wide-angle lens and a wide aperture so the background softly blurs. Colors are low-saturation and cool, with cyan-grey and dark green set softly against warm skin tones. Natural window light gives delicate tonal transitions with slightly gloomy shadows. Light film grain and a soft-focus quality. Composition favors a centered subject looking straight into the lens, with mild barrel distortion at the edges and the surroundings retained in the blur. Overall it presents an intimate, quiet, slightly melancholic indie-film texture.

1792513006375_style.name: 1950s Retro Surreal Print Style
1792513006375_style.prompt: Retro-futurist surreal illustration style, flat drawing that imitates 1950s print: forms are built from summarized silhouette shapes and simple shading, with geometric spheres floating in the frame. Colors are faded teal, coral red, grey-green and ink black, a low-saturation vintage palette. Lighting is flat with dramatic blocky shadows. Aged paper, halftone dots, scratches and worn edges are evident. Composition favors figures walking in a horizontal procession and frames split by the horizon, with juxtaposed elements creating absurdity. Overall it presents a nostalgic, serene, dreamlike surreal vintage print.

1792513006376_style.name: Clear High-Saturation Misty Film Style
1792513006376_style.prompt: High-saturation misty film-photography style; live-action photorealistic photography with crisp detail and true-to-life textures. Colors are vivid and saturated, with rose red, emerald green and sky blue bright and clear and a slight cyan cast overall. Soft outdoor daylight with a thin haze in the air, distant layers fading out. Fine film grain and a subtle halation. Composition favors a figure seen from behind within a vast scene, with rich foreground layers, deep focus and an open viewpoint. Overall it presents a bright, romantic, lyrical image tinged with nostalgia.

1792513006377_style.name: Cobalt Decorative Fauvist Oil Style
1792513006377_style.prompt: Fauvist expressionist oil-painting style with bold, visible brushstrokes and impasto texture; forms are simplified, figures outlined with dark lines, and backgrounds filled with broad-stroke floral and leaf motifs. Cobalt blue and cream dominate, accented with bright yellow and orange-red in strongly contrasting, non-naturalistic color blocks. Lighting is flattened, with warm and cool color blocks replacing light and shade. Canvas and paint texture are clearly visible. Composition favors a centered half-length figure interwoven with the decorative background. Overall it presents a bright, passionate, highly decorative modern-art image.

1792513006378_style.name: Layered Paper Sculpture Style
1792513006378_style.prompt: Layered three-dimensional paper sculpture style with the look of real paper craft shot in a studio: forms are built from stacked quilled, cut and folded paper, everything assembled from paper pieces, with curled strips forming spiral patterns. Colors are deep teal, moss green, orange-yellow and ochre red, soft yet rich. Soft studio top light casts crisp small shadows between paper layers for a strong sense of volume. Paper fibers and cut edges look real. Composition is clearly layered, with foreground, midground and background stacked like a stage set and the subject centered. Overall it presents a delicate, warm, tactile handmade paper fairy-tale world.

1792513006379_style.name: Overcast Muted Poetic Cinema Style
1792513006379_style.prompt: Poetic realist cinema style; live-action photorealistic photography with an unadorned, natural look and true-to-life textures. Colors are low-saturation, with an overcast grey-blue sky echoing grass green, earthy yellow and olive. Soft diffused overcast light with almost no cast shadows and gentle tonal shifts. Light film grain. Composition favors low-angle shots, large areas of empty sky and a low horizon, with figures scattered across the frame and moments of movement often captured. Overall it presents a free, innocent art-house film feel with a fable-like quality.

1792513006380_style.name: Dark-Green Misty Soft-Focus Film Style
1792513006380_style.prompt: Impressionistic blurred film-photography style; live-action photorealistic photography that deliberately uses soft focus, slow shutter and camera shake so detail dissolves, keeping only contours and mood. Colors are low-saturation and dark, mainly ink green, olive brown and grey-white mist. Diffuse skylight in thick fog, no clear shadows, hazy tonal transitions. Pronounced film grain and fading. Composition favors a figure in an empty setting with large areas of fog as negative space. Overall it presents a lonely, dreamy, elusive emotional image.

1792513006381_style.name: Dark-Ground Dissolving Particle Dotwork Style
1792513006381_style.prompt: Particle dotwork digital-art style: countless tiny dots build up forms, their density setting light and dark, with edges gradually scattering into particles as if dissolving. Colors are mainly cool blue and misty white, with warm orange and flesh red showing through in places, set against pure black. Strong side light pushes highlights almost to white while shadows are swallowed by black. The whole image carries a grain like analog film and screen light points. Composition favors extreme close-ups with the subject partly cropped. Overall it presents a mysterious, ethereal, dreamlike feeling between substance and nothingness.

1792513006382_style.name: Fine Pen Stipple Engraving Style
1792513006382_style.prompt: Pen stippling and line-engraving illustration style: dense ink dots and cross-hatching model volume and tone, lines are precise and fine, and hair is drawn in layers of flowing curves, with the rigor of traditional copperplate engraving. Monochrome black ink on beige paper. Classical side lighting, with tonal transitions built from gradations in dot and line density. Paper fibers and embossed texture are preserved. Composition favors a centered subject surrounded by generous white space, like a small print. Overall it presents a classic, refined, enduring hand-engraved quality.

1792513006383_style.name: Dark-Ground Pastel Doodle Illustration Style
1792513006383_style.prompt: Pastel and crayon doodle illustration style: rough chalk and oil-pastel strokes fill shapes flatly, edges are fuzzy, forms are simplified into rounded blobs, and faces are suggested with just a few lines. Royal blue, pink, orange-red, lavender, black and white sit vividly side by side on a dark purple ground. Almost no lighting; flat treatment. Stroke texture and paper grain are clearly visible. Compositions are all-over with dense, repeated elements forming a lively pattern. Overall it presents a naive, whimsical, slightly dreamy hand-drawn charm.

1792513006384_style.name: Warm Light-Leak Ghosting Film Style
1792513006384_style.prompt: Retro film snapshot style; live-action photorealistic photography shot up close with a wide-angle lens, with slight distortion. Colors are dim warm orange, amber and brown, low in saturation and dark. Indoor tungsten light creates light leaks, flares and streaks, along with ghosting and double-exposure effects. Heavy film grain with slightly soft detail. Casual composition like a selfie or handheld snapshot, with obvious edge vignetting. Overall it presents a private, hazy, nostalgic blend of early-digital and film textures.

1792513006385_style.name: Fine Stippled Quiet Picture-Book Style
1792513006385_style.prompt: Stippled-grain picture-book illustration style: fine digital stipple brushes and noise build forms with soft, fluffy edges and simple, rounded shapes. Colors are low-saturation ink green, brick red, grey-blue and off-white, soft and vintage. Lighting is simple, with blocks of cast shadow implying the light source and soft shadows. A uniform grain covers the whole image like sandblasted print. Composition is flat, often placing subjects in simple settings framed with a white border. Overall it presents a quiet, gentle, slightly mysterious vintage picture-book mood.

Soft studio lighting, faint shadows and a slightly shallow depth of field to emphasize the materials. Eye-level horizontal staging with a strong theatrical feel. Overall it feels warm, quiet and full of handmade childlike charm.

1792513006533_style.name: Playful Marker Children's Drawing Style
1792513006533_style.prompt: Playful marker children's-drawing style: thick black outlines drawn freehand with slight wobble and irregularity, simplified naive shapes, round-headed small-bodied figures with simple expressions. Bright, saturated marker fills with visible overlapping strokes and missed white spots, combining navy, orange and grey-green. Almost no lighting, only flat color shapes with a few little star accents. Clean paper with ample white space. Simple compositions with the subject centered and other elements lined along the bottom edge. Overall it feels innocent, playful and friendly, like a children's picture-book doodle.

1792513006534_style.name: Grainy Soft-Focus Diffused Illustration Style
1792513006534_style.prompt: Grainy soft-focus diffused illustration style: digital painting emulating airbrush and stippling, edges softened and scattered, tone and volume built from dense grain, forms kept simple. A two-pole gradient of cobalt blue and warm apricot with soft transitions and moderate saturation. Soft diffuse light with no clear source, highlights glowing through like mist. Even grain noise across the image, close to a screen-print or risograph texture. Simple compositions with the subject in profile on one side and a broad gradient field on the other. Overall it feels quiet, hazy and gently melancholic.

1792513006535_style.name: Warm-Brown Low-Key Cinematic Portrait Style
1792513006535_style.prompt: Warm-brown low-key cinematic portrait style, live-action realism, photographic work: close-ups with shallow depth of field and layered background blur, rendering people with rich, realistic texture. Warm brown, amber and dark olive dominate with suppressed saturation and a retro grade. Dim, tungsten-like warm side light creates soft but defined modeling with deep shadows. Noticeable film grain with crisp material detail. Grounded compositions, subjects centered or slightly off-center, the gaze carrying emotional tension. Overall it feels brooding, refined and steeped in period storytelling.

1792513006536_style.name: Retro Three-Color Screen-Print Flat Style
1792513006536_style.prompt: Retro three-color screen-print flat style: digital illustration imitating silkscreen, thin dark outlines, forms reduced to flat color shapes, natural forms summarized with decorative scalloped contours. The palette is limited to a few spot colors, saturated cobalt blue and cream with a touch of orange-red, all flat fills with no gradients. Shadows are indicated by a single darker layer, with no volumetric rendering. Slight ink grain and misregistration on the paper. Simple compositions with large solid backgrounds, subjects pressed to one side or the bottom, framed by a cream border. Overall it feels clean and quiet, with the urban poetry of a retro poster.

1792513006537_style.name: Saturated Candy-Color Geometric 3D Style
1792513006537_style.prompt: Saturated candy-color geometric 3D style: 3D render where forms are built from simplified cones, domes and arches with smooth matte surfaces and rounded silhouettes, like soft toys. A high-saturation palette boldly mixing royal blue, lemon yellow, coral red, lavender and cream, often against a clean deep blue gradient. Soft global ambient light and diffuse shading, gentle shadows and subtle gradient highlights between forms. Clean, grain-free finish. Layered staging with staggered depth and a strong theatrical feel. Overall it feels cheerful, playful and very modern, like a toy world.

1792513006538_style.name: Western 2D Narrative Animation Style
1792513006538_style.prompt: Western 2D narrative animation style: characters drawn with clean lines of varying weight and layered cel coloring, exaggerated designs with big noses, thin limbs and lively expressions, set against richly layered, hand-painted backgrounds. Grey-blue teal contrasted with warm orange-brown at moderate saturation. Dramatic lighting, local light sources creating clear warm-cool zones and volume. Slight brush grain in the textures. Cinematic, storyboard-like compositions with clear spatial depth and abundant scene detail. Overall it feels warm, humorous and story-rich like a feature animation.

1792513006539_style.name: 1970s Retro Fashion Editorial Style
1792513006539_style.prompt: 1970s retro fashion editorial style, live-action realism, photographic work: the set dressing and styling of mid-to-late 20th-century magazine fashion photography, with carefully arranged props. Retro, saturated yet slightly faded color, pink, mustard, mint and orange candy tones echoing one another. A soft diffused key light evenly illuminates the subjects, with light shadows and warm skin. Fine film grain and a warm color shift. Frontal, eye-level, symmetrical centered framing with clearly posed figures. Overall it feels playful, nostalgic and steeped in retro pop culture.

1792513006540_style.name: Pink-Toned Showa Shoujo Anime Style
1792513006540_style.prompt: Pink-toned Showa shoujo anime style, with the look of hand-painted 1980s Japanese cel animation: clean thin linework, characters with large eyes, voluminous curly hair and simplified features, expressions delicate. A soft pink, peach and pale teal palette with gentle low saturation, against watercolor-like hand-painted backgrounds. Simple two-tone cel shading with soft diffused light. Film grain and slight fading. Close framing, mostly quiet everyday viewpoints. Overall it feels nostalgic, languid and wistful in the manner of Showa-era anime.

1792513006541_style.name: Modern Chinese Guochao Line-and-Flat Illustration
1792513006541_style.prompt: Modern Chinese guochao line-and-flat illustration: fine black outlines blended with traditional Eastern motifs such as auspicious clouds and waves, large areas laid out with dense parallel wavy lines. Slight paper grain. Layered, scroll-like compositions with floating, overlapping elements, highly decorative and poster-like. Overall it feels lively, fantastical and mythically Eastern with a contemporary sensibility.

1792513006542_style.name: Flocked High-Saturation Dreamy 3D Style
1792513006542_style.prompt: Flocked high-saturation dreamy 3D style: 3D render with surfaces covered in fine fuzz or flocking, forms rounded and puffy, soft like plush toys. A highly saturated palette led by sapphire blue with orange-yellow, grass green and pink-violet, skies in pink-blue dusk gradients. Soft daylight plus ambient light, fine highlights along fuzzy edges and gentle shadows. Rich material detail with moderate depth of field. Open, deep compositions where layered rounded forms lead the eye into the distance. Overall it feels fantastical, healing and dreamlike, like a fairy-tale playland.

1792513006543_style.name: Fisheye Distortion Raw Snapshot Style
1792513006543_style.prompt: Fisheye distortion raw snapshot style, live-action realism, photographic work: an ultra-wide fisheye shoots up close, the edges bending hard, perspective wildly exaggerated, with round vignetting in the corners. Rough, unretouched images with digital noise. Selfie-style or in-your-face viewpoints with the subject dominating the center. Overall it feels restless, raw and charged with underground youth culture.

1792513006544_style.name: Frenetic Pen-Hatching Sketch Style
1792513006544_style.prompt: Frenetic pen-hatching sketch style: a black dip pen or fineliner dashed off quickly, sharp lines with dense cross-hatching, hurried strokes with jitter and stray lines, the raw marks of sketching left unpolished. Pure black and white, heavy ink lines in strong contrast with wide blank areas, shadows pushed dark by layer upon layer of hatching. Light and form defined by line density with dramatic contrast. Overlapping pen marks visible on the paper. Cinematic foreground-background layering, faces rendered intently while backgrounds stay scrawled. Overall it feels tense, agitated and emotionally charged.

1792513006545_style.name: Night-Blue Warm-Glow Airbrush Illustration
1792513006545_style.prompt: Night-blue warm-glow airbrush illustration: digital airbrushing models forms with soft gradients, rounded hazy edges and fine stippled grain over the surface. Varied night blues form the body of the palette, accented by orange-red warm light in a vivid yet gentle cool-warm contrast. Light usually comes from local warm sources diffusing outward, the ground glowing faintly. Fine grain throughout, like an old print. Open compositions with layered distant backdrops, subjects simplified into rounded silhouettes. Overall it feels quiet, fantastical and tenderly eerie, like a nocturnal fairy tale.

1792513006546_style.name: High-Contrast Coarse-Grain Black-and-White Photography
1792513006546_style.prompt: High-contrast coarse-grain black-and-white photography, live-action realism, photographic work: shot on high-speed black-and-white film with heavy grain and intense tonality. Pure monochrome with deep blacks, bright whites and compressed midtones. Overcast diffuse light or strong overhead light defines crisp outlines and gritty texture. Often slight vignetting and soft edges. Humanist documentary framing with the subject centered and gazing frontally into the lens, the blurred background hinting at the setting. Overall it feels austere, poetic and nostalgic with a personal-photography sensibility.

1792513006547_style.name: Cobalt Flat Line Illustration Style
1792513006547_style.prompt: Cobalt flat line illustration style: thin dark outlines, rounded simplified forms, natural foliage condensed into clumps and dotted textures. Cobalt and ultramarine lead the palette with mint, pale grey-green and a few orange accents, mostly flat fills with light grainy shading in places. Simple lighting, depth separated by darker and lighter tones within the same hue family. Clean paper with subtle texture. Open compositions progressing layer by layer from foreground to middle ground to distance. Overall it feels fresh, peaceful and gently playful.

1792513006548_style.name: Night Direct-Flash Dark-Frame Snapshot Style
1792513006548_style.prompt: Night direct-flash dark-frame snapshot style, live-action realism, photographic work: at night an on-camera flash lights the foreground, faces turning white and flat while backgrounds plunge into black. Cool color, pale skin, pure black shadows with a few warm reflections. Heavy black borders surround the image, as if seen through an old viewfinder or screen. Noticeable grain and noise with slight misfocus. Frontal eye-level framing, subjects staring blankly into the lens. Overall it feels eerie, private and like an underground nighttime documentary.

1792513006549_style.name: Retro Album-Sleeve Faded Photo Style
1792513006549_style.prompt: Retro album-sleeve faded photo style, live-action realism, photographic work: photographs boosted as if hand-tinted and printed on worn cardboard, with creases, scratches and fading at the edges. Saturated retro color, pink, lush green, bold red and warm yellow clashing. Bright daylight with cool shadows. Printing dots and paper grain throughout. Eye-level wide framing that fills the frame with the whole scene, with cover-like margins. Overall it feels nostalgic, languid and slightly surreal in a retro pop-record aesthetic.

1792513006550_style.name: Neon Streak Dragged-Shutter Style
1792513006550_style.prompt: Neon streak dragged-shutter style, live-action realism, photographic work: a slow shutter combined with flash and a moving camera, the subject frozen by the flash while background neon smears into long light trails. Coarse grain and film-like color shifts. Tilted, off-balance framing with the subject off-center. Overall it feels hazy, restless and charged with nightlife speed and emotional tension.

1792513006551_style.name: Misty-Blue Dusk Split-Frame Film Style
1792513006551_style.prompt: Misty-blue dusk split-frame film style, live-action realism, photographic work: shot at dusk in thick fog, distances dissolving and figures mostly blurred silhouettes, the frame often divided into multiple panels or by glass partitions. Misty blue and grey-teal dominate, with a few warm yellow point lights. Low, diffuse light with almost no hard shadows. Visible film grain and local motion blur from a slow shutter. Eye-level horizontal compositions with figures standing at staggered distances. Overall it feels lonely, aloof, suspenseful and poetic with a cool cinematic mood.

1792513006552_style.name: 1950s Color Pulp Comic Style
1792513006552_style.prompt: 1950s color pulp comic style: bold black outlines and heavy ink shadows, exaggerated features and dramatic expressions. Limited high-saturation print colors, flesh tones, bright yellow, primary red and purple in large flat fills, with dot screens for gradients and shading. Overall it feels retro, exaggerated and old-school, steeped in the air of vintage thriller pulps.

1792513006553_style.name: High-Saturation Naive Flat Color-Block Style

Clashing saturated colors, often on a pink ground with cobalt, grass green, primary red, bright yellow and black in distinct blocks. Overall it feels innocent, joyful and decorative like contemporary playful illustration.

1792513006554_style.name: Monochrome Blue-Ink Engraving Style
1792513006554_style.prompt: Monochrome blue-ink engraving style, imitating copperplate or steel-engraved illustrations: ultra-fine parallel lines, cross-hatching and stippling build tone and texture with precise, regular linework. 1792513006555_style.name: Loose Colored Crayon Line Style

Bright, lively color, lemon yellow, pink, sky blue, grass green and red laid flat with irregular white gaps and visible crayon strokes. Almost no shading; forms are separated by color patches and lines. Off-white paper with dry-media grain. Eye-level horizontal compositions with casual arrangements. Overall it feels light, warm and full of everyday life, like a hand-drawn sketchbook.

1792513006556_style.name: Grey Minimalist Geometric Light-and-Shadow Render
1792513006556_style.prompt: Grey minimalist geometric light-and-shadow render: 3D render where huge flat walls, slopes and geometric masses form abstract spaces, clean and crisp with almost no detail. Near-monochrome neutral greys in many values, with only minimal shifts in color temperature. A single beam of cool white light cuts in, forming a sharp wedge of light and large areas of shadow with smooth transitions. Fine matte concrete-like material with very light grain. Compositions with dramatic scale contrast, often using tiny human figures to emphasize mass. Overall it feels solemn, empty and meditative with an architectural aesthetic.

1792513006557_style.name: Classical Academic Oil Painting Style
1792513006557_style.prompt: Classical academic oil painting style: 19th-century academic realist technique with rigorous form, fine yet visible brushwork and accurate perspective and space. A mellow palette in which ochre, warm white and terracotta answer deep sea blue and emerald green at moderate saturation. Bright natural light with clear contrast in sunlight and cool reflected light in the shadows. Canvas weave, fine craquelure and yellowed varnish. 1792513006558_style.name: Victorian Pen-Hatching Illustration Style

Overall it feels classical, romantic and nostalgic, like an old storybook.

1792513006559_style.name: Minimalist Silhouette Sky-Gradient Style

1792513006562_style.name: 1950s Studio Rich-Color Film

Overall it feels bright, optimistic and adventurous with old-movie nostalgia.

Overall it feels intricate, quiet and like a handmade model fairy-tale world.

1792513006564_style.name: Black-and-White Scratchboard Comic Style

1792513006569_style.name: Cream High-Key Minimalist Cinematic Style

1792513006572_style.name: Teal-and-Brown Retro Film Style

1792513006574_style.name: Cold Cyan Motion-Streak Style

1792513006576_style.name: Faded Reddish Old-Photo Style

Overall it feels nostalgic, blurred and eroded by time, like a memory.

1792513006577_style.name: Lo-Fi Cool-Green Film Snapshot Style

1792513006580_style.name: Detailed Linework Pale-Wash Sci-Fi Comic Style

Overall it feels desolate, weighty and post-apocalyptic with the air of Japanese sci-fi manga.

1792513006581_style.name: Bleak Wasteland Surreal Photography

1792513006583_style.name: Architectural Perspective Pencil Sketch Style

1792513006627_style.name: Teal-Green Layered Grain Illustration
1792513006627_style.prompt: Teal-green layered grain illustration style, digitally drawn in 2D, stacking silhouetted cone shapes and curved planes in layers to build depth, highly simplified forms with soft edges and small figures as accents. The palette is nearly monochrome, ranging through deep and light teal, emerald and yellow-green with small touches of white and warm color. Light is expressed through misty translucent white bands and layered values, darker in front and lighter behind, with a strong sense of air. The whole image is covered in gouache and dry-brush grain and mottled noise. Compositions use a high viewpoint and receding layers with winding bands guiding the eye and tiny subjects, giving an overall fresh, tranquil, springtime healing picture-book mood.

1792513006628_style.name: Orange-Toned Light-Ink Landscape Painting
1792513006628_style.prompt: Orange-toned light-ink landscape painting style, hand-painted in 2D on the foundation of traditional Chinese shan shui brush and ink, with light-ink texture strokes outlining rocks, trees and pavilions while distant views are softened by washes, layers of mist and cloud fading away one after another. Colors lay a pale wash of warm orange, apricot and ochre under ink of varying density, often punctuated by a single vermilion accent. Light is expressed through ink tones and blank paper, with translucent mist and a strong sense of air. The paper shows rice-paper fibers and grain. Compositions combine high-distance and level-distance views, solid near and soft far, with water reflections extending the space, giving an overall tranquil, far-reaching Eastern mood with the warmth of dusk.

1792513006629_style.name: Sunlit Pastel Impressionist Oil Painting
1792513006629_style.prompt: Sunlit pastel impressionist oil painting style, hand-painted in 2D with short loose impressionist strokes and thick paint shaping forms, blurred contours and details suggested by color patches, fabrics and even the air built from layered strokes. Colors are soft pink, cream, pale yellow and warm orange wood, accented with wine red and fresh green, high in value with gentle saturation. Light is slanting warm afternoon sun, highlights nearly white and warm light patches falling across surfaces, shadows with a cool lavender tint. The surface shows clear canvas texture and oil brush marks. Compositions are eye-level with the subject centered and much of the frame bathed in light, giving an overall cozy, languid and bright afternoon atmosphere.

1792513006630_style.name: Dark-Ground Fine-Line Soft-Color Japanese Painting
1792513006630_style.prompt: Dark-ground fine-line soft-color Japanese painting style, hand-painted in 2D blending contemporary Japanese fine-detail painting with traditional gongbi, layering ultra-fine colored lines to outline forms and textures, elegant, flowing shapes with a hint of the uncanny and intricate detail. A gradient ground from deep ink green to black sets off soft pinkish white, pale violet, light green and a touch of vermilion in strong contrast between dark and light. Light comes from a pale circular disc behind the subject and from line density, the subject seeming to glow faintly. The surface has paper grain and a light pastel-like texture, often with vertical inscriptions and seals. Compositions are vertical with the subject standing centered against large areas of dark negative space, giving an overall secluded, mysterious and exquisite Eastern decorative painting mood.

1792513006631_style.name: Maximalist Line-Drawing Illustration
1792513006631_style.prompt: Maximalist line-drawing illustration style, hand-drawn in 2D combining pen line work with flat gouache, densely layering lush vegetation and decorative detail with fine, tactile lines and almost no empty space. Colors are warm ochre, olive green, coral pink, orange-red and pale cyan at medium saturation with a retro cast. Lighting is flattened, depth separated only by warm-cool color blocks and line density. The surface shows paper grain and slight gouache brush marks. Compositions often overlay a close-up profile against a broad bird's-eye vista, creating scale contrast and a strong sense of space, giving an overall lush, romantic and exotic fantastical atmosphere.

1792513006632_style.name: Dreamy Swirling Cloud-Pattern Illustration
1792513006632_style.prompt: Dreamy swirling cloud-pattern illustration style, hand-drawn in 2D fusing ukiyo-e line work with post-impressionist swirling brushwork, clear ink lines outlining forms, curling, billowing clouds stacked in layers and skies filled with flowing swirl textures. Colors are midnight blue, deep green and creamy white, accented with pale cyan and small touches of vermilion and orange-yellow, calm and dreamlike. Light is soft moonlight, cloud edges glowing warm white, shadows in flat deep blue. The surface has fine grain and a paper feel. Compositions use a high viewpoint with scenes and their mirror reflections echoing above and below and tiny figures, giving an overall tranquil, fantastical and poetic dreamscape.

1792513006633_style.name: Fifties Hand-Drawn Fairy-Tale Animation
1792513006633_style.prompt: Fifties hand-drawn fairy-tale animation style, traditional 2D animation with hand-inked cel characters layered over backgrounds painted in watercolor and gouache, fluid, rounded character lines and graceful designs, and refined architecture rich in decorative detail. Colors are soft pastels, mainly pale rose, misty blue, light lavender gray and warm beige, gently saturated. Light is warm and soft, backgrounds using large shadow shapes for volume while characters carry a single shadow tone. The surface shows the paint texture of hand-painted backgrounds and slight film grain. Compositions are stage-like with stately perspective, often setting figures against grand architecture, giving an overall romantic, dreamy and classically elegant fairy-tale animation mood.

1792513006634_style.name: Wilderness Surreal Narrative Photography
1792513006634_style.prompt: Wilderness surreal narrative photography style, photorealistic live-action photographic work that places masks, transformations or illogical props in real outdoor natural settings to create absurd yet composed fable-like images with believable realistic detail. Tones are earthy olive green, dry-grass yellow, ochre brown and dark forest green, low-saturation and mellow. Light is soft natural overcast or early-evening light with no strong shadows and delicate gradation. Fine film grain. Compositions are eye-level medium-wide shots with small, centered figures surrounded by expanses of natural landscape, giving an overall quiet, uncanny and resonant surreal fable atmosphere.

1792513006635_style.name: Pink-Toned Soft-Color Line Illustration
1792513006635_style.prompt: Pink-toned soft-color line illustration style, digitally drawn in 2D with fine, lively lines outlining forms and foliage, combined with soft watercolor-like flat fills and washes, forms with a slightly loose hand-drawn feel. The palette is nearly monochrome, mostly soft pink, coral pink and cream with one or two intense accents of true red and gray-blue, gentle and delicate overall. Light is soft and diffuse, volume separated by pale value steps with no clear shadows. The surface has fine paper texture and grainy brush quality. Compositions often use a symmetrical frontal view with branches framing the subject on both sides, giving an overall romantic, nostalgic, storybook-like springtime European mood.

1792513006636_style.name: White-Wall Hard-Light Minimalist Still Life
1792513006636_style.prompt: White-wall hard-light minimalist still-life photography style, photorealistic live-action photographic work like fresh still-life features in lifestyle magazines and social media, simple subjects with very few elements, often held in a hand, with fresh, real textures. Tones are a clean warm-white background with one or two highly saturated subject colors, crisp and bright. Light is strong direct sunlight slanting in through a window, casting clear geometric light shapes and sharp shadows on the white wall. The image is sharp with slight film grain. Compositions leave large empty space with the subject centered or to one side, shot at eye level, giving an overall bright, simple and summery fresh lifestyle feel.

1792513006637_style.name: Emerald Light-and-Shadow Brush Illustration
1792513006637_style.prompt: Emerald light-and-shadow brush illustration style, digitally painted in 2D combining flat color blocks with visible dry-brush strokes to summarize forms, light flecks and plants rendered as patterned brush shapes, figures simple yet realistic. Colors are mainly emerald, jade, lake teal and pale blue with warm skin tones, cool, clear and fairly saturated. Light is strong summer sunshine, caustic-like rippling light patterns and highlights bright and lively, shadows in deep teal-green. The surface has fine grain and brush texture. Compositions often use a low camera with layered foreground and background, giving an overall cool, languid animated-illustration mood with a summer-film feel.

1792513006638_style.name: Minimalist Neutral-Tone Fashion Editorial
1792513006638_style.prompt: Minimalist neutral-tone fashion editorial style, photorealistic live-action photographic work like lookbook imagery from a high-end fashion label, with relaxed, restrained poses, loose clean silhouettes and finely legible fabric textures. Tones are soft oatmeal, stone gray, off-white and light gray, low-saturation and low-contrast, calm and refined. Light is broad, even, soft diffuse light with very faint shadows and natural skin tones. The image is clean and crisp with a slight film feel. Compositions use architectural empty spaces and bare concrete walls as backdrops, full-length or half-length at eye level with generous space and orderly geometric lines, giving an overall quietly confident, restrained and timeless minimalist aesthetic.

1792513006639_style.name: Ukiyo-e Bijin-ga Woodblock Print
1792513006639_style.prompt: Ukiyo-e bijin-ga woodblock print style, 2D printmaking texture in the tradition of Edo-period multicolor woodblock prints, fluid fine ink lines outlining figures and drapery, intricate, exquisite garment patterns and flora rendered in a patterned manner. Colors are faded indigo, gray-green, coral red, cream and pale pink, low-saturation, antique and elegant. No realistic lighting; layers come from flat color blocks and graded bokashi. The paper is yellowed, with woodgrain impressions, registration grain and the mottling of age. Compositions are flattened with figures in the main position surrounded by floral patterns, often with vertical calligraphic inscriptions and red seals, giving an overall graceful, delicate and classical Eastern genre-painting atmosphere.

1792513006640_style.name: Purple-Toned Digital Glitch Art
1792513006640_style.prompt: Purple-toned digital glitch art style, created digitally in 2D, shattering the image with pixel dragging, data displacement, torn scanlines and sliced color blocks until forms survive only as blurred outlines, with horizontal and vertical streaks and noise stacked layer upon layer. Colors are mainly deep purple, electric violet and magenta, with black shadows and a few teal and white highlights, cold and hazy. Light comes from blown-out white glow bursts and neon flecks with strong contrast. The surface is covered in digital noise, compression artifacts and pixel grain. Compositions are full-bleed without a clear focal point, chaotic yet rhythmic, giving an overall psychedelic, restless and cyber-tinged digital distortion mood.

1792513006641_style.name: Misty-Rain Reflection Naive Flat Painting
1792513006641_style.prompt: Misty-rain reflection naive flat painting style, hand-painted in 2D with flat acrylic or gouache blocks, forms with a slightly childlike naive-art charm, simplified details with strong decorative quality and finely rendered patterns. Colors are sober deep green, gray-white, golden warm light and pink accents with a single bright yellow, medium-low saturation and soft haze. Light is diffuse rainy-day light with warm interior light spilling out and wet ground showing soft reflections. The surface has a matte paint texture with slight grain. Compositions are frontal and eye-level, spread horizontally, with small figures arranged in the foreground, giving an overall romantic, cozy and slightly languid urban everyday mood.

1792513006642_style.name: Direct-Flash Domestic Film Portrait
1792513006642_style.prompt: Direct-flash domestic film portrait style, photorealistic live-action photographic work like personal snapshots from the nineties to the early 2000s, figures posed casually in home spaces with real, unstyled clutter and furnishings. Tones are warm cream, milky white and powder blue at medium saturation, shadows with a slight green or warm cast. Light is on-camera direct flash, flattening the front of the figure while casting crisp hard shadows on the wall behind and falling off quickly into darkness around the edges. Visible film grain and slight overexposure. Compositions are casual snapshots from slightly above or at eye level with the subject in the middle of the frame, giving an overall intimate, authentic and nostalgic youth-documentary atmosphere.

1792513006643_style.name: Ukiyo-e Pastoral Landscape Woodblock
1792513006643_style.prompt: Ukiyo-e pastoral landscape woodblock style, 2D printmaking texture in the tradition of Edo-period famous-places landscape prints, with clear ink lines outlining vegetation and distant views, finely detailed foregrounds and distances simplified into flat silhouettes. Colors run from an indigo sky gradient to pale pink dusk, with straw yellow, gray-green and cream paper, accented with red title cartouches. Light is conveyed through bokashi gradients in sky and water that suggest the time of day and atmosphere, with no realistic shadows. The paper shows woodblock grain, fibers and yellowed age. Compositions boldly close in on foreground elements to set off vast distances, with a low horizon and clear layers, often with inscriptions and seals, giving an overall expansive, serene and seasonally poetic Eastern landscape atmosphere.

1792513006644_style.name: Deep-Blue Low-Key Hand-Painted Animation
1792513006644_style.prompt: Deep-blue low-key hand-painted animation style, 2D animation pairing painterly hand-painted backgrounds with simple cel line work, foliage and distant views summarized in brush blocks and dense detail in the foreground. The palette centers on deep midnight blue and dark green, dotted with many tiny specks of red, yellow, pink and purple contrasted with warm orange glowing elements. Light is cool, dark moonlit ambient light with local warm light picking out the focal point, and stars and light dust scattered across the sky. The surface has soft gouache strokes and slight grain. Compositions are tranquil widescreen long shots with a low horizon and a large expanse of sky, giving an overall serene, dreamy and poetic cinematic-animation atmosphere.

1792513006645_style.name: Cobalt Brushstroke-Motion Fashion Photography
1792513006645_style.prompt: Cobalt brushstroke-motion fashion photography style, photorealistic live-action photographic work fusing fashion portraiture with painted brushstrokes: the figure stays sharp while garments and hems are rendered as broad sweeping dry-brush swirls that trace strong motion trails. Colors are rich cobalt blue and black against an almost pure-white high-key background, with pale pink-white dry-brush streaks showing through in places. Light is clean, bright studio softness with minimal shadows and crisp contours. The brushwork carries dragged-paint texture and grain. Compositions leave large empty space with full-length side-on figures and movement unfolding along arcs, giving an overall elegant, dynamic and artistically experimental fashion-editorial atmosphere.

1792513006646_style.name: Street-Graffiti Neo-Expressionism
1792513006646_style.prompt: Street-graffiti neo-expressionist style, hand-painted in 2D fusing street graffiti with primitive art, rough oil-stick, spray-paint and brushed lines scrawled freely, distorted forms, mask-like symbolic faces and plenty of text, arrows and skull-like scribbled symbols scattered across the surface. Colors are bold black, true red, gray-blue, pink and white, blocks layered directly without blending. No realistic lighting; strong contrast comes from color blocks and heavy lines. The surface shows paint drips, overpainting and scraping. Compositions are crowded, fragmented and randomly juxtaposed, giving an overall primal, restless contemporary art atmosphere charged with street energy and cryptic symbols.

1792513006647_style.name: Dark-Ground Fine-Line Chinese Landscape Illustration
1792513006647_style.prompt: Dark-ground fine-line Chinese landscape illustration style, digitally drawn in 2D on the framework of traditional shan shui ridges and flowing water, outlining mountains, mist and currents with ultra-fine parallel lines, ripples and curling patterns, patterned forms with strong decorative quality. Colors are indigo, ink teal, gray-green and warm gold-beige on a pure black ground, with one vermilion accent as the focal point, calm in tone with a faint glow. Light is expressed through line density and bright washes, mountains seeming to rise from the dark with a glow of their own. The surface has a fine engraved-line texture, often with inscriptions and seals. Compositions are vertical with a winding waterway running top to bottom through layered depth, giving an overall secluded, mysterious mood blending the Eastern and the modern.

1792513006648_style.name: Red-Blue Color-Field Abstract Painting
1792513006648_style.prompt: Red-blue color-field abstract painting style, hand-painted in 2D, building the image from broad flat fields of color and organic rounded color shapes rather than depicting specific forms, with loose visible strokes and soft, slightly bleeding edges. Colors are mainly an intense clash of vermilion and cobalt blue against raw off-white canvas, with occasional pale pink transitions, in strong, pure contrast. No light or shadow is depicted; emotion comes entirely from color conflict and the tension of shapes. The surface shows thin paint soaking into the canvas weave and dry-brush marks. Compositions split top-bottom or left-right with color shapes of varied size in rhythmic arrangement, giving an overall fervent, tense and pure emotional abstract-art atmosphere.

1792513006649_style.name: Brushstroke Cyber Rainy-Night Matte Painting
1792513006649_style.prompt: Brushstroke cyber rainy-night matte painting style, digitally painted in 2D with loose concept-art brushes quickly laying in architecture and figures, simplified forms with dry-brush edges and details suggested by color patches. The tonal base is dark blue-gray night, accented with high-saturation magenta, fluorescent green and bright orange neon light sources. Light is a wet rainy-night environment, neon stretching long reflections across slick ground, heavy shadows and local flashes of brightness. The surface shows clear brush texture and slight grain. Compositions use deep alley perspective with buildings pressing in on both sides and tiny figures, giving an overall gloomy, nostalgic cyberpunk atmosphere with a retro-futurist feel.

1792513006650_style.name: Exuberant Pastel Gouache Sketch
1792513006650_style.prompt: Exuberant pastel gouache sketch style, hand-painted in 2D with a broad flat brush boldly laying down gouache patches, then dashing in contours and structure with thick black strokes, loose, uninhibited brushwork and casually summarized forms with the spontaneity of on-site sketching. Compositions are full, foreground color masses framing the scene and depth leading into the distance, giving an overall cheerful, warm and nostalgic springtime mood.

1792513006651_style.name: Fresh-Green Expressive Brushstroke Sketch
1792513006651_style.prompt: Fresh-green expressive brushstroke sketch style, hand-painted in 2D with bold palette-knife and brush blocks shaping large masses and fine, lively ink lines outlining structure and contours, keeping plenty of improvised strokes and unfinished white space over a realistic framework. Colors are mainly fresh green, yellow-green, emerald and gray-teal, accented with ochre red, earth yellow and cream paper, fresh and bright. Spring sunlight is conveyed through warm-cool patches and value jumps without detailed shadows. The surface shows uneven paint thickness and scraping marks. Compositions often frame a central subject with foreground elements on both sides and blank space drawing the eye in, giving an overall fresh, vibrant, spring-filled plein-air sketching mood.

1792513006652_style.name: Deep-Green Line-and-Flat Illustration
1792513006652_style.prompt: Deep-green-dominant line-and-flat illustration style, digitally drawn in 2D with thin dark lines outlining dense leaves and grasses, combined with large flat fills and fine linear textures, plant forms enlarged and exaggerated to fill the frame with small figures as accents. The palette is dominated by rich emerald, grass green and deep green, dotted with small specks of bright yellow, pale pink, misty blue and orange, with clearly separated color blocks. Lighting is flattened, depth distinguished only by darker and lighter greens with no clear shadows. The surface has fine paper grain and a hand-drawn line feel. Compositions are vertical and all-over yet clearly layered, an open channel guiding the eye, giving an overall lush, quiet picture-book mood with a hint of solitary poetry.

1792513006653_style.name: Bold Colored-Pencil Picture-Book Illustration
1792513006653_style.prompt: Bold colored-pencil picture-book illustration style, hand-drawn in 2D with dense colored-pencil hatching filling color blocks, clearly directional, rough-textured strokes, fine lines for features and strands of hair, and endearingly naive characters with expressive eyes. Colors are bold and intense, large blocks of cobalt blue, orange-red, bright yellow and deep black side by side, cheeks touched with blush, in vivid contrast. Compositions are full with close-up subjects filling the frame against large flat backgrounds, giving an overall warm, slightly mysterious and playful hand-drawn picture-book mood.

1792513006654_style.name: Nineties Mecha Anime Key-Art Style
1792513006654_style.prompt: Nineties mecha anime key-art style, hand-drawn in 2D like animation design sheets and artbook illustrations, pencil and ink lines outlining intricate mechanical armor with hard yet sketchy lines, then colored quickly with colored pencil and markers that keep hatching and strokes visible. Compositions use low, looming angles with the subject filling the frame and strong dynamic tension, giving an overall ferocious, sharp and nostalgic nineties mecha anime atmosphere.

1792513006655_style.name: Breezy Retro Ink-Line Comic Style
1792513006655_style.prompt: Breezy retro ink-line comic style, hand-drawn in 2D with fluid ink lines of varied weight and a slight hand-drawn wobble outlining figures and objects, exaggerated yet friendly character designs, and details such as hair drawn strand by strand in fine lines. Colors set a soft gray-teal background against warm red, orange, cream and deep black, with sparse, slightly faded flat fills. Lighting is simple flat shadows and blushing cheeks, with a light sense of volume. The surface has retro print-like grain and paper texture. Compositions are often close-up half-length shots against an understated solid background, giving an overall warm, humorous and easygoing retro comic mood.
